To address this, we propose GAM, a hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory framework that explicitly decouples memory encoding from consolidation to effectively resolve the conflict between rapid context perception and stable knowledge retention. By isolating ongoing dialogue in an event progression graph and integrating it into a topic associative network only upon semantic shifts, our approach minimizes interference while preserving long-term consistency. Additionally, we introduce a graph-guided, multi-factor retrieval strategy to enhance context precision. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongDialQA indicate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both reasoning accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: GAM 是一种面向 LLM 智能体的分层图式智能体记忆框架，通过将“记忆编码”与“记忆固化”解耦，在事件进展图（局部缓冲）与主题联想网络（全局长期存储）之间建立写隔离，并以语义事件触发（Semantic-Event-Triggered）状态机在语义边界处执行原子式合并；同时提出图引导的多因子（时间/置信度/角色）检索策略。在 LoCoMo 与 LongDialQA 上，该方法在四种骨干模型上均优于 MemoryBank、MemGPT、MemoryOS、A-Mem、Mem0、AriGraph 等基线，并取得更低的 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长期交互中需同时满足“快速感知新信息”与“稳定保留既有知识”，但二者存在结构性冲突。统一流式记忆（MemGPT、MemoryOS、Mem0、A-Mem 等）直接在活动记忆流上更新，缺少写隔离，容易产生记忆污染（Memory Contamination）、记忆丢失（已建立节点因连接弱化被孤立遗忘）与语义漂移（不同主题被错误混淆）；且这类自反思式方法多以 token 数或时间步作为任意触发条件，而非语义完整性。相反，离散结构化记忆（GraphRAG、LightRAG、G-Memory、StructRAG）结构稳定但刚性，索引构建昂贵、延迟高，难以刻画开放域对话中叙事的连续演化，产生碎片化话语表示。部分工作（AriGraph、Zep）虽引入动态元素，但依赖人为设定的离散状态切换或仅优化检索基础设施，未根本解决“即时编码 vs 长期固化”的认知冲突。
AI.method:
形式化：把记忆管理建模为推理期在线决策策略，最小化编码成本 C_enc 与长期干扰成本 C_inter 之和（式1），并用语义发散指示器 b_t=I(Δ(G_event,G_topic)>ε)（式2）作为低成本触发代理。

分层图记忆架构：H_t = {G_topic, G_event, S_arch, E_cross}（式3）。全局主题联想网络 G_topic 以高层语义簇为节点、LLM 语义打分器（E.1 提示词，关系类型 support/contradict/coreference/causal/semantic/unrelated + 置信度权重）确定边；局部事件进展图 G_event 以原子交互单元为节点、时序/因果边为连接，支持快速追加以降低编码延迟；E_cross 将主题节点索引到归档事件图，保留可溯源证据。

状态式记忆固化：将叙事动态建模为有限状态机，在“情节缓冲态”与“语义固化态”间切换。情节缓冲态严格写隔离，仅向局部图追加事件（式6）；语义固化态在检测到语义边界 b_t=1 时，将缓冲区合并为双粒度节点 v_new={c_sum, c_raw}（式7，E.2 提示词生成关键词+摘要，同时拼接原始文本防信息丢失），再以“粗到细”策略接入全局图——先用向量检索取 top-5 候选主题节点，再仅对这些候选调用 LLM 关系打分器，超过阈值 τ 则建立新边（式8），避免 O(N) 全图打分；随后事件图入档 S_arch、建立 E_cross、清空缓冲区并回到缓冲态。

语义边界检测：使用 2048 token 固定容量的情节缓冲区，由 LLM 代理充当阈值函数；判别器不逐轮调用，仅在会话结束、交互停顿、缓冲区溢出等稀疏维护事件时触发（算法2），ε 并非硬性数值距离阈值，而以提示词严格程度作为启发式代理。

图引导多因子检索：自顶向下“扩展-下钻”。先向量检索得到 V_top 并沿 E_topic 纳入一跳邻居形成 V_anchor（式9）；再经 E_cross 下钻到 S_arch 中归档事件图，聚合候选集 C（式10）；最后用交叉编码器计算基础语义概率 P_sem(v|q)，并以乘性调制 Score(v,q)=P_sem(v|q)·∏β_k^{I_k(v,q)}（式11），其中 K={time, conf, role}：时间因子在查询含时间表达式时激活，置信度因子偏好通过编码期自一致性校验的记忆，角色因子校验记忆来源说话人是否匹配查询隐含的对话方，从而解耦多方叙事线索。

实现：完全免训练框架（backbone 为现成指令模型），采用 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 向量编码与 cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 重排，检索规模 k=10，β_time=β_role=1.4、β_conf=1.2。
AI.result:
LoCoMo（取前四类）：GAM 在四个骨干（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B/14B、GPT-4o-mini）上总体取得最佳平均分；Qwen2.5-7B 平均 F1 40.00 / BLEU-1 32.99，GPT-4o-mini 平均 F1 43.14 / BLEU-1 36.48，Llama-3.2-3B 平均 F1 36.27 / BLEU-1 30.02。Qwen2.5-7B 上 Temporal F1 48.97 超过 Mem0 的 41.22 逾 18%；例外是 GPT-4o-mini 的 Temporal F1 低于 Mem0（51.96 vs 56.42），作者归因于大模型时序能力强、可直接检索原始轨迹保留精确时序线索，而 GAM 在固化时部分压缩；Open-Domain 为最弱类别，因其弱定位、缺少时间/角色约束。

LongDialQA：GAM 全部骨干领先，Qwen2.5-7B 平均 F1 12.55 / BLEU-1 12.43，超 MemoryOS 约 86%，并在三个子集（Big Bang Theory / Friends / The Office）上整体占优（The Office 11.60 vs Mem0 9.11），验证角色中心因子在多方叙事中的消歧作用；对小模型 Llama-3.2-3B 亦取得最高平均 F1 7.36，体现模型无关的稳健性。

消融（Qwen2.5-7B，LoCoMo）：w/o EPG 下降最大（25.06/20.76），w/o SSM 次之（32.58/26.13），w/o TAN（35.07/29.00）、w/o MFR（35.94/29.28），完整模型 40.00/32.99，说明事件图结构、编码-固化解耦、主题组织与多信号融合均不可或缺。

分区策略：语义边界触发优于 Fixed Window（256/512）、Fixed Turns（k=3/5）与 Session-based，平均 F1 40.00 vs 最低 34.23，Temporal 提升尤为明显（48.97 vs 44.12）；引入 0–40% 分割噪声（Miss/Shift/Extra）后平均 F1 仍稳定于约 40.0，η=0.4 时为 38.60，仍高于 Fixed Window 34.23 与 Session-based 36.59。

效率：token/查询 1370.18 为最低（较 Mem0 降约 11%），延迟 0.80s（F1 领先 13%），显著优于 A-Mem（4221 tokens/2.21s）与 MemoryOS（3400 tokens/154.22s）；维护阶段判别器每会话约 0.63s、932 输入 token，属稀疏维护原语；扩展性上注入至 27 个会话时边数增至 3307，但 token 与延迟稳定（1836/4.71s，F1 0.48→随会话增长上升），检索先经主题层剪枝避免无控增长。

超参敏感性：β_role=1.4 峰值（>1.6 因过度过滤下降），β_time=1.4 最优（利于 Temporal、略损 Open-Domain），β_conf 在 1.2–1.4 轻微峰值且曲线平坦，说明增益主要源自架构而非调参；检索规模 k=10 达峰，继续增大因噪声引入而下降。

代理多模态：MovieChat-1K 密集字幕流上零样本迁移时间/角色/置信度因子，准确率 55.51（+8.16）、F1 48.95、BLEU-1 51.63，优于长上下文直接输入基线。
AI.conclusion: GAM 通过在物理层面分离全局主题联想网络与局部事件进展图，并仅在语义完整的边界处（语义事件触发状态切换）执行原子式合并，从结构上化解了“快速上下文感知”与“稳定知识保留”的冲突，抑制了流式记忆中的记忆污染、记忆丢失与语义漂移；配合融合时间、置信度、角色信号的图引导自顶向下检索，在 LoCoMo 与 LongDialQA 上以更低 token 消耗与可比延迟取得优于 SOTA 的推理精度，并具备对分割噪声与超参的低敏感性和随记忆增长稳定的推理开销。局限与展望：当前仅限文本模态，无法利用视觉/听觉等非语言信息，作者提出未来以多模态节点（符号摘要+关键帧/音频特征）替换纯文本表示、由视觉或声学信号触发状态切换；并指出持久记忆带来的隐私与安全风险——状态式固化在写入全局图前提供了天然的审查干预点，图结构也便于选择性删除、冻结与分支剪枝，错误记忆可通过删除虚假边或调整置信度局部修正，但这些仅为安全原语，仍需接口设计、审计与用户同意机制。

title: Agentic Insight Generation in VSM Simulations
summary: Extracting actionable insights from complex value stream map simulations can be challenging, time-consuming, and error-prone. Recent advances in large language models offer new avenues to support users with this task. While existing approaches excel at processing raw data to gain information, they are structurally unfit to pick up on subtle situational differences needed to distinguish similar data sources in this domain. To address this issue, we propose a decoupled, two-step agentic architecture. By separating orchestration from data analysis, the system leverages progressive data discovery infused with domain expert knowledge. This architecture allows the orchestration to intelligently select data sources and perform multi-hop reasoning across data structures while maintaining a slim internal context. Results from multiple state-of-the-art large language models demonstrate the framework's viability: with top-tier models achieving accuracies of up to 86% and demonstrating high robustness across evaluation runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种解耦的双步骤智能体架构，用于从复杂价值流图模拟中提取可操作洞察。该架构将编排与数据分析分离，结合领域专家知识进行渐进式数据发现，支持跨数据结构的多次推理。
AI.motivation: 从复杂价值流图模拟中提取可操作洞察具有挑战性、耗时且容易出错。现有大语言模型虽擅长处理原始数据获取信息，但在识别该领域中细微情境差异以区分相似数据源方面存在结构性不足。
AI.method: 提出解耦的双步骤智能体架构：1）将编排与数据分析分离；2）融合领域专家知识的渐进式数据发现；3）支持跨数据结构的多次推理，同时保持紧凑的内部上下文。
AI.result: 多个前沿大语言模型的测试结果表明该框架的可行性：顶级模型达到最高86%的准确率，且在多次评估运行中表现出高稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 该架构有效解决了价值流图模拟分析中的细粒度区分难题，证明了将编排与数据分析解耦结合领域知识注入的方法在复杂仿真分析任务中的实用价值。

title: PubSwap: Public-Data Off-Policy Coordination for Federated RLVR
summary: Reasoning post-training with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is typically studied in centralized settings, yet many realistic applications involve decentralized private data distributed across organizations. Federated training is a natural solution, but scaling RLVR in this regime is challenging: full-model synchronization is expensive, and performing many local steps can cause severe client drift under heterogeneous data. We propose a federated RLVR framework that combines LoRA-based local adaptation with public-data-based off-policy steps to improve both communication efficiency and cross-client coordination. In particular, a small shared public dataset is used to periodically exchange and reuse response-level training signals across organizations, providing a lightweight anchor toward a more globally aligned objective without exposing private data. Our method selectively replaces locally incorrect responses with globally correct ones during public-data steps, thereby keeping training closer to the local policy while still benefiting from cross-client coordination. Across mathematical and medical reasoning benchmarks and models, our method consistently improves over standard baselines. Our results highlight a simple and effective recipe for federated reasoning post-training: combining low-rank communication with limited public-data coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联邦强化学习框架，结合LoRA局部适配与公共数据离线策略步骤，解决去中心化场景下RLVR的可扩展性问题，在数学和医学推理基准上优于标准基线。
AI.motivation: 当前RLVR研究集中于中心化设置，而现实应用涉及跨组织的去中心化私有数据。联邦训练面临全模型同步开销大、局部异质性导致严重客户端漂移两大挑战。
AI.method: 提出联邦RLVR框架：(1) 基于LoRA的局部适配保持通信高效；(2) 利用小型共享公共数据集进行周期性响应级训练信号交换，提供轻量级全局对齐锚点；(3) 在公共数据步骤中选择性替换本地错误响应为全局正确响应。
AI.result: 在多个数学和医学推理基准及模型上，方法一致优于标准基线。
AI.conclusion: 联邦推理后训练的有效方案：低秩通信+有限公共数据协调。该方法兼顾通信效率与跨客户端协调，同时保护私有数据隐私。

title: Frontier-Eng: Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on Real-World Engineering Tasks with Generative Optimization
summary: Current LLM agent benchmarks, which predominantly focus on binary pass/fail tasks such as code generation or search-based question answering, often neglect the value of real-world engineering that is often captured through the iterative optimization of feasible designs. To this end, we introduce Frontier-Eng, a human-verified benchmark for generative optimization -- an iterative propose-execute-evaluate loop in which an agent generates candidate artifacts, receives executable verifier feedback, and revises them under a fixed interaction budget -- spanning $47$ tasks across five broad engineering categories. Unlike previous suites, Frontier-Eng tasks are grounded in industrial-grade simulators and verifiers that provide continuous reward signals and enforce hard feasibility constraints under constrained budgets. We evaluate eight frontier language models using representative search frameworks, finding that while Claude 4.6 Opus achieves the most robust performance, the benchmark remains challenging for all models. Our analysis suggests a dual power-law decay in improvement frequency ($\sim$ 1/iteration) and magnitude ($\sim$ 1/improvement count). We further show that although width improves parallelism and diversity, depth remains crucial for hard-won improvements under a fixed budget. Frontier-Eng establishes a new standard for assessing the capacity of AI agents to integrate domain knowledge with executable feedback to solve complex, open-ended engineering problems.

AI.tldr: Frontier-Eng 是一个面向「生成式优化」（generative optimization）的新基准：把真实工程优化任务形式化为 (任务上下文 C, 初始可行解 x₀, 冻结求值器 E) 三元组，在固定交互预算内让 LLM 智能体反复「提出候选—执行—评估—修改」，以「预算内找到的最佳可行解分数」而非二元通过/失败来衡量能力。基准含 5 大类共 47 个任务，全部基于工业级仿真器/有限元求解器/密码学参考实现/量子编译锚点等可执行验证器，并配套只读隔离、防 reward hacking 的评分管线。跨 9 个前沿模型与 3 类搜索框架的实验显示：GPT-5.4（重测后）平均排名最佳（3.54），claude-opus-4.6 次之（3.63）；改进动态呈「双重幂律」（频率 ∝ t⁻¹、幅度 ∝ k⁻¹）；在固定预算下「深度」显著优于「宽度」。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准（SWE-bench、搜索类问答、代码生成）以二元 pass/fail 为主，衡量的是「从 0 到 1 的一次性产出」；而真实工程的价值更多来自「在一个已可行的初始解上，在硬约束与资源预算下反复迭代优化」——例如充电曲线缩短十分钟、桁架减重 15%、调度缩短 makespan 20%。这类问题往往没有已知最优解（GPU kernel、调度启发式、控制策略都可继续改进），本质需要把「检索领域知识（search）」与「生成可执行实现（coding）」在闭环反馈中紧耦合。已有生成式优化工作（FunSearch、AlphaEvolve、Self-Refine、Learning to Discover）仅覆盖数学函数发现、单一组合优化或合成优化地形，缺少跨工程学科、以可执行验证器为反馈、面向真实工程设计的系统性基准；同时缺少「固定预算下最优可行解」这一评测范式与防 reward hacking 的评测完整性机制。
AI.method:
【任务形式化】工程优化任务定义为 τ=(C, x₀, E)：C 为只读上下文（问题说明、约束、参考数据、支撑代码）；x₀∈X 为贡献者提供的可行但可能朴素的初始解（Python/C/C++/CUDA/Triton 代码、配置或结构化提交）；E: X→{0,1}×R 为不可修改的冻结求值器，返回可行性指示 v(x) 与仅在可行时有效的标量分数 s(x)（含内部随机性时以固定种子重复运行取期望）。生成式优化智能体 A 在预算 B 内迭代：x_t=A(C, H_{t-1})，H 为历史 (x_i,v_i,s_i)，可行与不可行步骤均消耗预算；目标 s*=max{s_t : v_t=1, 0≤t≤B}。架构上区分「搜索策略（如何选择/呈现历史）」与「提案机制（LLM 代码生成）」。
【基准构建】47 个任务，五类：计算与量子信息(10)、运筹与决策科学(9)、机器人/控制/能源(8)、光学与通信(10)、物理科学与工程设计(10)。任务来源五渠道：工程竞赛（ISCSO）、学术套件（Summit、MQT Bench、OpenProblems）、经典课程作业（MallocLab）、工业仿真器（MuJoCo、PyBullet、SustainDC）、专家原创（自适应光学、光纤网络、库存管理、电池电化学）。入选需满足：规格自洽、存在可编辑解空间 x₀、提供可运行且声明环境的求值器、初始解已验证可行 v(x₀)=1；经「自动化智能体初审 + 人工维护者复核」两阶段质量控制。
【反作弊三层机制】隔离（求值器与参考数据只读，候选在仅含声明可访问文件的沙箱临时目录执行）；验证器解析式打分（分数只从 stdout/JSON/仿真产物中提取，候选无法自报）；评测稳健性（多测试种子、随机输入、多场景平均、OpenSSL 参考比对、FEM 重解等二次校验）。
【评测协议】主指标为任务内平均排名 R_m（1/N Σ rank，越小越好，单位无关，无需知道理论最优）；分布分析采用 Dolan–Moré 性能剖面，为处理负分任务先做逐任务平移 s̃=s*−s*_min+1 再计算比值 ρ≥1，得 P_m(α)；辅助指标为「相对基线胜率」（最佳可行分严格超过初始解的任务比例）；另给五类分解与协议与具体搜索算法解耦。
【实验设计】Exp1：9 个模型在同一 openevolve 框架、固定 100 次迭代、相同初始程序与冻结验证器下对比（GPT-5.4 以同协议全 47 任务重测替换原运行）；Exp2：claude-opus-4.6 与 gpt-oss-120b 在 abmcts / openevolve / shinkaevolve 三框架下的聚合（平均排名、胜/平）与轨迹统计（gain、early-share、last-improve、best-updates、plateau）；Exp3：优化动力学（GPT-OSS-120B+openevolve、500 次迭代，追踪 running-best 改进事件分布与幅度）；Exp4：深度-宽度预算实验（B=n×d≤256，n∈{1,2,4,8,16}，10 任务子集）；Exp5：四个代表性任务（MallocLab、BatteryFastChargingProfile、general_meio、SHA3-256）的案例与代码日志分析；附录给出 47 任务逐项目标/评分/反作弊说明与原始分数表。
AI.result:
【模型对比】重测后 GPT-5.4 平均排名最佳 3.54，略优于 claude-opus-4.6 3.63，其后 glm-5 4.34、deepseek-v3.2 4.76、gpt-oss-120b 4.81、gemini-3.1-pro 5.53、seed-2.0-pro 5.86、qwen3-coder-next 6.71、grok-4.20 5.82（GPT-5.4 原运行仅 5.68，重测使其跃居首位）。性能剖面上 GPT-5.4 在 24/47 任务（51.1%）取得最优平移分，在 33/47（70.2%）落入 1.1 近优带；而「相对基线胜率」最高的是 glm-5 与 gpt-oss-120b，说明排名靠前与「能稳定超过初始解」并不完全重合。所有模型在该基准上均未被完全解决，多任务仍停留在基线水平。
【模型×框架】claude-opus-4.6 在三框架上全面优于 gpt-oss-120b：平均排名 1.43/1.28/1.28 vs 1.55/1.64/1.62，胜局 26/30/29 vs 20/13/13（平局 1/4/5），差距最大出现在 openevolve。轨迹上 abmcts 收益前置（early-share 0.89/0.99）、plateau 长（OSS 0.72、best-updates 仅 3）；openevolve 早期集中但保留多次后期更新（best-updates 5.5/6.0）；shinkaevolve 最利于持续精修（OSS last-improve 0.64、plateau 0.45）。结论为「模型—框架交互效应」而非某框架普适最优。
【优化动力学】改进事件频率随迭代衰减 ∝ t⁻¹（R²=0.84，多数改进集中在前约 30 步，尾部延至 500），单次改进幅度随序数 k 衰减 ∝ k⁻¹（首次为大尺度结构重写，后续为小幅增量精修），47 个任务全部至少获得一次改进，每任务改进次数中位数为 7；约 50–100 次迭代后边际收益趋近零，形成「双重挤压」。
【深度 vs 宽度】等预算对角线 n×d=256 上归一化分数随 n 单调下降（n=1,2,4,8,16 对应 1.00、0.99、0.99、0.97、0.91），确认固定预算下单条深链优于多链并行（重启会清空累积上下文）；仅在固定深度时加宽才带来提升。
【案例分析】MallocLab 存在「粒度—能力鸿沟」：Claude 在大改写与精修两种动力学下均达 97，GPT-OSS 在大改写下「能力崩塌」至 53，但在 shinkaevolve 细粒度分解下恢复到 86；电池快充为边界敏感控制问题，openevolve 的「大步改写」（四段→六段激进电流）达 120.80，而增量式仅 87.58，说明需要「有计算地侵入安全裕度」；general_meio 属策略结构搜索，Claude 早期「regime shift」换成两阶段网络级策略达 0.9929，精修式 0.9694；SHA3-256 为实现密度型任务，Claude 端到端重写（mmap I/O + 标量级 Keccak 轮）达 28.90，最优组合为 Claude+openevolve。总体结论：任务结构决定轨迹形状（结构阈值 / 边界控制 / 策略搜索 / 实现工程），模型能力决定候选质量上限，框架动力学决定如何逼近该上限。
AI.conclusion: 论文将评测焦点从「是否给出唯一正确答案」转移到「固定交互预算下，智能体能否把领域知识与可执行反馈整合起来，在硬约束下持续搜到高质量可行解」，提出 Frontier-Eng（47 任务 / 5 大类，统一元数据接口、只读冻结验证器、验证器解析式打分、防 reward hacking 三层机制），并建立以平均排名为主、性能剖面与胜率为辅的跨异构任务评测协议；实验表明前沿模型已具备一定迭代优化能力（能有效优化简单控制器与算法内核），但在复杂物理系统的多目标权衡与长程推理上仍明显吃力，且高度依赖搜索框架的粒度与「大胆改写 vs 细粒度精修」的选择。据此作者主张：通往工程 AGI 的关键不只是更大模型，而是更善于把领域知识与结构化可执行反馈相结合的搜索策略；作者计划扩展更多工程领域与更高保真度仿真。需要指出的局限与疑点：①摘要（称 8 个模型、Claude 最优）与正文（9 个模型、GPT-5.4 最优）不一致；②表 7 原始分数中 GPT-5.4 在 EngDesign、ISCSO2015、ISCSO2023、TopologyOptimization、predict_modality、disruption_eoqd 等多任务上与基线完全相同，却在表 2 中多处取得最佳排名，排名与原始分数的对应关系、并列处理与「重测」口径需要澄清；③主指标平均排名丢弃幅度信息，性能剖面的逐任务平移也改变了「接近最优」的语义，且未报告重复实验、方差或显著性检验；④跨模型比较固定为 100 次迭代、单次运行，预算相对任务难度的适配性未加讨论；⑤框架对比仅覆盖两模型三框架，结论外推性有限；⑥类别规模较小（8–10 任务/类），分类分解的统计稳定性受限。

title: Decoding by Perturbation: Mitigating MLLM Hallucinations via Dynamic Textual Perturbation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models frequently suffer from inference hallucinations, partially stemming from language priors dominating visual evidence. Existing training-free mitigation methods either perturb the visual representation and deviate from the natural image distribution, or enforce intrusive manipulations that compromise the model's inherent generative fluency. We introduce a novel perspective that multimodal hallucination manifests as the hypersensitivity of visual grounding to textual phrasing during the decoding phase. Building on this insight, we propose Decoding by Perturbation (DeP), a training-free framework mitigating prior-induced hallucinations via controlled textual interventions. DeP employs a dynamic probe applying multi-level textual perturbations to elicit latent language priors. Leveraging attention variance, it enhances stable evidence regions while suppressing suspicious noise in the feature space. Furthermore, it constructs an interpretable prior drift direction using logits statistics to counteract probability biases from textual co-occurrences. Extensive experiments confirm DeP effectively reduces hallucinations and achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Decoding by Perturbation (DeP)框架，通过在解码阶段对文本进行受控扰动来缓解多模态大语言模型的幻觉问题。该方法利用注意力方差识别稳定视觉证据区域，并构建先验漂移方向来抵消文本共现导致的概率偏差。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型常出现推理幻觉，部分原因是语言先验 dominance 于视觉证据。现有免训练缓解方法存在缺陷：扰动视觉表示会偏离自然图像分布，强制干预会损害模型内在生成流畅性。
AI.method: 1) 将多模态幻觉重新定义为解码阶段视觉定位对文本措辞的过度敏感；2) 采用动态探针，通过多层文本扰动激发潜在语言先验；3) 利用注意力方差增强稳定证据区域，抑制特征空间中的可疑噪声；4) 使用logits统计构建可解释的先验漂移方向，对抗文本共现概率偏差。
AI.result: 实验验证了DeP能有效减少幻觉，并在多个基准测试上达到优异性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种新的视角和免训练方法来解决多模态LLM幻觉问题，通过文本层面的干预而非视觉扰动或强制操纵，为该领域提供了更自然的解决方案。

title: CycloneMAE: A Scalable Multi-Task Learning Model for Global Tropical Cyclone Probabilistic Forecasting
summary: Tropical cyclones (TCs) rank among the most destructive natural hazards, yet their forecasting faces fundamental trade-offs: numerical weather prediction (NWP) models are computationally prohibitive and struggle to leverage historical data, while existing deep learning (DL)-based intelligent models are variable-specific and deterministic, which fail to generalize across different forecasting variables. Here we present CycloneMAE, a scalable multi-task forecasting model that learns transferable TC representations from multi-modal data using a TC structure-aware masked autoencoder. By coupling a discrete probabilistic gridding mechanism with a pre-train/fine-tune paradigm, CycloneMAE simultaneously delivers deterministic forecasts and probability distributions. Evaluated across five global ocean basins, CycloneMAE outperforms leading NWP systems in pressure and wind forecasting up to 120 hours and in track forecasting up to 24 hours. Attribution analysis via integrated gradients reveals physically interpretable learning dynamics: short-term forecasts rely predominantly on the internal core convective structure from satellite imagery, whereas longer-term forecasts progressively shift attention to external environmental factors. Our framework establishes a scalable, probabilistic, and interpretable pathway for operational TC forecasting.

AI.tldr: CycloneMAE是一个基于Transformer的多任务预测模型，通过掩码自编码器学习热带气旋的可迁移表示，同时输出确定性预报和概率分布。在五个全球洋盆的评估中，该模型在120小时内的气压和风场预报以及24小时内的路径预报方面超越了主流数值天气预报系统。
AI.motivation: 现有热带气旋预报面临核心矛盾：数值天气预报(NWP)计算成本高且难以利用历史数据，而现有深度学习模型缺乏跨变量泛化能力。本研究旨在构建一个可扩展的概率预报框架，同时解决计算效率和泛化性问题。
AI.method: 1) 采用TC结构感知掩码自编码器架构学习多模态数据的可迁移表示；2) 耦合离散概率网格化机制实现概率预报；3) 预训练/微调范式实现跨变量泛化。
AI.result: 在五个全球洋盆的评估中，CycloneMAE在120小时气压/风场预报和24小时路径预报上优于主流NWP系统。归因分析表明：短期预报主要依赖卫星影像中的内核对流结构，长期预报则逐步转向外部环境因素。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为热带气旋业务预报提供了一条可扩展、概率化、可解释的技术路径。

title: MultiDocFusion: Hierarchical and Multimodal Chunking Pipeline for Enhanced RAG on Long Industrial Documents
summary: RAG-based QA has emerged as a powerful method for processing long industrial documents. However, conventional text chunking approaches often neglect complex and long industrial document structures, causing information loss and reduced answer quality. To address this, we introduce MultiDocFusion, a multimodal chunking pipeline that integrates: (i) detection of document regions using vision-based document parsing, (ii) text extraction from these regions via OCR, (iii) reconstruction of document structure into a hierarchical tree using large language model (LLM)-based document section hierarchical parsing (DSHP-LLM), and (iv) construction of hierarchical chunks through DFS-based grouping. Extensive experiments across industrial benchmarks demonstrate that MultiDocFusion improves retrieval precision by 8-15% and ANLS QA scores by 2-3% compared to baselines, emphasizing the critical role of explicitly leveraging document hierarchy for multimodal document-based QA. These significant performance gains underscore the necessity of structure-aware chunking in enhancing the fidelity of RAG-based QA systems.

AI.tldr: MultiDocFusion是一个用于工业文档RAG问答的多模态分块流水线，通过融合视觉文档解析、OCR、LLM结构分析和DFS层次分组来重建文档结构。实验表明该方法在工业基准上检索精度提升8-15%，ANLS问答分数提升2-3%。
AI.motivation: 传统文本分块方法忽略复杂工业文档结构，导致信息丢失和答案质量下降，亟需结构感知的文档分块方案。
AI.method: 提出MultiDocFusion多模态分块流水线，包含四个核心模块：(1)基于视觉的文档区域检测；(2)OCR文本提取；(3)基于LLM的文档章节层次解析(DSHP-LLM)重建层级树结构；(4)基于DFS的层次分块构建。
AI.result: 在工业基准测试中，检索精度提升8-15%，ANLS问答分数提升2-3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用文档层次结构对多模态文档问答至关重要，结构感知分块是提升RAG问答系统保真度的必要手段。

title: GLeMM: A large-scale multilingual dataset for morphological research
summary: In derivational morphology, what mechanisms govern the variation in form-meaning relations between words? The answers to this type of questions are typically based on intuition and on observations drawn from limited data, even when a wide range of languages is considered. Many of these studies are difficult to replicate and generalize. To address this issue, we present GLeMM, a new derivational resource designed for experimentation and data-driven description in morphology. GLeMM is characterized by (i) its large size, (ii) its extensive coverage (currently amounting to seven European languages, i.e., German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Russian, (iii) its fully automated design, identical across all languages, (iv) the automatic annotation of morphological features on each entry, as well as (v) the encoding of semantic descriptions for a significant subset of these entries. It enables researchers to address difficult questions, such as the role of form and meaning in word-formation, and to develop and experimentally test computational methods that identify the structures of derivational morphology. The article describes how GLeMM is created using Wiktionary articles and presents various case studies illustrating possible applications of the resource.

AI.tldr: GLeMM是一个基于维基词典构建的大规模派生形态学资源，涵盖7种欧洲语言，支持形态学变体机制的实验和数据驱动研究。
AI.motivation: 派生形态学中形式-意义关系的变异机制研究长期依赖直觉和小规模数据，缺乏可复制性和可泛化性。
AI.method: 利用维基词典文章全自动构建；跨语言统一设计；自动标注形态特征和语义描述。
AI.result: 创建了涵盖德语、英语、西班牙语、法语、意大利语、波兰语、俄语7种语言的大规模派生形态学资源，支持派生词结构识别和计算方法开发。
AI.conclusion: GLeMM为形态学变体机制研究提供了可复制的实证基础，可用于探索形式与语义在词派生中的作用。

title: Clustering-Enhanced Domain Adaptation for Cross-Domain Intrusion Detection in Industrial Control Systems
summary: Industrial control systems operate in dynamic environments where traffic distributions vary across scenarios, labeled samples are limited, and unknown attacks frequently emerge, posing significant challenges to cross-domain intrusion detection. To address this issue, this paper proposes a clustering-enhanced domain adaptation method for industrial control traffic. The framework contains two key components. First, a feature-based transfer learning module projects source and target domains into a shared latent subspace through spectral-transform-based feature alignment and iteratively reduces distribution discrepancies, enabling accurate cross-domain detection. Second, a clustering enhancement strategy combines K-Medoids clustering with PCA-based dimensionality reduction to improve cross-domain correlation estimation and reduce performance degradation caused by manual parameter tuning. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly improves unknown attack detection. Compared with five baseline models, it increases detection accuracy by up to 49%, achieves larger gains in F-score, and demonstrates stronger stability. Moreover, the clustering enhancement strategy further boosts detection accuracy by up to 26% on representative tasks. These results suggest that the proposed method effectively alleviates data scarcity and domain shift, providing a practical solution for robust cross-domain intrusion detection in dynamic industrial environments.

AI.tldr: 针对工业控制系统在动态环境下面临的跨域入侵检测挑战，本文提出一种聚类增强的域适应方法。该方法通过基于谱变换的特征对齐和K-Medoids聚类结合PCA降维，显著提升了对未知攻击的检测能力，在检测准确率上最高提升49%，聚类增强策略额外提升26%。
AI.motivation: 工业控制系统运行在动态环境中，流量分布随场景变化，标注样本有限，未知攻击频繁出现，传统方法难以有效应对跨域入侵检测问题。
AI.method: 提出聚类增强的域适应方法，包含两个核心组件：1）基于谱变换的迁移学习模块，将源域和目标域投影到共享潜在子空间，通过迭代减少分布差异；2）聚类增强策略，结合K-Medoids聚类与PCA降维，提升跨域相关性估计并减少人工参数调优带来的性能下降。
AI.result: 实验表明：相比五种基线模型，检测准确率最高提升49%，F-score提升显著，稳定性更强；聚类增强策略在代表性任务上额外提升检测准确率最高26%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效缓解了数据稀缺和域偏移问题，为动态工业环境下的鲁棒跨域入侵检测提供了实用解决方案。

title: ReflectCAP: Detailed Image Captioning with Reflective Memory
summary: Detailed image captioning demands both factual grounding and fine-grained coverage, yet existing methods have struggled to achieve them simultaneously. We address this tension with Reflective Note-Guided Captioning (ReflectCAP), where a multi-agent pipeline analyzes what the target large vision-language model (LVLM) consistently hallucinates and what it systematically overlooks, distilling these patterns into reusable guidelines called Structured Reflection Notes. At inference time, these notes steer the captioning model along both axes -- what to avoid and what to attend to -- yielding detailed captions that jointly improve factuality and coverage. Applying this method to 8 LVLMs spanning the GPT-4.1 family, Qwen series, and InternVL variants, ReflectCAP reaches the Pareto frontier of the trade-off between factuality and coverage, and delivers substantial gains on CapArena-Auto, where generated captions are judged head-to-head against strong reference models. Moreover, ReflectCAP offers a more favorable trade-off between caption quality and compute cost than model scaling or existing multi-agent pipelines, which incur 21--36\% greater overhead. This makes high-quality detailed captioning viable under real-world cost and latency constraints.

AI.tldr: ReflectCAP通过多智能体管道分析目标LVLM的幻觉模式和遗漏内容，生成结构化反思笔记来引导图像描述，在8个模型上实现事实性与覆盖率的帕累托最优权衡，且计算开销比模型扩展或现有多智能体管道低21-36%。
AI.motivation: 现有图像描述方法在事实基础（factual grounding）和细粒度覆盖（fine-grained coverage）之间存在张力，难以同时优化。模型扩展和多智能体管道虽然能提升质量，但计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出ReflectCAP方法：(1) 使用多智能体管道分析目标大视觉-语言模型(LVLM)的系统性幻觉模式和遗漏内容；(2) 将这些模式提炼为可复用的结构化反思笔记(Structured Reflection Notes)；(3) 推理时利用笔记引导模型同时避免错误和关注遗漏区域。
AI.result: 在8个LVLM（涵盖GPT-4.1系列、Qwen系列、InternVL变体）上实验，ReflectCAP达到事实性与覆盖率的帕累托最优边界；在CapArena-Auto基准上，生成描述被判定优于强参考模型。
AI.conclusion: ReflectCAP提供了描述质量与计算成本之间更优的权衡，相比模型扩展或现有多智能体管道可节省21-36%的计算开销，使高质量详细图像描述在真实成本和延迟约束下变得可行。

title: Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) face significant challenges in processing long contexts due to the linear growth of the key-value (KV) cache and quadratic complexity of self-attention. Existing approaches address these bottlenecks separately: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) reduces the KV cache by projecting tokens into a low-dimensional latent space, while sparse attention reduces computation. However, sparse methods cannot operate natively on MLA's compressed latent structure, missing opportunities for joint optimization. In this paper, we propose Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA), which directly condenses context within MLA's latent space, where the representation is disentangled into semantic latent vectors and positional keys. LCA separately aggregates semantic vectors via query-aware pooling and preserves positional keys via anchor selection. This approach jointly reduces both computational cost and KV cache without adding parameters. Beyond MLA, LCA's design is architecture-agnostic and readily extends to other attention mechanisms such as GQA. Theoretically, we prove a length-independent error bound. Experiments show LCA achieves up to 2.5$\times$ prefilling speedup and 90% KV cache reduction at 128K context while maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA)，一种在MLA潜在空间内直接压缩上下文的方法，通过将表示解耦为语义潜在向量和位置键，分别通过查询感知池化和锚点选择进行聚合，从而在无额外参数的情况下联合降低计算成本和KV缓存。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在处理长上下文时面临两大瓶颈：KV缓存的线性增长和自注意力的二次复杂度。现有方法分别解决这些问题：Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)通过将token投影到低维潜在空间来减少KV缓存，而稀疏注意力则减少计算量。然而，稀疏方法无法原生作用于MLA的压缩潜在结构，错失了联合优化的机会。
AI.method: LCA在MLA的潜在空间内直接压缩上下文，将表示解耦为语义潜在向量和位置键。语义向量通过查询感知池化（query-aware pooling）进行聚合，位置键通过锚点选择（anchor selection）进行保留。该方法可扩展至GQA等其他注意力机制。
AI.result: LCA在128K上下文下实现最高2.5倍预填充加速和90%的KV缓存减少，同时保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: LCA提供了一种架构无关的解决方案，能够在不增加参数的情况下联合优化计算成本和KV缓存，为长上下文处理提供了高效的途径。理论分析证明了与长度无关的误差边界。

title: Preventing Safety Drift in Large Language Models via Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains highly fragile during fine-tuning, where even benign adaptation can degrade pre-trained refusal behaviors and enable harmful responses. Existing defenses typically constrain either weights or activations in isolation, without considering their coupled effects on safety. In this paper, we first theoretically demonstrate that constraining either weights or activations alone is insufficient for safety preservation. To robustly preserve safety alignment, we propose Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints (CWAC), a novel approach that simultaneously enforces a precomputed safety subspace on weight updates and applies targeted regularization to safety-critical features identified by sparse autoencoders. Extensive experiments across four widely used LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that CWAC consistently achieves the lowest harmful scores with minimal impact on fine-tuning accuracy, substantially outperforming strong baselines even under high harmful data ratios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CWAC方法，通过同时约束权重更新到预计算的安全子空间并使用稀疏自编码器正则化安全关键特征，解决大语言模型微调过程中安全对齐退化的问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型微调时，即使是对良性任务的适应也会破坏预训练的拒绝行为，导致有害响应。现有防御方法仅孤立约束权重或激活，未考虑二者的耦合效应，无法充分保护安全对齐。
AI.method: 1) 理论证明单独约束权重或激活均不足以保护安全；2) 提出CWAC方法，同时对权重更新施加预计算安全子空间约束，并对稀疏自编码器识别的安全关键特征进行定向正则化。
AI.result: 在四个主流LLM和多种下游任务上的广泛实验表明，CWAC始终以最低有害评分和最小微调精度影响实现最优安全保护，在高有害数据比例下也显著优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 权重与激活的协同约束是保持LLM微调安全对齐的必要条件，CWAC通过耦合约束机制为安全微调提供了有效且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Mining Large Language Models for Low-Resource Language Data: Comparing Elicitation Strategies for Hausa and Fongbe
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; to appear in LREC-COLING 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on data contributed by low-resource language communities, yet the linguistic knowledge encoded in these models remains accessible only through commercial APIs. This paper investigates whether strategic prompting can extract usable text data from LLMs for two West African languages: Hausa (Afroasiatic, approximately 80 million speakers) and Fongbe (Niger-Congo, approximately 2 million speakers). We systematically compare six elicitation task types across two commercial LLMs (GPT-4o Mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash). GPT-4o Mini extracts 6-41 times more usable target-language words per API call than Gemini. Optimal strategies differ by language: Hausa benefits from functional text and dialogue, while Fongbe requires constrained generation prompts. We release all generated corpora and code.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了通过精心设计的提示策略从商业LLM中提取低资源语言（Hausa和Fongbe）文本数据的可行性，发现GPT-4o Mini优于Gemini，且最优提示策略因目标语言特性不同而存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言社区为LLM训练贡献了数据，但这些语言社区却无法通过商业API获取模型中编码的语言知识。研究旨在探索如何通过策略性提示从LLM中提取可用的目标语言文本数据。
AI.method: 使用六种不同的诱发任务类型对两种商业LLM（GPT-4o Mini和Gemini 2.5 Flash）进行系统比较，评估其提取Hausa语（阿非罗-亚细亚语系，约8000万使用者）和Fongbe语（尼日尔-刚果语系，约200万使用者）文本数据的能力。
AI.result: GPT-4o Mini每次API调用提取的目标语言词汇量是Gemini的6-41倍；最优策略因语言而异：Hausa语受益于功能性文本和对话类提示，而Fongbe语需要约束性生成提示。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明通过策略性提示设计可从商业LLM中提取低资源语言文本数据，且最优策略因语言而异。研究还公开了生成语料库和代码，为低资源语言NLP研究提供了新途径。

title: Heuristic Classification of Thoughts Prompting (HCoT): Integrating Expert System Heuristics for Structured Reasoning into Large Language Models
summary: This paper addresses two limitations of large language models (LLMs) in solving complex problems: (1) their reasoning processes exhibit Bayesian-like stochastic generation, where each token is sampled from a context-dependent probability distribution, leading to inherently random decision trajectories rather than deterministic planning; (2) the reasoning and decision-making mechanisms are statically decoupled, meaning dynamically retrieved domain knowledge fails to dynamically adjust the underlying reasoning strategy. These dual deficiencies result in initial decisions lacking strategic anchoring and reasoning chains often failing to converge on correct solutions, as stochastic generation lacks mechanisms for trajectory correction or knowledge-guided optimization during sequential reasoning. To resolve these issues, we propose a problem-solving method integrated into the LLM's generation process to guide reasoning. This method, compatible with numerous LLMs and featuring reusable solutions, is grounded in a novel Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts prompting schema (HCoT). HCoT synergizes the LLM's reasoning ability with a structured problem space via a heuristic classification model that controls the reasoning process and provides reusable abstract solutions. Evaluated on two complex inductive reasoning tasks with ill-defined search spaces, HCoT outperforms existing approaches (e.g., Tree-of-Thoughts and Chain-of-Thoughts prompting) in performance. On the well-structured 24 Game task, HCoT demonstrates significantly higher token efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art Tree-of-Thoughts-Breadth-First-Search. In terms of both accuracy and token usage, HCoT achieves a Pareto frontier balance, offering a strong trade-off between performance and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HCoT (Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts) 提示框架，通过启发式分类模型引导LLM推理过程，解决其在复杂问题求解中随机生成和静态推理两大缺陷，在24点游戏等复杂归纳推理任务上实现了性能与计算成本的最优权衡。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在解决复杂问题时存在两个关键局限：1) 推理过程呈现类贝叶斯随机生成特性，每个token从上下文相关概率分布中采样，导致决策轨迹本质上是随机的而非确定性规划；2) 推理与决策机制静态解耦，动态检索的领域知识无法动态调整底层推理策略。这导致初始决策缺乏战略锚点，推理链经常无法收敛到正确解，且随机生成缺乏轨迹修正或知识引导的优化机制。
AI.method: 提出一种集成到LLM生成过程中的问题求解方法，基于新颖的HCoT (Heuristic-Classification-of-Thoughts) 提示框架。该框架通过启发式分类模型将LLM的推理能力与结构化问题空间协同，结合分类控制推理过程并提供可复用的抽象解决方案。该方法兼容多种LLM且具有可复用性。
AI.result: 在两个具有模糊搜索空间的复杂归纳推理任务上评估，HCoT优于Tree-of-Thoughts和Chain-of-Thoughts等现有方法。在结构良好的24点游戏任务中，HCoT相比最先进的Tree-of-Thoughts-Breadth-First-Search展现出显著更高的token效率。在准确率和token使用两个维度上，HCoT均达到Pareto前沿平衡。
AI.conclusion: HCoT在性能与计算成本之间实现了Pareto前沿的平衡，提供了准确率和效率之间的良好权衡。该方法可兼容多种LLM并具有可复用性，为增强LLM复杂推理能力提供了有效方案。

title: Meet Dynamic Individual Preferences: Resolving Conflicting Human Value with Paired Fine-Tuning
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved the alignment of models with general human preferences. However, a major challenge remains in adapting LLMs to individual preferences, which are not only diverse but also dynamic. In this paper, we introduce a novel framework, Preference-Paired Fine-Tuning (PFT), designed to align models with contradictory and evolving individual preferences. We present a new dataset, Value Conflict Dilemma (VCD), which includes scenarios that involve conflicting human preferences, facilitating the evaluation of our approach. Our experiments demonstrate that PFT outperforms single-preference training methods, achieving up to 96.6% accuracy in multi-choice classification tasks and the highest open-ended generation score of 8.69. PFT also shows significant improvements over DPO, SFT and some traditional training methods, especially when handling conflicting preferences. Additionally, with limited user history data, models can inferring preference vector rapidly, achieving a 44.76% improvement in user-specific preference alignment in comparison to single-preference models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Preference-Paired Fine-Tuning (PFT) 框架，用于解决大语言模型适应用户动态、多样化甚至相互冲突的个性化偏好问题，并构建了包含冲突偏好场景的 Value Conflict Dilemma (VCD) 数据集。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM虽能对齐一般人类偏好，但在适应个体化、动态化甚至相互冲突的偏好方面仍面临重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出PFT框架和VCD数据集；该框架通过偏好配对方式训练模型处理矛盾偏好。
AI.result: 多选分类任务达到96.6%准确率；开放式生成得分8.69（最高）；相比DPO、SFT等方法显著提升；在有限用户历史数据下，偏好向量推理提升44.76%。
AI.conclusion: PFT在处理冲突偏好方面优于单偏好训练方法，具备快速推断用户偏好向量的能力。

title: MolMem: Memory-Augmented Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Molecular Optimization
summary: In drug discovery, molecular optimization aims to iteratively refine a lead compound to improve molecular properties while preserving structural similarity to the original molecule. However, each oracle evaluation is expensive, making sample efficiency a key challenge for existing methods under a limited oracle budget. Trial-and-error approaches require many oracle calls, while methods that leverage external knowledge tend to reuse familiar templates and struggle on challenging objectives. A key missing piece is long-term memory that can ground decisions and provide reusable insights for future optimizations. To address this, we present MolMem (\textbf{Mol}ecular optimization with \textbf{Mem}ory), a multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework with a dual-memory system. Specifically, MolMem uses Static Exemplar Memory to retrieve relevant exemplars for cold-start grounding, and Evolving Skill Memory to distill successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Built on this memory-augmented formulation, we train the policy with dense step-wise rewards, turning costly rollouts into long-term knowledge that improves future optimization. Extensive experiments show that MolMem achieves 90\% success on single-property tasks (1.5$\times$ over the best baseline) and 52\% on multi-property tasks using only 500 oracle calls. Our code is available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MolMem.

AI.tldr: MolMem是一种多轮智能体强化学习框架，通过双记忆系统（静态范例记忆+进化技能记忆）解决药物分子优化中样本效率低的问题，在仅500次oracle调用的预算下实现了单目标任务90%和多目标任务52%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 药物发现中的分子优化面临关键挑战：每次oracle评估成本高昂，现有方法样本效率低。试错法需要大量oracle调用，而利用外部知识的方法容易陷入熟悉模板，难以应对挑战性目标。核心缺失环节是能够为决策提供基础支撑并为未来优化提供可复用洞察的长期记忆机制。
AI.method: MolMem采用双记忆系统的多轮agentic强化学习框架：(1) 静态范例记忆(Static Exemplar Memory)用于冷启动 grounding，检索相关范例；(2) 进化技能记忆(Evolving Skill Memory)将成功轨迹蒸馏为可复用策略。基于记忆增强 formulation，策略训练采用密集步级奖励，将昂贵的rollout转化为长期知识以改进未来优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，MolMem在单属性优化任务上达到90%成功率（比最佳基线提升1.5倍），多属性任务达52%成功率，且仅需500次oracle调用。
AI.conclusion: 双记忆系统有效解决了分子优化中的样本效率问题，记忆增强的强化学习方法能够将单次优化经验转化为可复用的领域知识，为有限预算下的药物分子优化提供了有效范式。

title: Operationalising the Right to be Forgotten in LLMs: A Lightweight Sequential Unlearning Framework for Privacy-Aligned Deployment in Politically Sensitive Environments
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in politically sensitive environments, where memorisation of personal data or confidential content raises regulatory concerns under frameworks such as the GDPR and its Right to be Forgotten. Translating such legal principles into large-scale generative systems presents significant technical challenges.
  We introduce a lightweight sequential unlearning framework that explicitly separates retention and suppression objectives. The method first stabilises benign capabilities through positive fine-tuning, then applies layer-restricted negative fine-tuning to suppress designated sensitive patterns while preserving general language competence.
  Experiments on the SemEval-2025 LLM Unlearning benchmark demonstrate effective behavioural suppression with minimal impact on factual accuracy and fluency. GPT-2 exhibits greater robustness than DistilGPT-2, highlighting the role of model capacity in privacy-aligned adaptation. We position sequential unlearning as a practical and reproducible mechanism for operationalising data erasure requirements in politically deployed LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级序列式遗忘框架，通过正负微调分离保留与抑制目标，在SemEval-2025基准上验证了有效的行为抑制能力，同时保持事实准确性和语言流畅性，GPT-2表现优于DistilGPT-2。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在政治敏感环境中部署时，对个人数据或机密内容的记忆化引发GDPR等隐私法规的合规担忧，需要技术手段实现"被遗忘权"。
AI.method: 提出轻量级序列式遗忘框架：首先通过正向微调稳定良性能力，然后应用层限制的负向微调抑制指定敏感模式，同时保留通用语言能力。
AI.result: 在SemEval-2025 LLM Unlearning基准上实现有效行为抑制，对事实准确性和流畅性影响最小。GPT-2比DistilGPT-2表现更鲁棒，表明模型容量在隐私对齐适应中的重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 序列式遗忘可作为政治敏感环境中LLM数据擦除要求的一种实用且可复现的技术机制。

title: KG-Reasoner: A Reinforced Model for End-to-End Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong abilities in natural language understanding and generation, yet they struggle with knowledge-intensive reasoning. Structured Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide an effective form of external knowledge representation and have been widely used to enhance performance in classical Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) tasks. However, performing precise multi-hop reasoning over KGs for complex queries remains highly challenging. Most existing approaches decompose the reasoning process into a sequence of isolated steps executed through a fixed pipeline. While effective to some extent, such designs constrain reasoning flexibility and fragment the overall decision process, often leading to incoherence and the loss of critical intermediate information from earlier steps. In this paper, we introduce KG-Reasoner, an end-to-end framework that integrates multi-step reasoning into a unified "thinking" phase of a Reasoning LLM. Through Reinforcement Learning (RL), the LLM is trained to internalize the KG traversal process, enabling it to dynamically explore reasoning paths, and perform backtracking when necessary. Experiments on eight multi-hop and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that KG-Reasoner achieves competitive or superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods. Codes are available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/KG-Reasoner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KG-Reasoner框架，通过强化学习将知识图谱多跳推理能力内化到大型语言模型中，使其能够动态探索推理路径并执行回溯，在8个多跳知识密集型推理基准上达到或超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型在知识密集型推理任务中表现不佳，尽管知识图谱能提供有效的外部知识表示，但现有方法将推理过程分解为固定管道的孤立步骤，导致推理灵活性受限、决策过程碎片化、结果不一致以及早期关键中间信息丢失。
AI.method: 提出KG-Reasoner端到端框架，将多步推理整合到推理型LLM的统一"思考"阶段。通过强化学习(RL)训练LLM内化知识图谱遍历过程，使其能够动态探索推理路径并在必要时执行回溯操作。
AI.result: 在8个多跳和知识密集型推理基准数据集上的实验表明，KG-Reasoner达到了与当前最优方法相当或更优的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将知识图谱遍历能力内化到LLM中，通过RL实现了动态推理路径探索和回溯机制，有效解决了传统固定管道方法的局限性。

title: Socrates Loss: Unifying Confidence Calibration and Classification by Leveraging the Unknown
summary: Deep neural networks, despite their high accuracy, often exhibit poor confidence calibration, limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Current ad-hoc confidence calibration methods attempt to fix this during training but face a fundamental trade-off: two-phase training methods achieve strong classification performance at the cost of training instability and poorer confidence calibration, while single-loss methods are stable but underperform in classification. This paper addresses and mitigates this stability-performance trade-off. We propose Socrates Loss, a novel, unified loss function that explicitly leverages uncertainty by incorporating an auxiliary unknown class, whose predictions directly influence the loss function and a dynamic uncertainty penalty. This unified objective allows the model to be optimized for both classification and confidence calibration simultaneously, without the instability of complex, scheduled losses. We provide theoretical guarantees that our method regularizes the model to prevent miscalibration and overfitting. Across four benchmark datasets and multiple architectures, our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that Socrates Loss consistently improves training stability while achieving more favorable accuracy-calibration trade-off, often converging faster than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Socrates Loss——一种把分类与置信度校准统一到单一损失函数中的即插即用（ad-hoc）方法。其核心做法是在输出层引入一个额外的"unknown（未知）"类别，并让该类别的预测概率通过"动态不确定性惩罚（dynamic uncertainty penalty, β）"直接参与损失计算，同时配合"自适应目标（adaptive target, t）"和 Focal 型调节因子（γ），从而在单阶段训练中同时优化分类精度与校准质量，缓解了现有方法"两阶段训练=精度高但不稳定、单损失=稳定但精度低"的权衡。理论证明其梯度范数不超过交叉熵、且构成 KL 散度的正则化上界；在 CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、Food-101 与 VGG-16/ResNet-34/ResNet-110/ViT（含迁移学习）等设置上，训练更稳定、收敛更快、精度–校准权衡（误差率 vs ECE 的 Pareto 位置）普遍最优或次优。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络常表现出系统性过度自信（overconfidence），预测置信度与真实正确率不匹配，限制其在医疗诊断、核安全、生物安全等高风险场景中的可靠性。现有校准方案分两类：事后（post-hoc）方法（温度缩放、矩阵/向量缩放）需额外标注数据与调参，且无法把校准表示嵌入权重，因而不适用于迁移学习；即插即用（ad-hoc）方法（ Focal Loss、FLSD、Meta-Calibration、Brier、SAT、CCL-SC 等）虽在训练中校准，但存在根本权衡：两阶段（组合损失+调度）方法分类性能强却训练不稳定、ECE 波动甚至校准更差；单损失方法稳定但分类性能不足。此外作者通过分析 SAT 发现"unknown 类平均置信度与 ECE 存在关联"，由此提出核心问题：能否用单一、易实现的损失函数，通过显式建模不确定性（unknown 类）同时获得训练稳定性与良好的校准/分类性能？
AI.method: 将 c 类分类重构为 (c+1) 类问题，新增 unknown 类 idk。损失为：L = -(1/n) Σ (1-p̂_{i,y_i})^γ [ t_{i,y_i,e} log p̂_{i,y_i,e} + β_{i,e} (1-t_{i,y_i,e}) log p̂_{i,idk,e} ]。其中：① Focal 调节因子 γ 下权易分类样本，把梯度聚焦于难样本，抑制 margin 无节制增长；② 自适应目标 t：e≤E_s 时取 one-hot 标签，否则 t = α·t_{e-1} + (1-α)·p̂_{i,y_i,e}（动量因子 α 源自 SAT），融合前后 epoch 预测以稳定收敛（E_s=0）；③ 动态不确定性惩罚 β_{i,e} = max_{ȳ≠y_i} p̂_{i,ȳ,e} - p̂_{i,idk,e} ∈[0,1]，当模型对某错误类的信心高于 unknown 类时惩罚它"未能识别自身不确定性"，β 非超参而是随预测动态变化；④ unknown 类既充当显式不确定性机制，也起正则化作用。理论上：证明当置信度足够高时 ||∂L_Soc/∂w|| ≤ ||∂L_CE/∂w||（权重正则化，防过拟合与失校准）；并利用 Bernoulli 不等式给出 L_Soc ≥ KL(q‖p̂) + H[q] - γH[p̂] + β·Δ_reg，即带最大熵正则项的 KL 上界。评测含 ECE/AdaECE/CW-ECE、可靠性图、跨 epoch 的误差率–ECE Pareto 图、损失曲线。基线：CE、Brier、Focal、FLSD、Meta-Calibration、SAT、CCL-SC 及事后 TS/MS/VS。数据：SVHN、CIFAR-10/100、Food-101；架构：VGG-16、ResNet-34/110、ViT（含 ImageNet-21k 预训练迁移微调）。
AI.result: 1) 训练稳定性：Socrates、Focal、FLSD、CE、Brier 在所有数据集/架构上均正常收敛；SAT 在 Food-101、CCL-SC 与 MC 在 SVHN 出现早停/低精度退化（即使在原作者推荐范围内调参）。SAT 与 CCL-SC 在"切换损失"epoch 出现损失尖峰并伴随 ECE 波动，而 Socrates 的损失与 ECE 曲线平滑。2) 动态权衡：Socrates 的误差率–ECE 轨迹稳定向左下移动，常比竞争方法更早达到更优区域；CE 随 epoch 校准恶化（ECE 上升）；MC 全面落后；Focal/FLSD/CCL-SC 表现震荡；ViT 上 Socrates 是唯一能在训练中期降低 ECE 并防止严重退化的方法。3) 末轮结果（测试集）：CIFAR-10/VGG-16 准确率 88.42 与最佳持平且 ECE 4.39 显著最低；Food-101/ResNet-34 准确率 77.72（次优）而 ECE 0.81 最低；CIFAR-100/VGG-16 ECE 3.45 最低、准确率 71.26 有竞争力；CIFAR-100/ResNet-110 ECE 2.86 最低；CW-ECE 在多数组合下最优。4) 事后校准：TS/MS 主要为纠正过度自信设计，对 Socrates 无益甚至变差（ECE 升至 9–52），仅 VS（按类缩放）多数有效；Socrates 单独使用已优于 CE 及其事后变体。5) 迁移学习（ViT TL）：仅 Socrates 与 CCL-SC 同时改善分类与校准，Socrates 保持稳定趋势；但末轮可靠性图显示 Socrates/CCL-SC 呈欠自信。6) 消融：移除 Focal 项（尤其真值分支中的）、自适应目标或 β 均显著恶化 ECE；γ=0 时校准明显变差；α 偏好 0.999（α=1 退化为受 unknown 影响的 Focal，震荡）；β 的备选形式（固定 0.25、无 β）导致校准误差随 epoch 上升并放大。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，显式借助 unknown 类并将它的预测直接写入损失（配合动态不确定性惩罚、自适应目标与 Focal 调节），可以用单一损失函数同时优化分类与置信度校准，规避两阶段调度带来的训练不稳定，在多种数据集与架构上取得更优的精度–校准 Pareto 权衡、更好的训练稳定性与更快的收敛，且不牺牲精度。其理论保证（梯度正则化与 KL 正则上界）解释了防过拟合与防失校准的机理。局限与后续方向：ViT 上仍观察到训练不稳定（与注意力机制的交互待研究）；仅验证同分布校准，对分布偏移/OOD 鲁棒性未验证；动态不确定性惩罚 β 有望作为独立的校准正则项用于 OOD 检测或选择性分类；可进一步研究更长训练下的迁移学习表现。

title: Enhancing Clustering: An Explainable Approach via Filtered Patterns
summary: Machine learning has become a central research area, with increasing attention devoted to explainable clustering, also known as conceptual clustering, which is a knowledge-driven unsupervised learning paradigm that partitions data into $θ$ disjoint clusters, where each cluster is described by an explicit symbolic representation, typically expressed as a closed pattern or itemset. By providing human-interpretable cluster descriptions, explainable clustering plays an important role in explainable artificial intelligence and knowledge discovery. Recent work improved clustering quality by introducing k-relaxed frequent patterns (k-RFPs), a pattern model that relaxes strict coverage constraints through a generalized kcover definition. This framework integrates constraint-based reasoning, using SAT solvers for pattern generation, with combinatorial optimization, using Integer Linear Programming (ILP) for cluster selection. Despite its effectiveness, this approach suffers from a critical limitation: multiple distinct k-RFPs may induce identical k-covers, leading to redundant symbolic representations that unnecessarily enlarge the search space and increase computational complexity during cluster construction. In this paper, we address this redundancy through a pattern reduction framework. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formally characterize the conditions under which distinct k-RFPs induce identical kcovers, providing theoretical foundations for redundancy detection. Second, we propose an optimization strategy that removes redundant patterns by retaining a single representative pattern for each distinct k-cover. Third, we investigate the interpretability and representativeness of the patterns selected by the ILP model by analyzing their robustness with respect to their induced clusters. Extensive experiments conducted on several real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly reduces the pattern search space, improves computational efficiency, preserves and enhances in some cases the quality of the resulting clusters.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可解释聚类中k-松弛频繁模式(k-RFPs)产生的冗余问题，提出了一种模式约简框架，通过识别并消除诱导相同k-覆盖的冗余模式来提高计算效率，同时保持或提升聚类质量。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释聚类方法使用k-RFPs生成人类可解释的聚类描述，但存在关键限制：多个不同的k-RFPs可能诱导相同的k-覆盖，导致冗余的符号表示，不必要地扩大搜索空间并增加计算复杂度。
AI.method: 提出三方面贡献：(1) 形式化描述不同k-RFPs诱导相同k-覆盖的条件，为冗余检测提供理论基础；(2) 提出优化策略，对每个不同的k-覆盖仅保留一个代表模式以移除冗余模式；(3) 分析ILP模型所选模式关于其诱导聚类的鲁棒性，探究其可解释性和代表性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法显著减小了模式搜索空间，提高了计算效率，同时保持并在某些情况下提升了聚类质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过模式约简框架有效解决了k-RFPs冗余问题，验证了其在多个真实数据集上的有效性。

title: Calibrated Confidence Estimation for Tabular Question Answering
comment: 27 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables (8-page main body + appendix)
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for tabular question
  answering, yet calibration on structured data is largely unstudied. This
  paper presents the first systematic comparison of five confidence estimation
  methods across five frontier LLMs and two tabular QA benchmarks. All models
  are severely overconfident (smooth ECE 0.35-0.64 versus 0.10-0.15 reported
  for textual QA). A consistent self-evaluation versus perturbation dichotomy
  replicates across both benchmarks and all four fully-covered models:
  self-evaluation methods (verbalized, P(True)) achieve AUROC 0.42-0.76, while
  perturbation methods (semantic entropy, self-consistency, and our
  Multi-Format Agreement) achieve AUROC 0.78-0.86. Per-model paired bootstrap
  tests reject the null at p<0.001 after Holm-Bonferroni correction, and a
  3-seed check on GPT-4o-mini gives a per-seed standard deviation of only
  0.006. The paper proposes Multi-Format Agreement (MFA), which exploits the
  lossless and deterministic serialization variation unique to structured data
  (Markdown, HTML, JSON, CSV) to estimate confidence at 20% lower API cost
  than sampling baselines. MFA reduces ECE by 44-63%, generalizes across all
  four models on TableBench (mean AUROC 0.80), and combines complementarily
  with sampling: an MFA + self-consistency ensemble lifts AUROC from 0.74 to
  0.82. A secondary contribution, structure-aware recalibration, improves
  AUROC by +10 percentage points over standard post-hoc methods.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对表格问答（Tabular QA）场景下的LLM置信度估计（calibration）做了系统性研究：在2个基准（WikiTableQuestions、TableBench）、5个前沿LLM、5种置信度方法上全面比较，发现所有模型严重过度自信（smooth ECE 0.35–0.64，远高于文本QA的0.10–0.15），并确立了一个稳健的「自评估 vs. 扰动」二分现象：自评估方法（verbalized、P(True)）AUROC仅0.42–0.76，而扰动方法（语义熵、自一致性、以及本文提出的多格式一致性MFA）AUROC达0.78–0.86。核心贡献是提出MFA（Multi-Format Agreement）：利用结构化数据天然存在的无损、确定性序列化变体（Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV）来估计置信度，仅需4次API调用（比采样基线省20%成本），可降低44–63%的ECE，并与采样方法互补（三路集成把AUROC从0.74提升到0.82）；次要贡献是引入表结构协变量的结构感知重校准，在AUROC上比标准后验校准提升约10个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM 正被大量部署到表格问答任务（金融分析、商业智能、数据探索），但「模型自报的置信度是否反映真实正确概率」这一基础可靠性问题在结构化数据上几乎无人研究：校准社区的数百篇论文几乎全部基于文本QA/常识/生物医学，表格QA社区则只报准确率而不做校准分析；text-to-SQL置信度研究与表格QA校准研究也基本割裂。此外，表格任务引入了文本QA没有的不确定性来源：schema链接歧义、聚合错误（SUM/COUNT混淆）、数值精度与单位换算、缺失值静默错误，以及序列化格式敏感性（同一张表以Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV呈现会得到不同答案）。已有工作（Sui et al. 2024; Singha et al. 2023）只关注「哪种格式最好」，从未把格式间的不一致当作置信度信号。本文的动机是：若答案随表格呈现方式改变，说明模型在做表层token的模式匹配而非对表结构的推理，此时答案不应被信任；格式敏感性本身可以转化为可利用的不确定性信号。
AI.method: 实验设计：在 WikiTableQuestions（n=2000 验证集）与 TableBench（n=836 非Visualization样例）两个基准上，评测 5 个前沿模型（GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Llama-3.3-70B、DeepSeek-V3）× 5 种置信度 elicitation 方法：① verbalized（1次调用，结构化JSON输出答案+0–100置信度）；② P(True)（2次调用，两轮自问「你的答案正确吗」）；③ self-consistency（N=5, τ=0.7，majority 一致率）；④ semantic entropy（N=5, τ=0.7，按归一化后精确匹配聚类而非NLI，c=1−H/log₂N）；⑤ MFA（K=4 种格式、τ=0，一致率 c_MFA=|{k:a_k=a_maj}|/K）。MFA 的三个性质：无损（格式切换保留100%语义内容）、确定性（无需LLM生成扰动，可完全复现）、天然可得（表格存在规范化的其他表示）。评价指标以 smooth ECE 为主（具一致性保证），另报分箱ECE(B=10/15/20)、Brier、AUROC（选择性预测），并配对 bootstrap（10K重采样）+ Holm-Bonferroni 校正做显著性检验，3随机种子（42/123/456）验证采样方差。答案评测采用「先严格后模糊」三级流水线（类型感知数值比较含1%相对容差→模糊数值抽取→词边界包含），并做严格匹配敏感性分析。另提出结构感知重校准：在 Platt scaling 上扩展结构协变量 x=[log行数, log列数, 列类型分布, 查询复杂度(词数/操作关键词), 答案类型]，即 P(correct|c,x)=σ(wᵀ[c;x]+b)，并做特征组消融与系数重要性分析。
AI.result: 1) 严重过度自信：WTQ上verbalized平均置信度88.9%–99.5%，准确率仅65.5%–76.2%，过度自信缺口23–30个百分点，smECE 0.35–0.64、ECE10 0.234–0.302（比文本QA的~0.10–0.15差1.5–3倍）；准确率最高的GPT-4o置信度几乎恒为99.5%，AUROC仅0.522（近乎随机）。2) 自评估 vs. 扰动二分在两个基准、四个全覆盖模型上均复现：自评估簇AUROC 0.42–0.76（均值0.62），扰动簇0.78–0.86（均值0.81）；best-vs-best配对bootstrap在每个模型上p_Holm<0.001（ΔAUROC +0.058至+0.177），更强的worst-vs-best检验在3/4模型显著（Gemini p=0.023；GPT-4o-mini p=0.189不显著），3种子AUROC标准差仅±0.006（约为二分差距的1/30）。Gemini的P(True)在TableBench上甚至低于随机（AUROC 0.423, CI[0.407,0.438]），显示自评估会主动误导。3) MFA效果：相对verbalized降低ECE 45–63%（WTQ）并提升准确率1–9个百分点，AUROC从0.522→0.782（GPT-4o）、0.523→0.737（Llama）、0.664→0.735（GPT-4o-mini）；在更难的TableBench上四模型均值AUROC 0.80，ECE降低41–57%，与SC/SE统计等效（Llama上Δ=−0.012/−0.011，p=0.78/0.75）但少20% API调用；K=3已能捕获大部分收益（Llama AUROC 0.716 vs K=4的0.737，成本再降25%），K=2明显退化（0.671）；结构最异质的HTML+JSON+CSV子集在3/4模型上点估计最佳但差异不显著（p_Holm=0.09）。4) 校准与判别正交：温度缩放/Platt/isotonic把ECE从0.315降到<0.05但AUROC恒为0.518（单调变换保序），结构感知重校准提升到0.619（+10pp），消融显示表维度单独0.588、查询复杂度单独0.596、全特征0.619，重要性最高的是操作关键词与log行数（系数为负）。5) 互补性：MFA+SC+SE三路集成在Llama上AUROC 0.819（vs SC 0.742、MFA 0.728，+0.077），跨5次随机划分权重稳定；CISC式MFA+P(True)组合在三个模型上均带来+0.007~+0.013的小幅提升，说明P(True)单独不可用但含互补信息。6) 机制分析：4种格式全一致时准确率>85%，少于3种一致时降至<40%；MFA在各问题类型上普遍提升（时序+0.245、最值+0.230）；严格匹配下结论不变（verbalized AUROC 0.522，MFA 0.745）。
AI.conclusion: 四点结论：(1) LLM在表格QA上普遍严重过度自信（smECE 0.35–0.64），远超文本QA基线；(2) 存在稳健的「自评估 vs. 扰动」二分现象，首次在表格域系统记录，与数学推理、SQL生成上的已有发现一致，且经bootstrap检验与多种子检验证实；(3) MFA作为输入扰动方法，在低20%成本下匹配最佳采样基线，在两个基准上跨模型泛化，并与采样信号正交互补（集成把AUROC从0.74提升到0.82）；(4) 校准与判别是正交的两件事——标准后验重校准只修校准不改判别，只有引入表结构协变量的结构感知重校准才能同时改善判别。实践建议：不要在表格QA中使用verbalized confidence与P(True)做选择性预测/弃答，应使用输入或输出扰动，其中MFA对结构化数据最具成本效益且唯一确定性。局限：仅两个基准（WTQ可能存在训练数据污染，故过度自信结论偏保守；TableBench提供部分缓解）、DeepSeek-V3部分单元与GPT-4o部分实验因额度缺失未完成（GPT-4o的MFA在WTQ仅n=500）、模型均为2024年中期版本、MFA需K次调用。未来方向：将共形预测（conformal prediction）用于MFA以获得选择性表格QA的形式化覆盖率保证；将MFA与语义熵/自一致性整合；用于在SQL/Python/直接推理间做工具路由；并把「无损扰动」原则推广到知识图谱、代码、化学式等其他存在规范替代表示的结构化领域。

title: CIA: Inferring the Communication Topology from LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks. Central to MAS is the communication topology which governs how agents exchange information internally. Consequently, the security of communication topologies has attracted increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate a critical privacy risk: MAS communication topologies can be inferred under a restrictive black-box setting, exposing system vulnerabilities and posing significant intellectual property threats. To explore this risk, we propose Communication Inference Attack (CIA), a novel attack that constructs new adversarial queries to induce intermediate agents' reasoning outputs and models their semantic correlations through the proposed global bias disentanglement and LLM-guided weak supervision. Extensive experiments on MAS with optimized communication topologies demonstrate the effectiveness of CIA, achieving an average AUC of 0.87 and a peak AUC of up to 0.99, thereby revealing the substantial privacy risk in MAS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对大语言模型多智能体系统（MAS）的通信拓扑推理攻击方法CIA，在黑盒设置下可有效推断系统内部通信结构，平均AUC达0.87，峰值0.99，揭示了MAS的重大隐私风险。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统的通信拓扑决定智能体间信息交换方式，其安全性至关重要。然而，现有研究尚未充分揭示通信拓扑在黑盒设置下被推断的风险，这不仅暴露系统漏洞，还对知识产权构成重大威胁。
AI.method: 提出通信推理攻击（CIA）方法：1）构造对抗性查询以诱导中间智能体的推理输出；2）通过全局偏置解耦（global bias disentanglement）建模语义相关性；3）利用LLM引导的弱监督（LLM-guided weak supervision）增强攻击效果。
AI.result: 在具有优化通信拓扑的MAS上进行实验，CIA平均AUC达到0.87，峰值高达0.99，表明该攻击方法可有效推断系统通信拓扑，具有很高的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证实了多智能体系统存在重大隐私风险，通信拓扑在黑盒设置下可被可靠推断，提示需要加强MAS的安全防护机制以保护系统架构和知识产权。

title: Latent Planning Emerges with Scale
summary: LLMs can perform seemingly planning-intensive tasks, like writing coherent stories or functioning code, without explicitly verbalizing a plan; however, the extent to which they implicitly plan is unknown. In this paper, we define latent planning as occurring when LLMs possess internal planning representations that (1) cause the generation of a specific future token or concept, and (2) shape preceding context to license said future token or concept. We study the Qwen-3 family (0.6B-14B) on simple planning tasks, finding that latent planning ability increases with scale. Models that plan possess features that represent a planned-for word like "accountant", and cause them to output "an" rather than "a"; moreover, even the less-successful Qwen-3 4B-8B have nascent planning mechanisms. On the more complex task of completing rhyming couplets, we find that models often identify a rhyme ahead of time, but even large models seldom plan far ahead. However, we can elicit some planning that increases with scale when steering models towards planned words in prose. In sum, we offer a framework for measuring planning and mechanistic evidence of how models' planning abilities grow with scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）是否具有隐式规划能力，通过定义"潜在规划"（latent planning）概念，测试Qwen-3系列模型（0.6B-14B），发现规划能力随模型规模增长而提升。
AI.motivation: LLM能够完成看似需要规划的任务（如写故事、写代码），但它们是否真正进行内部规划尚不清楚。理解这一能力对于揭示LLM的认知机制至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 定义"潜在规划"：模型拥有内部规划表征，该表征(1)导致生成特定未来token/概念，(2)塑造前置上下文以支持该生成；2) 使用简单规划任务和押韵对联补全任务测试Qwen-3系列模型；3) 采用机制性分析（mechanistic analysis）探究模型内部表征。
AI.result: 1) 规划能力随模型规模增加而提升；2) 具有规划能力的模型拥有代表规划目标词（如"accountant"）的特征，并导致输出"an"而非"a"；3) 4B-8B规模的Qwen-3模型已具备初步规划机制；4) 在押韵任务中，模型常提前识别韵脚，但即使大模型也较少进行远期规划；5) 引导模型向规划词靠近时可激发一定程度的规划能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了测量LLM规划能力的框架，并从机制层面证明模型的规划能力随规模增长而发展。隐式规划是LLM的重要能力，但即使是大型模型，远期规划能力仍然有限。

title: RoleMAG: Learning Neighbor Roles in Multimodal Graphs
summary: Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs) combine multimodal node attributes with structured relations. However, existing methods usually perform shared message passing on a single graph and implicitly assume that the same neighbors are equally useful for all modalities. In practice, neighbors that benefit one modality may interfere with another, blurring modality-specific signals under shared propagation. To address this issue, we propose RoleMAG, a multimodal graph framework that learns how different neighbors should participate in propagation. Concretely, RoleMAG distinguishes whether a neighbor should provide shared, complementary, or heterophilous signals, and routes them through separate propagation channels. This enables cross-modal completion from complementary neighbors while keeping heterophilous ones out of shared smoothing. Extensive experiments on three graph-centric MAG benchmarks show that RoleMAG achieves the best results on RedditS and Bili\_Dance, while remaining competitive on Toys. Ablation, robustness, and efficiency analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed role-aware propagation design. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RoleMAG-7EE0/

AI.tldr: RoleMAG是一个多模态图框架，通过将邻居节点区分为共享、互补或异配信号，并使用独立传播通道进行路由，从而解决传统方法中邻居对不同模态贡献不一致的问题。在三个基准数据集上取得了最佳或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态属性图方法通常在单一图上进行共享消息传递，隐式假设同一邻居对所有模态同等有用。然而实践中，一个模态有益的邻居可能对另一模态产生干扰，在共享传播中模糊化模态特定信号。
AI.method: RoleMAG将邻居区分为三种角色（共享信号、互补信号、异配信号），并通过独立传播通道进行路由。这使得来自互补邻居的跨模态补全成为可能，同时将异配邻居排除在共享平滑之外。
AI.result: 在三个以图为中心的MAG基准数据集上，RoleMAG在RedditS和Bili_Dance上取得最佳结果，在Toys上保持竞争力。消融、鲁棒性和效率分析进一步验证了角色感知传播设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RoleMAG通过角色感知传播设计有效解决了多模态图中邻居贡献不一致的问题，实验结果证明了该方法的有效性和实用性。

title: Intelligent ROI-Based Vehicle Counting Framework for Automated Traffic Monitoring
summary: Accurate vehicle counting through video surveillance is crucial for efficient traffic management. However, achieving high counting accuracy while ensuring computational efficiency remains a challenge. To address this, we propose a fully automated, video-based vehicle counting framework designed to optimize both computational efficiency and counting accuracy. Our framework operates in two distinct phases: \textit{estimation} and \textit{prediction}. In the estimation phase, the optimal region of interest (ROI) is automatically determined using a novel combination of three models based on detection scores, tracking scores, and vehicle density. This adaptive approach ensures compatibility with any detection and tracking method, enhancing the framework's versatility. In the prediction phase, vehicle counting is efficiently performed within the estimated ROI. We evaluated our framework on benchmark datasets like UA-DETRAC, GRAM, CDnet 2014, and ATON. Results demonstrate exceptional accuracy, with most videos achieving 100\% accuracy, while also enhancing computational efficiency, making processing up to four times faster than full-frame processing. The framework outperforms existing techniques, especially in complex multi-road scenarios, demonstrating robustness and superior accuracy. These advancements make it a promising solution for real-time traffic monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双阶段视频车辆计数框架，通过自动确定最优感兴趣区域(ROI)来平衡计算效率与计数精度，在多个基准数据集上达到接近100%的准确率，同时处理速度提升4倍。
AI.motivation: 视频监控中的车辆计数需在精度与计算效率间取得平衡。传统全帧处理方法计算开销大，而现有 ROI 提取方法多为手动设置，缺乏自适应性和通用性。
AI.method: 框架包含两阶段：估计阶段利用检测分数、跟踪分数和车辆密度的三模型组合自动确定最优ROI；预测阶段在估计的ROI内执行车辆计数。该方法兼容任意检测和跟踪方法。
AI.result: 在UA-DETRAC、GRAM、CDnet 2014和ATON等基准数据集上验证，大部分视频达到100%准确率，处理速度较全帧处理提升4倍，在复杂多道路场景中表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在精度和效率上均优于现有技术，为实时交通监控提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Topology-Aware Reasoning over Incomplete Knowledge Graph with Graph-Based Soft Prompting
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across various tasks but remain prone to hallucinations in knowledge-intensive scenarios. Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) mitigates this by grounding generation in Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, most multi-hop KBQA methods rely on explicit edge traversal, making them fragile to KG incompleteness. In this paper, we proposed a novel graph-based soft prompting framework that shifts the reasoning paradigm from node-level path traversal to subgraph-level reasoning. Specifically, we employ a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to encode extracted structural subgraphs into soft prompts, enabling LLM to reason over richer structural context and identify relevant entities beyond immediate graph neighbors, thereby reducing sensitivity to missing edges. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage paradigm that reduces computational cost while preserving good performance: a lightweight LLM first leverages the soft prompts to identify question-relevant entities and relations, followed by a more powerful LLM for evidence-aware answer generation. Experiments on four multi-hop KBQA benchmarks show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on three of them, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/GraSP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GraSP框架，通过GNN将知识图谱子图编码为软提示，使LLM能够进行子图级推理而非节点级路径遍历，从而降低对缺失边的敏感性。同时引入两阶段范式（轻量LLM识别实体关系+强大LLM生成答案）以平衡性能与计算成本。在4个多跳KBQA基准上取得3项SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM在知识密集型任务中容易产生幻觉；现有KBQA方法依赖显式边遍历，对知识图谱不完整性敏感，推理能力脆弱
AI.method: 1) GNN编码提取的结构子图为软提示；2) 子图级推理替代节点级路径遍历；3) 两阶段范式：轻量LLM识别相关实体关系→强大LLM生成答案
AI.result: 在4个多跳KBQA基准测试中，3个取得最优性能
AI.conclusion: 子图级软提示推理有效降低了对KG缺失边的敏感性，两阶段范式在保持性能的同时降低了计算开销

title: SubFlow: Sub-mode Conditioned Flow Matching for Diverse One-Step Generation
summary: Flow matching has emerged as a powerful generative framework, with recent few-step methods achieving remarkable inference acceleration. However, we identify a critical yet overlooked limitation: these models suffer from severe diversity degradation, concentrating samples on dominant modes while neglecting rare but valid variations of the target distribution. We trace this degradation to averaging distortion: when trained with MSE objectives, class-conditional flows learn a frequency-weighted mean over intra-class sub-modes, causing the model to over-represent high-density modes while systematically neglecting low-density ones. To address this, we propose SubFlow, Sub-mode Conditioned Flow Matching, which eliminates averaging distortion by decomposing each class into fine-grained sub-modes via semantic clustering and conditioning the flow on sub-mode indices. Each conditioned sub-distribution is approximately unimodal, so the learned flow accurately targets individual modes with no averaging distortion, restoring full mode coverage in a single inference step. Crucially, SubFlow is entirely plug-and-play: it integrates seamlessly into existing one-step models such as MeanFlow and Shortcut Models without any architectural modifications. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-256 demonstrate that SubFlow yields substantial gains in generation diversity (Recall) while maintaining competitive image quality (FID), confirming its broad applicability across different one-step generation frameworks. Project page: https://yexionglin.github.io/subflow.

AI.tldr: SubFlow通过语义聚类将每个类别分解为细粒度子模式，并对子模式进行条件化训练，从根本上消除了流匹配中的平均失真问题。这种即插即用的方法可以在不修改现有架构的情况下，显著提升ImageNet-256上的生成多样性，同时保持图像质量。
AI.motivation: 现有少步生成模型存在严重的多样性退化问题，样本集中在主导模式，忽略了目标分布中稀有但有效的变体。论文将这一问题根源追溯为"平均失真"：使用MSE目标训练的类别条件流学习的是类内子模式上的频率加权均值，导致模型过度代表高密度模式而系统性忽略低密度模式。
AI.method: 提出SubFlow（子模式条件化流匹配），通过语义聚类将每个类别分解为细粒度子模式，并使用子模式索引对流进行条件化。每个条件化的子分布近似单峰，因此学习的流能准确瞄准各个模式而不产生平均失真，在单步推理中恢复完整的模式覆盖。SubFlow完全即插即用，可无缝集成到现有单步模型中（如MeanFlow和Shortcut Models）而无需任何架构修改。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256上的广泛实验表明，SubFlow在保持竞争力的图像质量（FID）的同时，在生成多样性（Recall）上取得了实质性提升，验证了其在不同单步生成框架中的广泛适用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除平均失真并恢复完整模式覆盖，SubFlow成功解决了少步生成模型的多样性退化问题，同时保持了图像质量。其即插即用的特性使其能够广泛应用于现有的单步生成框架。

title: Technical Report -- A Context-Sensitive Multi-Level Similarity Framework for First-Order Logic Arguments: An Axiomatic Study
summary: Similarity in formal argumentation has recently gained attention due to its significance in problems such as argument aggregation in semantics and enthymeme decoding. While existing approaches focus on propositional logic, we address the richer setting of First-Order Logic (FOL), where similarity must account for structured content. We introduce a comprehensive framework for FOL argument similarity, built upon: (1) an extended axiomatic foundation; (2) a four-level parametric model covering predicates, literals, clauses, and formulae similarity; (3) two model families, one syntax-sensitive via language models, both integrating contextual weights for nuanced and explainable similarity; and (4) formal constraints enforcing desirable properties.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个针对一阶逻辑(FOL)论点的全面相似性框架，超越现有基于命题逻辑的方法，通过四层参数化模型和语言模型实现结构化内容的相似度计算。
AI.motivation: 形式论证中的相似性研究在论点聚合和省略论证解码等问题中具有重要意义，但现有方法局限于命题逻辑，无法处理一阶逻辑中更丰富的结构化内容。
AI.method: 框架包含四个核心组成部分：(1) 扩展的公理化基础；(2) 四层参数化模型（谓词、字面量、子句、公式层次）；(3) 两个模型族（基于语言模型的语法敏感方法，集成上下文权重）；(4) 约束条件确保期望性质。
AI.result: 建立了一个全面、可解释且具有理论保障的FOL论点相似性度量框架。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为形式论证领域提供了处理一阶逻辑结构化内容相似性的理论基础和实践工具。

title: Beyond Transcription: Unified Audio Schema for Perception-Aware AudioLLMs
summary: Recent Audio Large Language Models (AudioLLMs) exhibit a striking performance inversion: while excelling at complex reasoning tasks, they consistently underperform on fine-grained acoustic perception. We attribute this gap to a fundamental limitation of ASR-centric training, which provides precise linguistic targets but implicitly teaches models to suppress paralinguistic cues and acoustic events as noise. To address this, we propose Unified Audio Schema (UAS), a holistic and structured supervision framework that organizes audio information into three explicit components -- Transcription, Paralinguistics, and Non-linguistic Events -- within a unified JSON format. This design achieves comprehensive acoustic coverage without sacrificing the tight audio-text alignment that enables reasoning. We validate the effectiveness of this supervision strategy by applying it to both discrete and continuous AudioLLM architectures. Extensive experiments on MMSU, MMAR, and MMAU demonstrate that UAS-Audio yields consistent improvements, boosting fine-grained perception by 10.9% on MMSU over the same-size state-of-the-art models while preserving robust reasoning capabilities. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/Tencent/Unified_Audio_Schema.

AI.tldr: 论文针对 AudioLLM「擅长推理却弱于细粒度听觉感知」的能力倒挂现象，指出根因是 ASR 中心化训练范式在提供精确文本监督的同时隐性压制了副语言与非语言声学信息。为此提出统一音频模式（Unified Audio Schema, UAS）：以统一 JSON 结构显式分解「转写 / 副语言 / 非语言事件」三层信息，并构建了可大规模自动合成该标注的三阶段流水线；配套训练出 UAS-Audio（连续架构）与 UAS-Audio-D（离散架构）。实验表明，MMSU 感知子集提升 10.9 个百分点（55.7% vs Kimi-Audio 44.8%）而推理能力基本无损（77.4%），三项基准平均分 65.2% 达 SOTA，且 TTS 生成质量同步提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 AudioLLM 普遍采用以 ASR 转写文本为唯一训练接口的监督范式。ASR 目标为还原规范化文本，会刻意归一化掉韵律、音色、说话人身份、情绪与声学环境，从而在训练中形成「奖励推理 what is said、隐性抑制 how it is said / what else happens」的系统性不对称。这使得感知能力不只是训练不足，而是被结构性去强调：例如 MMSU 上推理任务约 70% 而基础感知仅约 40%，模型可正确转写「I'm fine」却完全忽略颤抖声线所传递的 distress。该现象在不同规模与架构（连续/离散）上持续存在，指向监督方式这一系统性因素而非容量或架构缺陷。此外已有丰富音频描述方案（如 MiDashengLM 的自由形式 caption）会将副语言与语义内容纠缠在一起，难以实现显式解耦。
AI.method: 1）Schema 定义：基于 Laver(1994) 语音信息三层（语言层/副语言层/超语言层）体系，映射为三类字段——Transcription（逐字转写，无语音时置 null）、Paralinguistics（Age/Gender/Emotion/Accent/Prosody/Timbre 六个子字段）、Non-linguistic Events（Description、DiscreteEvents、ContinuousEvents，每个事件带 label 与 characteristic）。其三大优势为：解耦学习（显式子任务、避免特征混淆）、句法不变性（低熵监督目标、稳定优化）、可编程可访问性（严格 JSON 便于下游直接调用）。2）三阶段自动数据流水线：Stage 1 用 AuT caption 模型生成声学描述；Stage 2 用 LLM（Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct）将描述与真值转写合成为结构化 JSON；Stage 3 质量校验，包括闭集本体约束、转写字符串精确匹配、逻辑一致性规则过滤（如空转写→副语言 null、性别与音色矛盾则拒绝）、时长—内容匹配启发式过滤。人工审核 N=400 样本，多数字段准确率 >95%（Emotion 89.0%、Discrete Events 91.75% 最弱）。3）UAS-QA：基于 UAS 标注自动合成 Direct QA、Multiple Choice、Yes/No 三类问答对（Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct），覆盖全部字段。4）UAS-Audio 训练：连续架构以 Qwen2.5-7B 为骨干、AuT 为音频编码器、线性投影对齐，语音解码器采用 flow matching + HiFi-GAN。四阶段流程：Stage 1 离散声学 token 对齐（仅训 embedding 与 LLM head，词表扩展 StableToken 码）；Stage 2 冻结 LLM 与编码器、仅训投影层，且仅用 UAS 数据以避免先形成 ASR 中心表征；Stage 3 全量指令微调（除编码器外全部解冻，数据混合基础 ASR/TTS + UAS 标注 + UAS-QA）；Stage 4 GRPO 强化学习。离散变体 UAS-Audio-D 用 Qwen2.5-3B + GLM-4-Voice 式 tokenizer，省略投影对齐与 GRPO，仅做 UAS 标注与 UAS-QA 微调。5）推理阶段采用任务特定提示（Targeted Mode），不强制输出完整 JSON，无额外延迟开销。
AI.result: 主结果（MMSU/MMAR/MMAU）：UAS-Audio MMSU 感知 55.7%（+10.9 相对最佳基线 Kimi-Audio 44.8%），推理 77.4%（仅低于 Qwen2.5-Omni 的 77.6% 0.2 个点），MMSU 总分 66.2%；MMAR 总分 60.1% 居首（语音 66.0%、音乐 45.2%，分别较 Qwen2.5-Omni 提升 6.1 与 4.4 个点）；MMAU 69.4%（Speech 67.0 / Sound 70.0 / Music 71.3），虽低于 Step-Audio2 的 72.7% 但各类别更均衡；三基准平均 65.2% 为最高。离散架构 UAS-Audio-D 相对 GLM-4-Voice 平均分近乎翻倍（24.4%→44.2%）。消融：去掉 UAS −6.3%、去掉 UAS-QA −9.6%、两者皆去 −15.0%，推理分数在各配置下保持稳定；去掉 GRPO 仅 −0.9（感知）/−1.4（推理），说明主要增益来自结构化监督而非优化算法；结构化 JSON 相比同源非结构化 caption 监督高 6.4 个感知点（54.8 vs 48.4）。生成能力：Seed-TTS 平均 WER 1.6，优于 Qwen2.5-Omni 1.9 与 Step-Audio2-mini 2.7（中文 1.4 与 Qwen 持平、英文 1.7 最佳），说明感知导向训练未损害生成。鲁棒性：整段 UAS JSON 输出的转写字段与标准 ASR 提示的 WER 仅差 0.1（LibriSpeech-clean 2.2→2.3，AISHELL 2.3→2.4）。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是：AudioLLM 细粒度感知能力的短板主要源于 ASR 中心化监督范式，而非模型容量、架构或优化算法；通过把音频信息重构为「转写—副语言—非语言事件」三层结构化 JSON 监督，可在几乎不牺牲推理与转写能力的前提下显著补齐感知瓶颈，且该收益与架构无关（连续与离散均成立），并可迁移改善语音生成质量。作者强调结构化监督的丰富度是 AudioLLM 走向超越简单扩展的关键因素。局限：实验集中在英语与中文等高资源语言，低资源与代码切换场景未验证；schema 仅针对主说话人做副语言分析，未覆盖鸡尾酒会等多说话人重叠场景的副语言解纠缠；情感与离散事件等主观/稀疏字段的人工标注精度相对较低。

title: Models Know Their Shortcuts: Deployment-Time Shortcut Mitigation
summary: Pretrained language models often rely on superficial features that appear predictive during training yet fail to generalize at test time, a phenomenon known as shortcut learning. Existing mitigation methods generally operate at training time and require heavy supervision such as access to the original training data or prior knowledge of shortcut type. We propose Shortcut Guardrail, a deployment-time framework that mitigates token-level shortcuts without access to the original training data or shortcut annotations. Our key insight is that gradient-based attribution on a biased model highlights shortcut tokens. Building on this finding, we train a lightweight LoRA-based debiasing module with a Masked Contrastive Learning (MaskCL) objective that encourages consistent representations with or without individual tokens. Across sentiment classification, toxicity detection, and natural language inference under both naturally occurring and controlled shortcuts, Shortcut Guardrail improves overall accuracy and worst-group accuracy over the unmitigated model under distribution shifts while preserving in-distribution performance.

AI.tldr: Shortcut Guardrail 是一种部署时框架，通过梯度归因识别捷径token，并使用轻量级 LoRA 模块和 MaskCL 对比学习目标来缓解语言模型中的捷径学习问题，无需访问原始训练数据或捷径标注。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型常依赖表面特征（捷径）进行预测，这些特征在训练时有效但在测试时泛化能力差。现有缓解方法需在训练时进行且需要大量监督（访问原始数据或预知捷径类型），缺乏轻量级的事后补救方案。
AI.method: 核心发现：基于梯度归因的偏差模型可高亮显示捷径token。在此基础上，训练轻量级 LoRA 去偏模块，采用 Masked Contrastive Learning (MaskCL) 目标函数，鼓励模型在有无特定token时产生一致表示，从而消除对捷径的依赖。
AI.result: 在情感分类、毒性检测和自然语言推理任务中，无论是自然出现还是人工控制的捷径场景，Shortcut Guardrail 均提升了整体准确率和最差组准确率，同时保持了分布内性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无需训练数据的事后部署方案，有效平衡了模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性与分布内表现，具有良好的实用价值。

title: A Two-Stage LLM Framework for Accessible and Verified XAI Explanations
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate the technical outputs of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods into accessible natural-language explanations. However, existing approaches often lack guarantees of accuracy, faithfulness, and completeness. At the same time, current efforts to evaluate such narratives remain largely subjective or confined to post-hoc scoring, offering no safeguards to prevent flawed explanations from reaching end-users. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Two-Stage LLM Meta-Verification Framework that consists of (i) an Explainer LLM that converts raw XAI outputs into natural-language narratives, (ii) a Verifier LLM that assesses them in terms of faithfulness, coherence, completeness, and hallucination risk, and (iii) an iterative refeed mechanism that uses the Verifier's feedback to refine and improve them. Experiments across five XAI techniques and datasets, using three families of open-weight LLMs, show that verification is crucial for filtering unreliable explanations while improving linguistic accessibility compared with raw XAI outputs. In addition, the analysis of the Entropy Production Rate (EPR) during the refinement process indicates that the Verifier's feedback progressively guides the Explainer toward more stable and coherent reasoning. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient pathway toward more trustworthy and democratized XAI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段LLM元验证框架，通过解释器LLM将XAI输出转换为自然语言叙述，再由验证器LLM评估其忠实性、连贯性、完整性和幻觉风险，最后通过迭代反馈机制优化解释。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM驱动的XAI解释方法缺乏准确性、忠实性和完整性的保证；现有评估方法多为事后评分或主观评价，无法防止有缺陷的解释到达终端用户。
AI.method: 提出两阶段LLM元验证框架：(i) 解释器LLM将原始XAI输出转换为自然语言叙述；(ii) 验证器LLM从忠实性、连贯性、完整性、幻觉风险四个维度评估解释；(iii) 迭代反馈机制利用验证器反馈进行优化改进。实验涵盖5种XAI技术和数据集，使用3个开源LLM家族。
AI.result: 验证机制可有效过滤不可靠解释，同时提升语言可访问性；熵产生率(EPR)分析表明验证器反馈逐步引导解释器趋向更稳定、连贯的推理。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为构建更可信、更民主化的XAI系统提供了有效路径。

title: Enhance-then-Balance Modality Collaboration for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) integrates heterogeneous text, audio, and visual signals to infer human emotions. While recent approaches leverage cross-modal complementarity, they often struggle to fully utilize weaker modalities. In practice, dominant modalities tend to overshadow non-verbal ones, inducing modality competition and limiting overall contributions. This imbalance degrades fusion performance and robustness under noisy or missing modalities. To address this, we propose a novel model, Enhance-then-Balance Modality Collaboration framework (EBMC). EBMC improves representation quality via semantic disentanglement and cross-modal enhancement, strengthening weaker modalities. To prevent dominant modalities from overwhelming others, an Energy-guided Modality Coordination mechanism achieves implicit gradient rebalancing via a differentiable equilibrium objective. Furthermore, Instance-aware Modality Trust Distillation estimates sample-level reliability to adaptively modulate fusion weights, ensuring robustness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EBMC achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results and maintains strong performance under missing-modality settings.

AI.tldr: EBMC框架通过语义解耦和跨模态增强提升弱模态表示质量，并利用能量引导的模态协调机制和实例级可信度蒸馏解决多模态融合中的模态竞争与不平衡问题，在多项基准数据集上达到最优或具竞争力的性能，且在缺失模态场景下表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态情感分析方法虽能利用跨模态互补性，但存在两个核心问题：1）弱模态易被主导模态（文本）淹没，导致模态竞争；2）该不平衡降低了融合性能及在噪声或缺失模态场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出EBMC框架，包含三个核心组件：1）语义解耦与跨模态增强：提升弱模态表示质量；2）能量引导模态协调机制：通过可微平衡目标实现隐式梯度重平衡，阻止主导模态压倒其他模态；3）实例感知模态信任蒸馏：估计样本级可靠性，自适应调节融合权重。
AI.result: EBMC在多个基准数据集上达到SOTA或具竞争力的性能，且在模态缺失设置下保持强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过增强弱模态表示、协调模态竞争及自适应融合，EBMC有效解决了多模态情感分析中的模态不平衡问题，为构建更鲁棒的多模态系统提供了有效方案。

title: Labeled TrustSet Guided: Batch Active Learning with Reinforcement Learning
comment: Published as a conference paper at IJCNN 2026
summary: Batch active learning (BAL) is a crucial technique for reducing labeling costs and improving data efficiency in training large-scale deep learning models. Traditional BAL methods often rely on metrics like Mahalanobis Distance to balance uncertainty and diversity when selecting data for annotation. However, these methods predominantly focus on the distribution of unlabeled data and fail to leverage feedback from labeled data or the model's performance. To address these limitations, we introduce TrustSet, a novel approach that selects the most informative data from the labeled dataset, ensuring a balanced class distribution to mitigate the long-tail problem. Unlike CoreSet, which focuses on maintaining the overall data distribution, TrustSet optimizes the model's performance by pruning redundant data and using label information to refine the selection process. To extend the benefits of TrustSet to the unlabeled pool, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL)-based sampling policy that approximates the selection of high-quality TrustSet candidates from the unlabeled data. Combining TrustSet and RL, we introduce the Batch Reinforcement Active Learning with TrustSet (BRAL-T) framework. BRAL-T achieves state-of-the-art results across 10 image classification benchmarks and 2 active fine-tuning tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness and efficiency in various domains.

AI.tldr: BRAL-T是一种新型批量主动学习方法，通过TrustSet机制从标注数据中选择信息量最大的样本，并利用强化学习策略从未标注数据中筛选高质量候选样本，实现最优模型性能。
AI.motivation: 传统批量主动学习方法主要依赖马氏距离等度量来平衡不确定性和多样性，但这些方法仅关注未标注数据的分布，忽视了标注数据的反馈信息和模型性能。为解决CoreSet仅维护整体数据分布而无法优化模型性能的局限，提出TrustSet机制。
AI.method: 1) TrustSet：从标注数据集中选择信息量最大的样本，确保类别分布平衡以缓解长尾问题，通过剪枝冗余数据和利用标签信息优化选择过程；2) 基于强化学习的采样策略：将TrustSet的优势扩展到未标注数据池；3) BRAL-T框架：结合TrustSet和RL方法。
AI.result: 在10个图像分类基准数据集和2个主动微调任务上均达到最优性能，验证了方法的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: BRAL-T框架通过TrustSet机制和强化学习采样策略，有效解决了传统批量主动学习方法忽视标注数据反馈的问题，在多个领域展现出优异的性能表现。

title: When Does Data Augmentation Help? Evaluating LLM and Back-Translation Methods for Hausa and Fongbe NLP
comment: 13 pages, 6 tables; previously submitted to KDD 2026
summary: Data scarcity limits NLP development for low-resource African languages. We evaluate two data augmentation methods -- LLM-based generation (Gemini 2.5 Flash) and back-translation (NLLB-200) -- for Hausa and Fongbe, two West African languages that differ substantially in LLM generation quality. We assess augmentation on named entity recognition (NER) and part-of-speech (POS) tagging using MasakhaNER 2.0 and MasakhaPOS benchmarks. Our results reveal that augmentation effectiveness depends on task type rather than language or LLM quality alone. For NER, neither method improves over baseline for either language; LLM augmentation reduces Hausa NER by 0.24% F1 and Fongbe NER by 1.81% F1. For POS tagging, LLM augmentation improves Fongbe by 0.33% accuracy, while back-translation improves Hausa by 0.17%; back-translation reduces Fongbe POS by 0.35% and has negligible effect on Hausa POS. The same LLM-generated synthetic data produces opposite effects across tasks for Fongbe -- hurting NER while helping POS -- suggesting task structure governs augmentation outcomes more than synthetic data quality. These findings challenge the assumption that LLM generation quality predicts augmentation success, and provide actionable guidance: data augmentation should be treated as a task-specific intervention rather than a universally beneficial preprocessing step.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了两种数据增强方法（LLM生成与回译）在两种西非语言（Hausa和Fongbe）上的效果，发现增强效果取决于任务类型而非语言或LLM质量本身，挑战了"LLM生成质量决定增强成功"的假设。
AI.motivation: 低资源非洲语言面临数据稀缺问题，制约NLP发展。研究者试图探索数据增强方法能否有效缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 使用Gemini 2.5 Flash进行LLM增强，NLLB-200进行回译增强；在MasakhaNER 2.0和MasakhaPOS基准上评估命名实体识别（NER）和词性标注（POS）任务。
AI.result: NER任务：两种方法均未提升基线，LLM增强使Hausa NER下降0.24%，Fongbe NER下降1.81%。POS任务：LLM增强提升Fongbe 0.33%，回译提升Hausa 0.17%；回译使Fongbe POS下降0.35%，对Hausa影响可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强效果由任务结构主导，而非合成数据质量；增强应被视为任务特异性干预手段，而非通用预处理步骤。

title: Beyond Weather Correlation: A Comparative Study of Static and Temporal Neural Architectures for Fine-Grained Residential Energy Consumption Forecasting in Melbourne, Australia
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Earlier preprint versions: Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19158396; SSRN https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6453198
