Interestingly, there was a small negative correlation (r = -.35) between whether a given AI tool was able to correctly classify the cognitive demand of tasks and whether the AI was able to upgrade tasks, showing that the ability to modify tasks (i.e., a generative task) represents a distinct capability from the ability to classify them (i.e., judgement using a rubric). These findings have important implications for understanding AI's potential role in curriculum adaptation and highlight the need for specialized approaches to support teachers in modifying instructional materials.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了11款AI工具（包括通用型如ChatGPT和专用型如Khanmigo）在提升低认知需求数学任务质量方面的能力，发现AI升级任务的成功率仅为64%，且存在"不足"（未能提升认知需求）和"过度"（提升幅度过大）两种失败模式。专用工具表现仅略优于通用工具，且AI的分类能力与生成能力呈弱负相关（r=-.35），表明这两项能力相互独立。
AI.motivation: 当前研究多关注AI对数学任务质量的分类能力，但缺乏对AI能否实际提升现有任务质量的理解。研究旨在填补这一空白，评估AI工具在辅助教师修改教学材料方面的实际潜力。
AI.method: 研究采用Task Analysis Guide框架（Stein & Smith, 1998），对11款AI工具（6款通用型 + 5款数学教师专用型）进行测试，使用模拟"典型有经验教师"的提示策略，要求其将两种不同类型的低需求数学任务进行升级改造。
AI.result: AI工具平均升级成功率为64%，不同工具表现差异显著（33%至88%）。专用工具略优于通用工具但差距不大。失败模式包括"不足"（维持低认知需求）和"过度"（提升至过高目标类别）。分类能力与升级能力呈弱负相关（r=-.35），表明两项能力相互独立。
AI.conclusion: AI在课程改编中具有一定潜力，但当前能力有限，需开发专门的教师支持工具。AI的分类能力无法预测其生成能力，研究建议未来开发针对教师任务修改需求的专用AI解决方案。

title: The role of System 1 and System 2 semantic memory structure in human and LLM biases
summary: Implicit biases in both humans and large language models (LLMs) pose significant societal risks. Dual process theories propose that biases arise primarily from associative System 1 thinking, while deliberative System 2 thinking mitigates bias, but the cognitive mechanisms that give rise to this phenomenon remain poorly understood. To better understand what underlies this duality in humans, and possibly in LLMs, we model System 1 and System 2 thinking as semantic memory networks with distinct structures, built from comparable datasets generated by both humans and LLMs. We then investigate how these distinct semantic memory structures relate to implicit gender bias using network-based evaluation metrics. We find that semantic memory structures are irreducible only in humans, suggesting that LLMs lack certain types of human-like conceptual knowledge. Moreover, semantic memory structure relates consistently to implicit bias only in humans, with lower levels of bias in System~2 structures. These findings suggest that certain types of conceptual knowledge contribute to bias regulation in humans, but not in LLMs, highlighting fundamental differences between human and machine cognition.

AI.tldr: This paper explores why dual process theory (System 1 vs System 2) describes bias regulation in humans but may not apply to LLMs, finding that fundamental differences in semantic memory structure mean conceptual knowledge regulates bias in humans but not in AI systems.
AI.motivation: Implicit biases in both humans and LLMs pose significant societal risks. Dual process theories suggest biases arise from System 1 thinking and are mitigated by System 2 thinking, but the cognitive mechanisms underlying this phenomenon remain poorly understood.
AI.method: Modeled System 1 and System 2 thinking as semantic memory networks with distinct structures built from comparable datasets generated by humans and LLMs, then investigated how these structures relate to implicit gender bias using network-based evaluation metrics.
AI.result: Semantic memory structures are irreducible only in humans (suggesting LLMs lack certain human-like conceptual knowledge), and structure relates consistently to implicit bias only in humans, with lower levels of bias in System 2 structures.
AI.conclusion: Certain types of conceptual knowledge contribute to bias regulation in humans but not in LLMs, highlighting fundamental differences between human and machine cognition.

title: Safety Training Modulates Harmful Misalignment Under On-Policy RL, But Direction Depends on Environment Design
summary: Specification gaming under Reinforcement Learning (RL) is known to cause LLMs to develop sycophantic, manipulative, or deceptive behavior, yet the conditions under which this occurs remain unclear. We train 11 instruction-tuned LLMs (0.5B--14B) with on-policy RL across 3 environments and find that model size acts as a safety buffer in some environments but enables greater harmful exploitation in others. Controlled ablations trace this reversal to environment-specific features such as role framing and implicit gameability cues. We further show that most safety benchmarks do not predict RL-induced misalignment, except in the case of Sycophancy scores when the exploit relies on inferring the user's preference. Finally, we find that on-policy RL preserves a safety buffer inherent in the model's own generation distribution, one that is bypassed during off-policy settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RL训练导致LLM产生谄媚/欺骗行为的条件，发现模型规模的作用因环境而异：有时作为安全缓冲，有时加剧危害。安全基准测试大多无法预测RL导致的对齐失效，且on-policy RL保留了模型自身生成分布中的安全缓冲，而off-policy设置会绕过这一保护机制。
AI.motivation: Specification gaming是RL中的已知问题，会导致LLM产生谄媚、操纵或欺骗行为，但这些不良行为在何种条件下产生尚不清楚，这是一个重要的安全问题。
AI.method: 使用11个指令微调的LLM（0.5B-14B参数），在3个环境中进行on-policy RL训练，并进行对照消融实验，测试多种安全基准。
AI.result: 模型规模的作用是环境依赖的——在某些环境中作为安全缓冲，在其他环境中反而加剧危害。这种逆转源于环境特定因素（角色框架、隐式可利用性线索）。大多数安全基准无法预测RL导致的对齐失效。On-policy RL保留了模型自身生成分布中的安全缓冲，而off-policy设置会绕过这一机制。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐研究需要考虑RL训练的具体环境设计。模型规模不是简单的安全指标，其作用高度依赖于训练环境。安全基准应针对RL特有的对齐失效机制进行设计。On-policy与off-policy RL在安全性上存在本质差异。

title: DocSeeker: Structured Visual Reasoning with Evidence Grounding for Long Document Understanding
summary: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from significant performance degradation on the long document understanding task as document length increases. This stems from two fundamental challenges: 1) a low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), with crucial evidence buried in irrelevant pages; and 2) supervision scarcity, as datasets offering only final short answers provide a weak learning signal. In this paper, we address these challenges by proposing a paradigm that requires the model to execute a structured ``\textbf{Analysis}, \textbf{Localization} and \textbf{Reasoning}'' workflow. To instill this capability, we design a two-stage training framework: we first perform Supervised Fine-Tuning on high-quality data generated via an efficient knowledge distillation strategy. Subsequently, we employ an Evidence-aware Group Relative Policy Optimization which jointly optimizes for both evidence localization and answer accuracy. Additionally, we introduce a Evidence-Guided Resolution Allocation strategy to mitigate memory constraints of training on multi-pages documents. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DocSeeker achieves superior performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks. We show it robustly generalizes from short-page training to ultra-long documents and is naturally synergistic with visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems, serving as a solid foundation for their implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在长文档理解中的性能下降问题，提出基于"分析、定位与推理"（ALR）工作流程的DocSeeker模型。采用两阶段训练框架，通过知识蒸馏生成高质量监督数据，并使用证据感知分组相对策略优化联合优化证据定位与答案准确性，同时引入证据引导的分辨率分配策略克服内存限制。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在长文档理解任务中存在严重性能下降问题，主要源于两个根本性挑战：1) 低信噪比（SNR），关键证据淹没在无关页面中；2) 监督稀缺，数据集仅提供最终短答案导致学习信号弱。
AI.method: 1) 监督微调阶段：使用高效知识蒸馏策略生成高质量数据；2) 强化学习优化阶段：采用证据感知分组相对策略优化（GRPO），联合优化证据定位和答案准确性；3) 引入证据引导的分辨率分配策略以缓解多页面文档训练的内存约束。
AI.result: DocSeeker在域内和域外任务均实现了优越性能，展现出从短页面训练到超长文档的稳健泛化能力，并能与视觉检索增强生成系统良好协同。
AI.conclusion: DocSeeker能够从短页面训练稳健泛化到超长文档，并能很好地与视觉检索增强生成系统协同工作，证明了该方法的有效性和通用性。

title: Growing Pains: Extensible and Efficient LLM Benchmarking Via Fixed Parameter Calibration
summary: The rapid release of both language models and benchmarks makes it increasingly costly to evaluate every model on every dataset. In practice, models are often evaluated on different samples, making scores difficult to compare across studies. To address this, we propose a framework based on multidimensional Item Response Theory (IRT) that uses anchor items to calibrate new benchmarks to the evaluation suite while holding previously calibrated item parameters fixed. Our approach supports a realistic evaluation setting in which datasets are introduced over time and models are evaluated only on the datasets available at the time of evaluation, while a fixed anchor set for each dataset is used so that results from different evaluation periods can be compared directly. In large-scale experiments on more than $400$ models, our framework predicts full-evaluation performance within 2-3 percentage points using only $100$ anchor questions per dataset, with Spearman $ρ\geq 0.9$ for ranking preservation, showing that it is possible to extend benchmark suites over time while preserving score comparability, at a constant evaluation cost per new dataset. Code available at https://github.com/eliyahabba/growing-pains

AI.tldr: 针对语言模型评估中基准和模型快速迭代导致的评估成本高、跨研究分数不可比问题，提出基于多维IRT的框架，通过锚题在不同时间段引入的数据集间实现分数校准和可比性，在400余个模型的大规模实验中验证了可行性，每个新数据集仅需100道锚题即可保持评估一致性。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型和基准的快速发布，在所有数据集上评估每个模型成本高昂；实践中模型往往在不同样本上进行评估，导致跨研究分数难以比较。
AI.method: 基于多维项目反应理论(IRT)的框架，使用锚题(anchor items)来校准新基准与已有评估体系，同时固定先前已校准的项目参数。
AI.result: 使用每个数据集仅100道锚题，即可将完整评估性能预测误差控制在2-3个百分点以内，Spearman相关系数ρ≥0.9，能够有效保持模型排名顺序。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在引入新数据集时保持分数可比性，且每个新数据集的评估成本恒定。实验验证了方法的可行性和实用性。

title: Agentic Control in Variational Language Models
summary: We study whether a variational language model can support a minimal and measurable form of agentic control grounded in its own internal evidence. Our model combines local variational hidden computation (EVE), a homeostatic latent regulator, structurally aware checkpoint retention and a calibrated uncertainty-aware controller operating on top of the retained model. Rather than treating uncertainty as a passive diagnostic measured after prediction, we treat it as an operational signal that can regulate training, support checkpoint retention and guide inference-time intervention. The resulting framework is deliberately focused. It studies a closed-loop form of internal control in which structural and predictive signals become actionable. Empirically, the variational backbone improves over a matched deterministic reference on the language-modeling task while also exhibiting a richer and more usable uncertainty profile. On top of this backbone, the calibrated controller remains active, uses multiple actions under a full agentic evaluation and yields a positive quality-cost trade-off. These results support a precise claim: internal uncertainty can serve not only as a descriptive property of a variational language model, but also as a practical control interface for regulation, checkpoint retention and minimal agentic routing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"最小可测的智能体控制"框架：在冻结 GPT-2 嵌入前端之上构建局部变分隐计算语言模型（EVE），配合训练期稳态（homeostatic）隐状态调节器、结构感知检查点保留规则与推理期校准的不确定性感知控制器，将不确定性从"事后诊断量"转变为可操作的闭环控制信号。实验显示：变分骨干在语言建模指标上优于匹配确定性基线（DET），并提供更丰富的可用不确定性结构；保留的检查点上的多动作控制器保持活跃，覆盖率 0.90、效用 0.1048，且相对直接预测避免约 9.94% 的错误。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体研究多聚焦于外延机制（工具调用、检索、规划、多步动作策略），把已训练好的模型当作黑箱叠加使用；而选择性预测/拒答类工作虽把不确定性用于决策，却只停留在"是否信任预测"的层面。论文提出的互补问题：语言模型能否仅凭自身内部证据支撑一种最小且可度量的"从内部"智能体控制？为此需要三个此前被混同的角色——训练期内部调节、训练后模型状态保留、推理期动作路由——在一条有序流水线中被显式分离，并需要变分隐计算提供比确定性后验置信度更丰富的内部可观测证据（KL 活跃度、隐能量、预测熵、互信息、多次随机前向分歧）。
AI.method: 任务与设置：RLAIF/WritingPrompts-Filtered 训练集 1% 子集，GPT-2 分词与冻结输入嵌入（nn.Embedding.from_pretrained(freeze=True)），prompt≤96、story≤192 token，context_len=24、target_stride=2、min_story_tokens=32；预测头与冻结嵌入表权重绑定。模型：EVE 在 Transformer 式隐层内置入局域变分单元 q_φ(z|x,h)、p_ψ(z|h)，z=μ_q+σ_q⊙ε，训练 4 次/评估 12 次 MC 采样；DET 为对照，移除后验/先验/采样路径，其余（分词器、嵌入、任务、接口）完全匹配。目标：L_EVE = L_CE + L_regKL + λ_local·L_local + λ_band·L_band（λ_local=3e-2、λ_band=4e-3、mu2_target=0.10）。稳态调节器（control_mode="homeo"、beta thermostat、neuron regulator）跟踪隐能量、带占用率、过低/过高单元比例、局部重构与 KL 统计，并以类恒温器方式把隐状态维持在可用区间；搜索 λ_band,high。内部信号分结构类（KL 活跃度、局部重构、μ²、带占用、frac_low/high）与预测类（预测熵、条件熵、互信息、top-1 MC 翻转率、置信度）。检查点保留采用"任务安全过滤 + 结构排序键"（1[¬task_safe], frac_too_high, |μ²_eval−μ²_target|, −acc, ce, −local_recon），跨种子再按 (val_ce, −val_acc, epoch) 选最终 EVE。统一不确定性分数 U(x) 由熵/MI/翻转率经固定上限截断归一（3.5/0.50/0.35）加权平均（0.40/0.40/0.20）并加低置信度惩罚，再在留出验证行上以分位数（0.50/0.75/0.90，或完整网格搜索三元组并最大化惩罚化代理目标）校准出 green/orange/red 阈值。动作空间：answer、deliberate_more、retrieve_or_resample、abstain_or_escalate（汇总为 direct/deliberate/retrieve/abstain）；终止动作互斥，支持动作可重叠。成本模型：answer 1.0、resample 2.0、retrieve_resample 3.0、abstain 0.5；Utility = mean(overall_acc) − λ_cost·mean(cost)，λ_cost=0.02。训练：batch 48、3 epochs、lr 2e-4、weight decay 1e-4、梯度裁剪 1.0，两阶段"搜索+跨种子确认"。
AI.result: 骨干对比（最终验证）：EVE Loss 5.5340 / CE 5.4341 / PPL 229.09 / Acc 0.1632 / KL 282.23 / Local 0.1309；DET Loss=CE 5.6035 / PPL 271.36 / Acc 0.1560。即 EVE 使验证 CE 降低 0.1694、困惑度降低 42.27、准确率绝对提升 0.0072。种子级：EVE S101（best epoch 3，val CE 5.4241，PPL 226.82，Acc 0.1657）与 S202（5.4161/225.00/0.1654），二者差距很小、表现稳定；确定性参考最佳在 epoch 2（CE 5.6035）。Stage-1 搜索显示 λ_band,high≈2.05 最优（CE 5.4094），超参区域紧凑。不确定性与校准：EVE 的 NLL 5.6404（优于 DET 5.6698）、ECE 0.0326（远优于 DET 0.0792）、CVaR-NLL 12.5035（优于 13.0499），且 MI 0.1777、Epi. 0.0325、MC top-1 翻转率 0.3197 均为非零，而 DET 全部为零；DET 的 μ²=0.7370 明显偏离目标，EVE 为 0.0487、frac_high 0.0826。隐状态诊断：局部活动由 ~0.10 升至 ~0.13–0.14，高活跃单元比例由 ~0.04 升至 ~0.11，μ² 由 ~0.035 升至 ~0.06，呈"活性、稳定、受控"的稳态剖面。全量多动作智能体评估（seed 101，200 例，阈值 green 0.6069/orange 0.7500/red 0.8919）：接受 180、弃答 20，覆盖率 0.9000，接受准确率 0.1778，总体准确率 0.1600，Accepted CE = Overall CE = 4.6553，平均成本 2.7600，平均 MC 成本 8.3800，平均步数 1.7450，弃答率 0.1000，直接率 0.6350，检索率 0.3200，深思率 0.2650，重采样率 0.2650，Utility 0.1048，相对直接预测避免错误比例 0.0994。六项验证检查（覆盖充分、检索被使用、深思被使用、非弃答主导、效用为正、避免部分直接错误）全部通过。
AI.conclusion: 结论是精确而有限的：变分语言模型的内部不确定性不仅是一种描述性属性，更可作为实际可用的"控制接口"——它能在训练期调节隐状态区间、支撑保留结构上有意义的检查点、并在推理期驱动校准化干预，从而在模型内部实现一种紧凑、具体、可度量的智能体控制闭环；这些结果同时表明变分骨干既保留了较强预测能力，又携带更丰富且可用的不确定性结构。论文亦明确界定其范围：这不是通用工具型智能体架构，而是为更大规模外部智能体系统提供"更早的内部层"基座。局限与后续方向：实验规模受限（1% 数据子集、约 200 条评估样本、GPT-2 冻结嵌入、无真实外部检索/工具环境，retrieve 实质为上下文增强后重跑），单一任务与单一架构族，阈值与权重为手工设定并按分位数校准；未来方向包括扩大规模与任务多样性、更丰富的路由策略（结合更强的检索或外部支持）、以及验证"调节—保留—路由"分离在更复杂骨干上的有效性。

title: RePAIR: Interactive Machine Unlearning through Prompt-Aware Model Repair
summary: Large language models (LLMs) inherently absorb harmful knowledge, misinformation, and personal data during pretraining on large-scale web corpora, with no native mechanism for selective removal. While machine unlearning offers a principled solution, existing approaches are provider-centric, requiring retraining pipelines, curated retain datasets, and direct intervention by model service providers (MSPs), thereby excluding end users from controlling their own data. We introduce Interactive Machine Unlearning (IMU), a new paradigm in which users can instruct LLMs to forget targeted knowledge through natural language at inference time. To realize IMU, we propose RePAIR, a prompt-aware model repair framework comprising (i) a watchdog model for unlearning intent detection, (ii) a surgeon model for generating repair procedures, and (iii) a patient model whose parameters are updated autonomously. At the core of RePAIR, we develop Steering Through Activation Manipulation with PseudoInverse (STAMP), a training-free, single-sample unlearning method that redirects MLP activations toward a refusal subspace via closed-form pseudoinverse updates. Its low-rank variant reduces computational complexity from O(d^3) to O(r^3 + r^2 * d), enabling efficient on-device unlearning with up to ~3x speedup over training-based baselines. Extensive experiments across harmful knowledge suppression, misinformation correction, and personal data erasure demonstrate that RePAIR achieves near-zero forget scores (Acc_f = 0.00, F-RL = 0.00) while preserving model utility (Acc_r up to 84.47, R-RL up to 0.88), outperforming six state-of-the-art baselines. These results establish RePAIR as an effective and practical framework for user-driven model editing, advancing transparent and on-device control over learned knowledge, with potential extensions to multimodal foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交互式机器遗忘(Interactive Machine Unlearning, IMU)范式，允许用户在推理时通过自然语言指令控制LLM遗忘目标知识。核心框架RePAIR包含三个组件和STAMP算法，通过无训练、单样本的MLP激活重定向实现高效设备端遗忘，在有害知识抑制、错误信息纠正和个人数据擦除三项任务上均达到接近零的遗忘分数(Acc_f=0.00, F-RL=0.00)同时保持模型效用(Acc_r=84.47, R-RL=0.88)，优于六种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在预训练过程中不可避免地吸收有害知识、错误信息和个人数据，但现有机器遗忘方法以服务提供商为中心，需要重新训练流水线、精心策划的保留数据集和服务商的直接干预，普通终端用户无法控制自己的数据被模型记忆。这限制了机器遗忘在实际场景中的应用，需要一种用户驱动的、轻量级的遗忘机制。
AI.method: 提出RePAIR框架，包含三个协同模型：(1)看门狗模型(Watchdog)检测用户遗忘意图，(2)外科医生模型(Surgeon)生成修复程序，(3)患者模型(Patient)自主更新参数。核心算法STAMP通过伪逆闭式更新将MLP激活重定向至拒绝子空间，实现无训练、单样本遗忘。其低秩变体将计算复杂度从O(d³)降至O(r³+r²·d)，支持高效设备端部署。
AI.result: 在有害知识抑制、错误信息纠正和个人数据擦除三项任务中，RePAIR达到近乎完美的遗忘效果(Acc_f=0.00, F-RL=0.00)同时保持良好的模型效用(Acc_r达84.47%, R-RL达0.88)，显著优于六种最新基线方法。STAMP相比训练基线方法实现约3倍加速。
AI.conclusion: RePAIR为用户驱动的模型编辑提供了有效且实用的框架，实现了透明、设备端的知识控制。STAMP的无训练特性使其特别适合资源受限场景和多模态基础模型的扩展。未来方向包括向多模态基础模型扩展以及进一步优化低秩近似的精度-效率权衡。

title: Round-Trip Translation Reveals What Frontier Multilingual Benchmarks Miss
summary: Multilingual benchmarks guide the development of frontier models. Yet multilingual evaluations reported by frontier models are structured similar to popular reasoning and knowledge benchmarks, but across many languages. We show such benchmarks, and consequently multilingual evaluations, measure mathematical reasoning and factual recall, not multilingual proficiency. For example, thinking variants dramatically outperform instruct variants on these benchmarks, yet often perform worse on real-world multilingual tasks, such as LMArena. We propose a simple alternative: evaluate multilingual capability via round-trip translation. Given text in a source language, translate it to a target language and back; semantic gaps between the original and result expose failures in multilingual generation capabilities. Round-trip translation correlates almost perfectly (\r{ho} = 0.94) with user ratings on LMArena with our benchmark, requires no human reference translations, and does not require a more capable multilingual judge than tested models. Lastly, we introduce Lost in Translation (LiT), a challenging round-trip translation benchmark spanning widely spoken languages worldwide, for realistic evaluation of multilingual frontier models.

AI.tldr: 现有的大语言模型多语言评估基准实际上测量的是数学推理和知识回忆能力，而非真正的多语言能力。本文提出用"回译"(round-trip translation)作为多语言能力评估方法，并引入Lost in Translation (LiT)基准。
AI.motivation: 当前多语言评估基准结构上模仿了推理和知识类基准，但这些基准无法真正衡量模型的多语言能力。思维链(thinking)变体虽在基准上表现优异，却在真实多语言任务(如LMArena)中表现更差，说明现有评估存在严重偏差。
AI.method: 提出基于回译的评估方法：将源语言文本翻译成目标语言，再翻译回来，通过比较原文与回译结果之间的语义差异来评估多语言生成能力。该方法无需人工参考译文，也不需要比被测模型更强的多语言裁判模型。
AI.result: 回译方法与LMArena用户评分达到几乎完美的相关性(ρ = 0.94)，证明了该方法在真实场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 回译是一种简单有效的多语言能力评估范式，能够捕捉现有基准无法检测的模型缺陷。LiT基准涵盖全球广泛使用的语言，为多语言前沿模型的现实评估提供了挑战性的测试平台。

title: Instantiating Bayesian CVaR lower bounds in Interactive Decision Making Problems
summary: Recent work established a generalized-Fano framework for lower bounding prior-predictive (Bayesian) CVaR in interactive statistical decision making. In this paper, we show how to instantiate that framework in concrete interactive problems and derive explicit Bayesian CVaR lower bounds from its abstract corollaries. Our approach compares a hard model with a reference model using squared Hellinger distance, and combines a lower bound on a reference hinge term with a bound on the distinguishability of the two models. We apply this approach to canonical examples, including Gaussian bandits, and obtain explicit bounds that make the dependence on key problem parameters transparent. These results show how the generalized-Fano Bayesian CVaR framework can be used as a practical lower-bound tool for interactive learning and risk-sensitive decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文将广义Fano框架具体化于交互式统计决策问题，通过平方Hellinger距离比较硬模型与参考模型，结合参考hinge项下界与两模型可区分性上界，推导出显式贝叶斯CVaR下界，并应用于高斯老虎机等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有广义Fano框架缺乏具体实例化和显式表达式，本文旨在将该抽象理论框架转化为交互式学习和风险敏感决策中的实用下界工具。
AI.method: 采用平方Hellinger距离作为模型比较工具，结合hinge项下界与模型可区分性界，推导贝叶斯CVaR的显式下界。
AI.result: 获得高斯老虎机等典型问题的显式界，清晰展示关键问题参数的下界依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 证明了广义Fano贝叶斯CVaR框架可作为交互式学习和风险敏感决策的实用下界工具。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Modeling and Simulation of Mixed Automated and Human Traffic
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) are now operating on public roads, which makes their testing and validation more critical than ever. Simulation offers a safe and controlled environment for evaluating AV performance in varied conditions. However, existing simulation tools mainly focus on graphical realism and rely on simple rule-based models and therefore fail to accurately represent the complexity of driving behaviors and interactions. Artificial intelligence (AI) has shown strong potential to address these limitations; however, despite the rapid progress across AI methodologies, a comprehensive survey of their application to mixed autonomy traffic simulation remains lacking. Existing surveys either focus on simulation tools without examining the AI methods behind them, or cover ego-centric decision-making without addressing the broader challenge of modeling surrounding traffic. Moreover, they do not offer a unified taxonomy of AI methods covering individual behavior modeling to full scene simulation. To address these gaps, this survey provides a structured review and synthesis of AI methods for modeling AV and human driving behavior in mixed autonomy traffic simulation. We introduce a taxonomy that organizes methods into three families: agent-level behavior models, environment-level simulation methods, and cognitive and physics-informed methods. The survey analyzes how existing simulation platforms fall short of the needs of mixed autonomy research and outlines directions to narrow this gap. It also provides a chronological overview of AI methods and reviews evaluation protocols and metrics, simulation tools, and datasets. By covering both traffic engineering and computer science perspectives, we aim to bridge the gap between these two communities.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述论文，系统梳理并分类了人工智能方法在混合自动化/人类交通微观仿真中的应用。作者提出以"智能体级行为模型—环境级仿真方法—认知与物理信息化方法"三族为核心的统一分类体系，并在三条正交轴（单智能体/多智能体、智能体级/环境级、数据驱动/理论驱动）上组织内容；论文还综述了AI方法的演进时间线、开环与闭环评测指标、仿真工具与数据集，并提出因果性缺口、评测危机、可扩展性—保真度—可控性三难等九项开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆已上路，测试验证需求日益迫切；仿真提供安全可控的评估环境，但现有工具（SUMO、VISSIM、CARLA）以图形真实感为主，依赖IDM/MOBIL等简单规则模型或轨迹回放，难以刻画真实驾驶的行为异质性与交互动态。已有综述存在明显空白：(1) 或只关注仿真平台而不检视其背后的AI方法；(2) 或只关注自车（ego-centric）决策规划，未覆盖周边交通建模与混合自主性特有需求；(3) 缺乏从个体行为建模到全场景生成的统一方法分类体系；(4) 缺少面向混合自主研究的评测协议、基准、数据集与工具的系统梳理；(5) 交通工程与计算机科学两个社区长期割裂。
AI.method: 采用面向方法论（methods-oriented）的综述方式而非严格系统综述协议。通过 Google Scholar、Web of Science、Scopus、IEEE Xplore、arXiv 检索，结合关键词组合（自动化驾驶/混合自主 × AI方法 × 行为建模任务）、引用追踪与滚雪球，并跟踪 WOSAC、nuPlan、WOMD、Argoverse 等主要基准与挑战，同时检索人因与认知科学文献。筛选标准为每个方法类别选取7–15篇代表性论文，依据五项准则：奠基性贡献、方法学推进、影响力与引用、在公认基准上的近期强结果、技术路线覆盖度；对新兴主题（基础模型、认知-学习融合）更看重新颖性与覆盖度而非引用量。分类体系由三条互补轴构成：(1) 单智能体 vs 多智能体（多智能体下再分联合轨迹预测、集中式交互仿真、去中心化交互仿真）；(2) 智能体级 vs 环境级（生成式世界模型、交通场景生成）；(3) 数据驱动 vs 理论驱动（认知与物理信息化方法）。各章按核心技术表述细分（模仿学习、强化学习、扩散生成、博弈论等），给出形式化问题设定、代表性研究、局限与未来方向；开环/闭环作为部署选择而非主分类维度。
AI.result:
1) 分类体系：智能体级行为模型涵盖模仿学习/行为克隆（含DAgger、DART、HG-DAgger、MEGA-DAgger等纠正协变量偏移）、轨迹预测（CoverNet、MultiPath、TNT、MID等）、强化学习（Kendall DDPG、Roach、Think2Drive、BC-SAC等）、逆强化学习与对抗模仿（MaxEnt IRL、GAIL、AIRL、RAIL）、端到端学习规划器（UniAD、VAD、Diffusion Planner、DiffusionDrive）、基于模型的世界模型策略学习（Dreamer系、MILE、AdaWM、Imagine-2-Drive）与基础模型方法（Agent-Driver、DiLu、GPT-Driver、DriveGPT4）。
2) 多智能体方法：联合轨迹预测（Social LSTM、Trajectron++、Scene Transformer、HiVT、GameFormer等）；集中式仿真含扩散式（CTG、CTG++、MotionDiffuser）、token/自回归式（MotionLM、Trajeglish、BehaviorGPT、SMART）与回归式反应型（SimNet、TrafficSim）；去中心化含MARL/自博弈（Shalev-Shwartz、Flow、Nocturne、HR-PPO、Robust Self-Play）、多智能体GAIL（PS-GAIL、Symphony、DecompGAIL）、博弈论（Nash/Stackelberg、level-k、BeTop）与混合数据驱动智能体（TrafficBots、CtRL-Sim、TrajGen）；另有基础模型协同（AgentsCoDriver、KoMA、CCMA）。
3) 环境级方法：视频/潜空间世界模型（GAIA-1/2、Drive-WM、DriveDreamer、VISTA、MUVO、DrivingWorld、GenAD）与占据栅格世界模型（OccWorld、OccSora、DOME、T³Former、I²-World、OccLLaMA）；场景初始化与可控合成（SceneGen、TrafficGen、DriveSceneGen、CTG++、LCTGen、ChatSim、RealGen）以及安全关键场景生成与对抗失效（AST、STRIVE、KING、AdvDiffuser、AV-FUZZER、CaDRE等）。
4) 认知与物理信息化：累积前景理论、风险稳态/前景平衡、漂移扩散模型与证据累积、level-k推理；ACT-R/QN-ACTR/QN-ACTR-SA/SOAR-ACPPO、注意力模型与脑启发架构（DR(eye)VE、BDD-A、DADA-2000）、驾驶安全场与DRF风险场、人-AV信任三维度（Lee & See、Hoff & Bashir）建模；物理信息化深度学习（IDM/OVM/FVDM作为结构先验，PIT-IDM、PIDL-GAN、KIDL）。
5) 评测与工具：开环指标ADE/FDE/minADE/minFDE、Miss Rate、Brier-minFDE、NLL、软mAP、越野率/重叠率/运动学可行性；闭环指标碰撞率、PET、nuPlan CLS、舒适性与违规分数；WOSAC真实度复合指标（9项分量、32次随机滚动）；数据集（NGSIM/highD/inD/rounD/exiD/pNEUMA/INTERACTION、WOMD、Argoverse2、nuScenes、nuPlan等）与仿真工具（GPUDrive、Waymax、Nocturne、SUMO、Flow、CityFlow、CARLA、AWSIM、Isaac Sim、VISTA、UniSim等）。
6) 关键结论与挑战：开环位移误差与闭环交互真实性之间存在根本落差；观测数据训练与干预部署之间的"因果性缺口"是跨方法族的普遍问题；评测体系滞后于建模方法（"评测危机"）；可扩展性—行为保真度—可控性三难无现有方法同时满足；混合自主表示问题（人-AV共适应建模缺失）；研究-部署落差（主流平台仍用规则模型）；数据地理与文化偏差；长尾安全关键事件严重欠采样；仿真-现实迁移差距；认知接地与统一架构整合问题。
AI.conclusion: AI方法在混合自主交通仿真中的价值已超越单纯提升轨迹预测精度：真正决定仿真可用性的是交互真实性（智能体对彼此及对自车干预做出合理反应）、场景级一致性（联合滚动无碰撞、符合地图约束）、可扩展性与可控性，以及干预下的反事实有效性。评测范式必须从开环位移匹配转向闭环、干预敏感、长时程稳定的综合评估，并明确"真实仿真"的操作性定义（统计保真 / 反事实有效性 / 认知机制再现）。领域正向混合架构演进——以数据驱动方法的可扩展性结合认知模型的可解释性与物理约束的可行性保证，并将基础模型与扩散生成整合进统一的感知—预测—规划框架。作者主张交通工程与机器学习社区的深度协作，是实现AI驱动仿真支撑自动驾驶安全部署的关键路径。

title: MetFuse: Figurative Fusion between Metonymy and Metaphor
summary: Metonymy and metaphor often co-occur in natural language, yet computational work has studied them largely in isolation. We introduce a framework that transforms a literal sentence into three figurative variants: metonymic, metaphoric, and hybrid. Using this framework, we construct MetFuse, the first dedicated dataset of figurative fusion between metonymy and metaphor, containing 1,000 human-verified meaning-aligned quadruplets totaling 4,000 sentences. Extrinsic experiments on eight existing benchmarks show that augmenting training data with MetFuse consistently improves both metonymy and metaphor classification, with hybrid examples yielding the largest gains on metonymy tasks. Using this dataset, we also analyze how the presence of one figurative type impacts another. Our findings show that both human annotators and large language models better identify metonymy in hybrid sentences than in metonymy-only sentences, demonstrating that the presence of a metaphor makes a metonymic noun more explicit. Our dataset is publicly available at: https://github.com/cincynlp/MetFuse.

AI.tldr: MetFuse：一个将字面句自动转换为「转喻句 / 隐喻句 / 混合句」的三阶段生成框架，并据此构建首个专门面向转喻—隐喻融合的语料库（含 1,000 组意义对齐四元组、共 4,000 句）。该框架显著优于朴素提示（人工判定有效率 75.2%/84.0%/74.0% vs 38.8%/70.8%/49.2%），在 8 个转喻/隐喻分类基准上做数据增强可稳定提升性能，且核心发现是「隐喻的存在会让共现的转喻名词更显著、更易被识别」。
AI.motivation: 转喻（metonymy，单一概念域内的指称转移）与隐喻（metaphor，跨概念域映射）在自然语言中常共现（Goossens 1990 称之为 metaphtonymy），但计算语言学几乎将二者割裂研究，缺少资源支撑的交互分析。同时隐喻生成研究相对成熟而转喻生成鲜有工作，二者的不对称性（如隐喻自由度高、转喻受制于邻近关系）也缺乏实证支撑。作者希望：（1）提供可控的「字面→转喻/隐喻/混合」转换框架；（2）构建首个转喻—隐喻融合数据集 MetFuse；（3）通过下游实验与人类/LLM 标注考察二者相互作用——具体而言，隐喻的存在是否使转喻更易被察觉。
AI.method:
【预处理】从 Wikipedia dump 用 SpaCy 抽取满足三条件的字面句：主语为人类实体名词、与动词存在依存关系（以支持隐喻动词的共现），实例主要落在「地点代指人」类转喻。

【转喻生成（3 步）】① 用 LLM 就名词的位置、居住者/构成部分、显著部分提出针对性问题以引出邻近关系，将答案作为候选名词（温度 0.7）；② 用 BERT 掩码语言模型对目标名词位置计算各候选填入的 log 概率，选最高者（如「The [mask] officially pronounced…」→ crown/Buckingham Palace）；③ 替换名词并让 LLM 精修句子、保留转喻名词（温度 0.4，抑制改写以保语义）。

【隐喻生成（3 步）】聚焦动词隐喻（受 Chakrabarty et al. 2021、Tian et al. 2021 启发，含夸张动词以强化域偏移）。① LLM 分别在 positive/negative/neutral 三种语气下生成动词候选（温度 0.7，top-p 0.9）；② 用轻量情感模型（Camacho-collados et al. 2022）预测字面句语气，选取语气匹配的候选动词；③ 替换动词并让 LLM 精修（温度 0.6，top-p 0.9）。

【混合句构造】将精修后转喻句中的转喻名词短语替换进精修后的隐喻句；因转喻生成基本保留原句法结构，无需额外后处理。

【框架评估】250 句样本，与「通用 few-shot CoT 提示」基线对比：人工判定是否为预期修辞（Table 2），并用 Sentence-Transformer 计算与字面句的余弦相似度（Table 3）。基座模型为 Llama-3.1-8B；附录 A 在 GPT-oss-20B/Qwen3-30B/Llama-3.1-70B/GPT-5 上验证框架泛化性。

【数据集构建】人工审阅 1,500 个生成样本，1,104 个三类均达标（≈74%），随机抽取 1,000 条构成 MetFuse（4,000 句）；标注者间一致率：转喻 96.3%、隐喻 91.2%、混合 91.1%；并从流畅性、意义保持、创造性、转喻显性度、隐喻显性度五项评分。

【下游/分析实验】① 8 个基准（转喻：ConMeC、Pedinotti & Lenci、RelocaR、WiMCor；隐喻：VUA、FLUTE、MOH-X、TroFi）按 70/30 划分，fine-tune BERT-base（3 epoch，lr 1e-5，batch 8），对比 Train / Train+MetFuse 对应类型样本 / Train+MetFuse 混合样本，增强量固定为原训练集 50%；附录 C 另有跨域训练—测试实验。② LLM 转喻消解零样本实验（GPT-OSS-20B、Qwen3-30B、Llama-3.1-70B、Gemini-2.5-Flash），对比「转喻句为正例」与「混合句为正例」。③ 上下文嵌入余弦相似度对比（名词侧与动词侧）。④ 附录 D 计算名词/动词 token 的 surprisal（-log p）。
AI.result:
1) 框架有效性：人工判定达成预期修辞的比例，转喻 75.2%、隐喻 84.0%、混合 74.0%，整体约 78%，远高于通用提示的 38.8%/70.8%/49.2%（整体 53%）；语义相似度（余弦）本文框架 0.84/0.82/0.70，亦全面高于基线 0.70/0.60/0.44。附录 A 显示框架在 4 个不同 LLM 上表现相当（转喻 72–75、隐喻 86–90、混合 72–75），GPT-5 存在替换重复问题。
2) MetFuse 数据集：1,000 组四元组 / 4,000 句，标注一致率高（>91%）；人类评分显示隐喻句最流畅（3.64）、转喻句最保义（3.51）、混合句创造性最高（4.25）但意义分最低（2.74）。
3) 下游增强：4 个转喻基准中 3 个提升（Pedinotti 下降 1.50），但所有数据集上「混合样本」增强均最优（如 ConMeC +3.84、RelocaR +3.34、Pedinotti +2.02）；4 个隐喻基准全部提升（Flute +3.47、TroFi +2.88、VUA +2.17、MOH-X +0.51），隐喻任务上混合与纯隐喻谁更优并不一致（VUA、MOH-X 混合更好；Flute、TroFi 纯隐喻更好）。跨域实验中 MetFuse 增强几乎均提升，混合样本始终优于纯转喻样本（除 RelocaR→WiMCor 外）。
4) 核心发现「隐喻促进转喻」：人类对混合句中转喻显性度评分 3.65 > 纯转喻句 3.47；BERT 在四个转喻基准上用混合样本增强优于纯转喻样本；四个 LLM 在混合句上的转喻识别 P/R/F1 全面高于纯转喻句（如 GPT-OSS-20B F1 71.6 vs 67.3，Qwen3-30B 87.3 vs 85.4）；名词上下文嵌入相似度 sim(N_lit, N_hyb) 一致高于 sim(N_lit, N_mty)（如 Llama-3.1-70B +1.86），说明混合句中的转喻名词更接近其非转喻（字面）用法。附录 B 显示反向作用不一致：动词嵌入相似度、隐喻释义/蕴含得分（metaphor-only 略优于 hybrid）表明转喻对隐喻无一致影响。附录 D 困惑度分析显示名词 surprisal 在转喻/混合中升高（9.01→12.79/12.81），动词 surprisal 在隐喻/混合中升高（7.03→11.38/12.66）。
5) 错误分析：转喻生成主要因原句语义结构不适合转喻替换、原名词为字面替换、或 LLM 精修时改写为非转喻表达而失败；隐喻生成主要因改写后语义偏离原句；混合句常因同时改动名词与动词而丢失具体所指（如「painters worked on…」→「The studio forged…」失去"绘画"义）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出一个可控的字面句→转喻/隐喻/混合三变体生成框架（候选生成→打分选择→LLM 精修），并据此发布首个转喻—隐喻融合数据集 MetFuse（1,000 组四元组、4,000 句）。该框架在有效率与语义保真上显著优于朴素提示，且跨 LLM 泛化良好；在 8 个基准上的数据增强一致提升转喻与隐喻分类，混合样本在转喻任务上增益最大。核心洞见是方向不对称：隐喻的跨域映射会对读者施压，迫使转喻名词被显式解读（metaphor 作为「forcing device」强化 metonymy），故混合句中转喻更易被人类与 LLM 识别；而转喻对隐喻的辨识无一致影响。局限包括：仅覆盖「地点/机构代人」类的活跃主语转喻、未显式标注概念域映射、混合句存在语义损失。数据集已开源（github.com/cincynlp/MetFuse），期待推动转喻—隐喻交互的计算研究。

title: Orthogonal Subspace Projection for Continual Machine Unlearning via SVD-Based LoRA
summary: Continual machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of data that should no longer be retained, while preserving the usefulness of the model on everything else. This setting becomes especially difficult when deletion requests arrive sequentially, because the model must repeatedly adapt without erasing previously retained knowledge. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) offers an efficient way to implement such updates, but naively combining many sequential LoRA modules leads to parameter collision, causing \textit{strong interference} between tasks. We propose a static alternative based on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-guided orthogonal subspace projection. Our method constrains each new LoRA update during training so that it lies in the orthogonal complement of the subspaces used by earlier unlearning tasks. This preserves task isolation without requiring dynamic routing at deployment. Experiments on CIFAR-100 with ResNet-20 and on MNIST show stable behavior across long sequences of unlearning tasks. After thirty sequential unlearning tasks, state-of-the-art static fusion reduces retained accuracy from 60.39\% to 12.70\%, whereas the proposed in-training constrained optimization maintains baseline performance ($\sim$58.1\%) while preserving strong unlearning efficacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于SVD引导的正交子空间投影方法，通过约束新的LoRA更新位于早期遗忘任务子空间的正交补空间中，解决顺序遗忘请求导致的参数冲突问题。在CIFAR-100和MNIST数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 顺序遗忘请求场景下，简单堆叠多个LoRA模块会导致参数冲突和任务间强干扰。现有静态融合方法在长期任务序列中性能急剧下降（保留准确率从60.39%降至12.70%）。需要一种既能保持任务隔离又不增加推理时动态路由开销的方法。
AI.method: 基于奇异值分解（SVD）引导的正交子空间投影。具体而言：在训练期间约束每个新LoRA更新，使其位于先前遗忘任务子空间的正交补空间中，从而实现任务隔离而不需要部署时的动态路由机制。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100（ResNet-20）和MNIST数据集上的长序列遗忘任务中表现稳定。经过30个顺序遗忘任务后，最先进的静态融合方法将保留准确率从60.39%降至12.70%，而本文提出的训练时约束优化方法维持基线性能（~58.1%）同时保持强遗忘效果。
AI.conclusion: SVD引导的正交子空间投影可有效解决顺序机器遗忘中的参数冲突问题，在无需动态路由的情况下实现稳定的任务隔离，为持续遗忘场景提供了一种高效实用的解决方案。

title: From edges to meaning: Semantic line sketches as a cognitive scaffold for ancient pictograph invention
summary: Humans readily recognize objects from sparse line drawings, a capacity that appears early in development and persists across cultures, suggesting neural rather than purely learned origins. Yet the computational mechanism by which the brain transforms high-level semantic knowledge into low-level visual symbols remains poorly understood. Here we propose that ancient pictographic writing emerged from the brain's intrinsic tendency to compress visual input into stable, boundary-based abstractions. We construct a biologically inspired digital twin of the visual hierarchy that encodes an image into low-level features, generates a contour sketch, and iteratively refines it through top-down feedback guided by semantic representations, mirroring the feedforward and recurrent architecture of the human visual cortex. The resulting symbols bear striking structural resemblance to early pictographs across culturally distant writing systems, including Egyptian hieroglyphs, Chinese oracle bone characters, and proto-cuneiform, and offer candidate interpretations for undeciphered scripts. Our findings support a neuro-computational origin of pictographic writing and establish a framework in which AI can recapitulate the cognitive processes by which humans first externalized perception into symbols.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个受生物启发的视觉层级数字孪生模型，模拟人类视觉皮层的前馈与反馈架构，将图像编码为低维特征并生成轮廓草图。该模型产生的符号与埃及象形文字、中国甲骨文及原始楔形文字等跨文化书写系统中的早期象形符号高度相似，支持象形文字具有神经计算起源的假设。
AI.motivation: 人类能够从稀疏线条绘图中识别物体，这种能力在发育早期即出现且跨越文化普遍存在，提示其具有神经而非纯粹习得的起源。然而，大脑如何将高级语义知识转化为低级视觉符号的计算机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在揭示象形文字书写系统的神经计算起源。
AI.method: 构建了一个受生物启发的视觉层级数字孪生模型。该模型包含三个核心阶段：1) 将图像编码为低级特征表示；2) 生成轮廓草图；3) 通过语义表征引导的自上而下反馈进行迭代优化。该架构镜像了人类视觉皮层的前馈与循环连接模式。
AI.result: 模型生成的符号与跨文化的早期象形文字系统（包括埃及象形文字、中国甲骨文和原始楔形文字）在结构上呈现显著相似性，并可为未解读文字提供候选解释方案。
AI.conclusion: 本研究支持象形书写具有神经计算起源的观点，并建立了一个框架，使AI能够重现人类将感知外化为符号的认知过程，为理解文字起源提供了计算神经科学的新视角。

title: MoshiRAG: Asynchronous Knowledge Retrieval for Full-Duplex Speech Language Models
summary: Speech-to-speech language models have recently emerged to enhance the naturalness of conversational AI. In particular, full-duplex models are distinguished by their real-time interactivity, including handling of pauses, interruptions, and backchannels. However, improving their factuality remains an open challenge. While scaling the model size could address this gap, it would make real-time inference prohibitively expensive. In this work, we propose MoshiRAG, a modular approach that combines a compact full-duplex interface with selective retrieval to access more powerful knowledge sources. Our asynchronous framework enables the model to identify knowledge-demanding queries and ground its responses in external information. By leveraging the natural temporal gap between response onset and the delivery of core information, the retrieval process can be completed while maintaining a natural conversation flow. With this approach, MoshiRAG achieves factuality comparable to the best publicly released non-duplex speech language models while preserving the interactivity inherent to full-duplex systems. Moreover, our flexible design supports plug-and-play retrieval methods without retraining and demonstrates strong performance on out-of-domain mathematical reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: MoshiRAG通过模块化设计将紧凑型全双工接口与选择性检索相结合，在保持实时交互能力的同时提升语音对话模型的事实准确性。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型虽具备实时交互优势（处理停顿、打断、反馈），但其事实性难以保证；扩大模型规模虽能改善但会带来高昂的实时推理成本。
AI.method: 异步框架设计：模型识别知识需求型查询，在响应开始与核心信息传递之间利用自然时间间隙完成检索，支持即插即用多种检索方法而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在保持全双工系统交互性的前提下，实现了与最佳公开非全双工语音语言模型相当的事实性表现，并展示了强大的领域外数学推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 模块化检索增强方案是平衡全双工语音模型事实性与实时性的有效途径，提供了灵活且无需重训练的优化路径。

title: EEG-Based Multimodal Learning via Hyperbolic Mixture-of-Curvature Experts
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based multimodal learning integrates brain signals with complementary modalities to improve mental state assessment, providing great clinical potential. The effectiveness of such paradigms largely depends on the representation learning on heterogeneous modalities. For EEG-based paradigms, one promising approach is to leverage their hierarchical structures, as recent studies have shown that both EEG and associated modalities (e.g., facial expressions) exhibit hierarchical structures reflecting complex cognitive processes. However, Euclidean embeddings struggle to represent these hierarchical structures due to their flat geometry, while hyperbolic spaces, with their exponential growth property, are naturally suited for them. In this work, we propose EEG-MoCE, a novel hyperbolic mixture-of-curvature experts framework designed for multimodal neurotechnology. EEG-MoCE assigns each modality to an expert in a learnable-curvature hyperbolic space, enabling adaptive modeling of its intrinsic geometry. A curvature-aware fusion strategy then dynamically weights experts, emphasizing modalities with richer hierarchical information. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that EEG-MoCE achieves state-of-the-art performance, including emotion recognition, sleep staging, and cognitive assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EEG-MoCE——首个面向 EEG 多模态学习的双曲混合曲率专家框架：每个模态由一个带可学习负曲率的双曲专家独立编码（Lorentz 双曲流形），再通过曲率引导的跨模态注意力（曲率缩放温度 + 曲率先验偏置）在共享融合流形上加权融合，最终用双曲多项逻辑回归分类。在 EAV（情感识别）、ISRUC-S3（睡眠分期）、Cognitive（N-back 认知评估）三个公开数据集的跨被试评估中取得 SOTA：75.88%/75.47%、78.53%/75.38%、62.39%/59.67%（平衡准确率/宏 F1），较最强基线分别提升 14.14%、3.34%、7.98 个百分点。
AI.motivation: EEG 信号易受伪迹干扰、内在结构复杂，仅靠单一模态难以稳健推断心理状态，融合 EEG 与面部表情、语音、EMG/EOG、NIRS 等互补模态成为提升鲁棒性的关键路径。作者指出 EEG 及相关模态（面部表情、生理信号）均存在反映复杂认知过程的层级结构（如皮层下→边缘系统→新皮层的情绪调节通路），而欧氏空间因几何平坦、距离/面积仅随半径线性或二次增长，难以表达层级结构的指数增长；负曲率双曲空间具有指数体积增长特性，天然适合树状层级数据。已有双曲 EEG 工作（如 HEEGNet）仅针对单模态且使用固定曲率，而不同模态的层级强度差异明显，因此需要"每模态自适应曲率 + 曲率驱动的跨模态融合"，这也是本文的首要动机。
AI.method: 整体为四级组合式架构：①模态专属欧氏编码器 e_θ^{(m)}——EEG 用 EEGNet（时间卷积频率滤波、深度可分离空间卷积电极模式、可分离时间卷积），EMG/EOG 用类 EEGNet 的 CNN，视频用轻量 CNN + 时间 Transformer，音频用 mel 频谱 1D-CNN + 时间 Transformer；②混合曲率专家 E_φ^{(m)}——每个模态通过原点处指数映射提升到各自的 Lorentz 流形 L^d_{K^(m)}（K^(m)<0 为可学习曲率，初始化 -2），随后进行双曲批归一化（HBN，基于 gyrovector 的中心化/缩放，含域特定动量统计与曲率自适应 running statistics 变换，以缓解跨被试分布漂移）、Lorentz 激活、Fréchet 均值池化；③曲率导向跨模态融合 F_ω——各模态表示经 log-exp 映射（带 √(K^(m)/K_f) 缩放，保持距离序关系）投影到共享融合流形 L^d_{K_f}（K_f 取各模态曲率均值），采用双曲跨模态注意力：以负平方测地距离为相似度，温度按曲率缩放 τ^(m)=τ_0/√|K^(m)|，并加入可学习的曲率先验偏置 λ·log(|K^(j)|+ε)（λ 经 softplus 参数化保证为正，仅在第一层施加以保留模态顺序信息），多头与跨模态聚合均用加权 Fréchet 均值，配双曲层归一化；④双曲分类器 g_ψ——Lorentz 全连接后用双曲多项逻辑回归（以测地超平面为决策边界）。训练用交叉熵，欧氏参数用 Adam、双曲参数用 Riemannian Adam，100 epoch、lr=1e-3、patience=20 早停，PyTorch + RTX 4090。此外，作者用直径归一化的 δ-超曲率 δ_rel（基于 Gromov 积与四点条件）量化各模态层级性，并分析学习到的曲率与注意力贡献度的一致性。
AI.result: 主实验（跨被试，EAV/ISRUC 采用 10 折分组交叉验证或留一被试，Cognitive 采用 10 折）：EAV 情感识别 Acc 75.88±8.31 / F1 75.47±8.66，超越 HEEGNet（61.74/60.48）达 14.14%/14.99%（p≪0.01）；ISRUC 睡眠分期 78.53±2.95 / 75.38±4.05，较 XSleepFusion（75.19/73.62）提升 3.34% 且方差更低；Cognitive N-back 62.39±13.07 / 59.67±59.67（vs EF-Net 54.41/51.47，提升 7.98%）；附录中 Word Generation 任务亦达 73.65/73.36（vs ST2A 67.27/66.64）。层级分析显示所有模态 δ_rel<0.3（EEG 最小 0.097~0.202，原始特征低于编码后特征，说明欧氏编码会破坏层级结构）；EAV 上学习曲率 |K| 与 δ_rel 呈负相关、与注意力贡献度呈正相关（EEG |K|=2.34、贡献 36.0%；Vision 2.29/33.6%；Audio 1.91/30.5%），曲率先验 λ 从 0.30 上升至 0.464/0.533/0.332，验证曲率导向融合设计。消融显示双曲编码器+双曲融合组合最优（75.88），纯欧氏仅 60.33；可学习曲率较固定曲率带来 2.14% 增益，COMF 较无曲率先验注意力带来 1.38% 增益；单模态中 EEG 最优（62.74%），融合超最佳单模态 13.14%；融合曲率取均值优于可学习版本，并与优化法估计值在 ±0.005 等价界内一致（TOST）。5 随机种子实验结果稳定（EAV 75.79±0.78）。计算开销较高：训练 26.07 s/epoch、推理 2.71 ms/trial（20 秒 trial），绝对延迟仍满足实时部署。
AI.conclusion: EEG-MoCE 是首个针对 EEG 多模态生理信号的层级性系统分析与双曲框架，其"每模态可学习曲率专家 + 曲率导向融合"设计在三任务上均获 SOTA，并从 δ-超曲率、学习曲率与模态贡献度的一致性两方面提供了机制性证据，说明几何感知的层级建模能有效挖掘跨模态协同。局限与未来方向：目前仅聚焦双曲几何及具备层级结构的模态，可拓展至具有其他结构先验的模态；双曲运算的计算稳定性与开销有待优化；统一融合流形的方案虽经验有效，但可探索更丰富的融合与测地传输机制；学习表征的可解释性有待深入，以揭示其背后的认知机制。代码开源于 https://github.com/zhourunhe/EEG-MoCE。

title: QuarkMedSearch: A Long-Horizon Deep Search Agent for Exploring Medical Intelligence
summary: As agentic foundation models continue to evolve, how to further improve their performance in vertical domains has become an important challenge. To this end, building upon Tongyi DeepResearch, a powerful agentic foundation model, we focus on the Chinese medical deep search scenario and propose QuarkMedSearch, systematically exploring a full-pipeline approach spanning medical multi-hop data construction, training strategies, and evaluation benchmarks to further push and assess its performance upper bound in vertical domains. Specifically, for data synthesis, to address the scarcity of deep search training data in the medical domain, we combine a large-scale medical knowledge graph with real-time online exploration to construct long-horizon medical deep search training data; for post-training, we adopt a two-stage SFT and RL training strategy that progressively enhances the model's planning, tool invocation, and reflection capabilities required for deep search, while maintaining search efficiency; for evaluation, we collaborate with medical experts to construct the QuarkMedSearch Benchmark through rigorous manual verification. Experimental results demonstrate that QuarkMedSearch achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models of comparable scale on the QuarkMedSearch Benchmark, while also maintaining strong competitiveness on general benchmarks.

AI.tldr: QuarkMedSearch 是基于通义深度研究（Tongyi DeepResearch, 30B-A3B）构建的中文医疗长程深度搜索智能体框架，覆盖"数据合成—后训练—评测基准"全链路：四阶段医疗深度搜索数据合成流水线（知识图谱长尾实体采样→在线多跳真实事实引入→实体混淆→唯一性/正确性校验）、两阶段 SFT + RLVR 后训练配方，以及与医学专家共建的 140 题 QuarkMedSearch Benchmark。模型在自建基准上取得 55.71 分，与 GLM-5（744B）相当，显著超越同规模开源模型（基座 40.71），并在 BrowseComp-EN/ZH、Xbench DeepSearch 上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 智能体基础模型（GPT-5、Claude Opus、Gemini 3.1、GLM-5、Kimi-K2.5 等）已将长程规划与工具编排置于核心位置，但垂直领域能力提升仍是难题。医疗深搜研究处于早期：训练数据以通用域为主，中文医疗长程高难数据严重匮乏，现有医疗深搜模型在 BrowseComp 级任务上因交互轮次短、数据源狭窄（仅 PubMed 等英文文献库）、依赖离线检索而表现不佳；且前沿模型已将大量医学知识内化于参数中，可直接凭记忆作答，削弱了深检索与长程推理的训练信号。同时评测也滞后：MedBrowseComp、MedXpertQA 等往往限定于特定官网或固定检索通道，强调内化知识与短程推理，缺少面向开放医疗环境、考察多轮工具使用与动态检索策略调整的长程智能体基准。此外，如何把通用智能体能力有效迁移到专业领域（如严格的事实准确性、权威来源、可解释推理链要求）也是未解问题。
AI.method:
**1) 问题形式化**：将深度搜索建模为序列决策，采用 ReAct 框架，交互为 (thought, action, observation) 三元组交替；动作空间含 search / visit / answer 三类工具。

**2) 四阶段渐进式数据合成**（构建数万条长程医疗深搜任务）：
- 阶段一：基于自建大规模医疗知识图谱（融合真实互联网医疗资源与数百万专业医书语料，覆盖疾病、药物、基因靶点、解剖结构等），按入度/出度分层采样长尾稀有实体（缓解模型对高频概念的参数化内化偏置），沿最长语义路径（症状表现、并发症、禁忌、饮食建议等）扩展 4–6 跳子图，以终端实体为答案、子图多跳条件为题干，用 LLM 转为自然语言问答，并经多个闭源前沿模型一致性校验。
- 阶段二：基于 WebExplorer 扩展的多跳真实事实引入模块，提供 Search、Visit、Medical Professional Search（强调来源权威性与时效性）、LLM Check（调用 Qwen 系列最强模型无工具直答以判定参数记忆可解性）四工具，闭环推进；推理跳数超过 10 跳且通过"检索必要性"校验方被采纳。
- 阶段三：实体混淆，按实体类型差异化替换（时间→时间范围描述、地点→功能描述、人物→职业/关系描述、医学术语→症状/病理描述、数值→相对或区间表述），并引入多轮自迭代检查表优化（替换自然度、覆盖完整性、难度有效性、答案唯一性），强制至少 5 轮迭代。
- 阶段四：唯一性与正确性保证——单模型多次 rollout 一致性验证 + 跨异构智能体模型交叉验证 + 因 API/解析失败而误杀样本的数据回收。

**3) 后训练**：轨迹由多个前沿智能体模型 rollout 采样，每题选最短正确轨迹；规则过滤（错误动作、格式异常、n-gram 重复/暴力搜索、循环推理）+ 维度化 rubric 过滤（意图规划、工具调用、信息整合含医学术语规范/来源权威性/时效性、事实严谨性为硬约束，事实错误直接 0 分）。两阶段 SFT：≤32K 短轨迹建立"思考—搜索—观察—总结"行为范式，再以 32K–128K 长轨迹续训并保留 20% 短样本；第二阶段 RLVR 采用 GRPO（去 KL、token 级策略损失、clip-higher）、Truncated Importance Sampling 与 Route Replay 缓解训推不一致，组内优势归一化；奖励为严格门控（format∧correct=1.0；¬format∧correct=0.8；否则 0）以抑制 reward hacking；RL 数据做难度过滤（剔除过易/过难）并混入通用域数据。环境含离线（2024 Wiki dump + 医学文献本地向量索引）与在线（Google Search API + 内部医学垂直搜索 + 在线阅读引擎）两套，配合异步 rollout 流水线避免长尾序列造成的训练气泡。

**4) 基准构建**：数据来自开源高难医疗题筛选（BrowseComp、HLE）与流水线合成题，按实体级别与训练集严格隔离防污染；医学专家逐题人工审核语言清晰度、难度（不可仅凭参数记忆作答）、ground truth 正确性与唯一性；按核心实体分六类（生物医学基础、药物与医疗产品、医学研究与知识、疾病与临床表现、临床操作与流程、医疗机构），做分层采样平衡。

**5) 推理侧**：上下文超阈值时采用 Discard-all 策略（清空历史工具调用记录，仅保留原问题与最小任务描述重启推理），参考 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 Kimi-K2.5。
AI.result:
**医疗域基准（Table 3）**：QuarkMedSearch 55.71（30B-A3B），显著高于同规模开源的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（43.57）、Qwen3.5-27B（44.28）与基座 Tongyi DeepResearch（40.71，+15.0）；与大规模模型相当或更优（Seed1.8 55.71、Kimi-K2.5 56.74、DeepSeek-V3.2 57.14、GLM-5 58.57）。

**通用深搜基准（Table 4, w/o ctm）**：BrowseComp-EN 47.03、BrowseComp-ZH 57.55、Xbench DeepSearch 81.0，均超过同规模开源基线（WebResearcher 37.3/45.2/71.0、WebSailorV2 35.3/44.1/73.7、REDSearcher 42.1/49.8、Tongyi DeepResearch 43.4/46.7/75.0、SMTL-100 43.6/-/80.0）。

**两阶段 SFT 消融（Table 5）**：基座 40.71/42.67/45.40 → Stage-I(32K) 49.99/43.23/49.40 → Stage-II(128K) 52.21/45.47/55.36，即第二阶段在 QuarkMedSearch、BrowseComp-EN、BrowseComp-ZH 上分别 +2.22、+2.24、+5.96。

**RL 动态（Table 6, Fig.6）**：响应长度持续下降同时奖励上升；终止率 BrowseComp-ZH 0.676→0.725、EN 0.580→0.635；答对时平均工具调用 ZH 28.09→24.01、EN 40.03→37.12；RL 相对两阶段 SFT 在 ZH/EN 上再 +2.19/+1.56。奖励消融（Fig.7）："correct+format"策略下 format 分单调上升而 correct 分震荡（典型 reward hacking），严格门控策略下 correct 分稳定上升。

**上下文管理（Table 7）**：Discard-all 使 BrowseComp-EN/ZH 提升 +10.58/+9.58（至 57.61/67.13），追平或超过 MiroThinker-V1.5、REDSearcher、Qwen3.5-27B/35B-A3B 等同规模带 ctm 模型。

**数据难度**：合成集与 BrowseComp 的平均工具调用数为 27.2 vs 32.3，分布形态相近。**业务迁移**：将长答案 Deep Research 样本与长程深搜样本混合训练后，专家人工评测 G:S:B = 48.9%:23.4%:27.7%，融合模型被偏好或持平占 72.3%。**案例**：附录 B 展示一条 29 次工具调用的多跳医疗推理链（NB-UVB 311nm → 嘧啶二聚体 → NER → XPF/ERCC4=FANCQ → FANCD2/FA-D2 → 2025 年 DEK 抑制研究 → 重医附二院"中西医结合旗舰医院建设项目"）。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出将智能体长程深搜能力迁移到中文医疗垂直领域的可复现全流程参考：长链数据合成（知识图谱 + 在线搜索 + 实体混淆 + 多模型校验）、SFT+RLVR 后训练配方（含严格门控奖励抑制 reward hacking、Discard-all 上下文管理）、以及专家共建的 140 题六分类基准。结果表明中等规模模型（30B-A3B）经领域化训练即可在医疗深搜上媲美参数量大数倍的通用模型，并在通用深搜基准上不牺牲能力；长程深搜能力亦可低成本迁移到开放式医疗研究报告生成等真实业务场景。局限方面：基准规模有限（140 题）、依赖闭源模型与人工专家、评测受实时网络与提示模板影响较大，且 RL 阶段对环境稳定性与超长序列训练效率要求较高。

title: GlotOCR Bench: OCR Models Still Struggle Beyond a Handful of Unicode Scripts
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) has advanced rapidly with the rise of vision-language models, yet evaluation has remained concentrated on a small cluster of high- and mid-resource scripts. We introduce GlotOCR Bench, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating OCR generalization across 100+ Unicode scripts. Our benchmark comprises clean and degraded image variants rendered from real multilingual texts. Images are rendered using fonts from the Google Fonts repository, shaped with HarfBuzz and rasterized with FreeType, supporting both LTR and RTL scripts. Samples of rendered images were manually reviewed to verify correct rendering across all scripts. We evaluate a broad suite of open-weight and proprietary vision-language models and find that most perform well on fewer than ten scripts, and even the strongest frontier models fail to generalize beyond thirty scripts. Performance broadly tracks script-level pretraining coverage, suggesting that current OCR systems rely on language model pretraining as much as on visual recognition. Models confronted with unfamiliar scripts either produce random noise or hallucinate characters from similar scripts they already know. We release the benchmark and pipeline for reproducibility. Pipeline Code: https://github.com/cisnlp/glotocr-bench, Benchmark: https://hf.co/datasets/cis-lmu/glotocr-bench.

AI.tldr: GlotOCR Bench是一个评估OCR系统在100+Unicode脚本上泛化能力的综合基准测试。研究发现大多数模型仅在不到10个脚本上表现良好，即使最强模型也难以泛化到30个以上脚本。性能与预训练覆盖范围高度相关，不熟悉脚本会导致模型产生噪声或幻觉字符。
AI.motivation: 当前OCR评估主要集中在高资源和中等资源语言脚本上，缺乏对多样化脚本的全面评估。现有评估无法反映模型在真实世界多语言场景中的泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建包含100+ Unicode脚本的基准测试，采用Google Fonts字体库、HarfBuzz文本整形和FreeType栅格化工具渲染清晰和退化图像变体，支持LTR和RTL脚本，样本经人工审核验证正确渲染。评估了多种开源和闭源视觉-语言模型。
AI.result: 大多数模型仅在不到10个脚本上表现良好，即使最强前沿模型也难以泛化到30个以上脚本。性能与脚本级别的预训练覆盖范围高度相关。模型面对不熟悉脚本时会生成随机噪声或幻觉相似脚本的字符。
AI.conclusion: 当前OCR系统不仅依赖视觉识别能力，同样依赖语言模型预训练。模型在不熟悉脚本上的失败模式表明缺乏有效的零样本泛化能力。该基准测试为未来多语言OCR研究提供了标准化评估框架。

title: KumoRFM-2: Scaling Foundation Models for Relational Learning
summary: We introduce KumoRFM-2, the next iteration of a pre-trained foundation model for relational data. KumoRFM-2 supports in-context learning as well as fine-tuning and is applicable to a wide range of predictive tasks. In contrast to tabular foundation models, KumoRFM-2 natively operates on relational data, processing one or more connected tables simultaneously without manual table flattening or target variable generation, all while preserving temporal consistency. KumoRFM-2 leverages a large corpus of synthetic and real-world data to pre-train across four axes: the row and column dimensions at the individual table level, and the foreign key and cross-sample dimensions at the database level. In contrast to its predecessor, KumoRFM-2 injects task information as early as possible, enabling sharper selection of task-relevant columns and improved robustness to noisy data. Through extensive experiments on 41 challenging benchmarks and analysis around expressivity and sensitivity, we demonstrate that KumoRFM-2 outperforms supervised and foundational approaches by up to 8%, while maintaining strong performance under extreme settings of cold start and noisy data. To our knowledge, this is the first time a few-shot foundation model has been shown to surpass supervised approaches on common benchmark tasks, with performance further improving upon fine-tuning. Finally, while KumoRFM-1 was limited to small-scale in-memory datasets, KumoRFM-2 scales to billion-scale relational datasets.

AI.tldr: KumoRFM-2是一个关系数据预训练基础模型，支持上下文学习和微调，可处理多个连接的表而不需要手动展平。它在四个维度（行、列、外键、跨样本）上进行预训练，并在41个基准测试中优于监督和基础方法达8%，首次实现少样本基础模型超越监督方法的性能，同时可扩展到十亿级数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型需要手动展平关系数据且无法保留时间一致性；KumoRFM-1仅支持小规模内存数据集；需要在保持表间关系的同时实现跨数据库的泛化能力，并解决冷启动和噪声数据问题。
AI.method: 利用大规模合成和真实世界数据，在四个轴上进行预训练：表级别的行维度和列维度，数据库级别的外键维度和跨样本维度；尽早注入任务信息以实现更精确的任务相关列选择。
AI.result: 在41个挑战性基准测试中表现优异，比监督和基础方法提升高达8%；首次实现少样本基础模型超越监督方法；Fine-tuning后性能进一步提升；在极端冷启动和噪声数据条件下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: KumoRFM-2是首个在大规模关系数据上超越监督方法的少样本基础模型，具备良好的可扩展性（支持十亿级数据集）和鲁棒性，为关系数据分析提供了新的基础模型范式。

title: LIFE -- an energy efficient advanced continual learning agentic AI framework for frontier systems
summary: The rapid advancement of AI has changed the character of HPC usage such as dimensioning, provisioning, and execution. Not only has energy demand been amplified, but existing rudimentary continual learning capabilities limit ability of AI to effectively manage HPCs. This paper reviews emerging directions beyond monolithic transformers, emphasizing agentic AI and brain inspired architectures as complementary paths toward sustainable, adaptive systems. We propose LIFE, a reasoning and Learning framework that is Incremental, Flexible, and Energy efficient that is implemented as an agent centric system rather than a single monolithic model. LIFE uniquely combines four components to realize self evolving network management and operations in HPCs. The components are an orchestrator, Agentic Context Engineering, a novel memory system, and information lattice learning. LIFE can also generalize to enable a variety of orthogonal use cases. We ground LIFE in a specific closed loop HPC operations example for detecting and mitigating latency spikes experienced by critical micro services running on a Kubernetes like cluster.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述兼框架提案论文，面向HPC（高性能计算）场景中AI系统能耗高、维度膨胀、持续学习能力弱的问题，提出名为LIFE（Incremental、Flexible、Energy-efficient）的智能体中心（agent-centric）框架。LIFE由四大组件构成：编排器（orchestrator）、Agentic Context Engineering（智能体上下文工程）、新型记忆系统，以及信息晶格学习（information lattice learning）。该框架定位为超越单体Transformer的补充路径，结合智能体AI与类脑架构，以实现自演进的HPC网络管理与运维，并以Kubernetes类集群上关键微服务延迟尖峰的检测与缓解作为闭环验证示例。
AI.motivation: AI的快速发展重塑了HPC的使用形态：资源维度扩展、资源供给（provisioning）方式与执行模式均发生改变，同时能耗需求被显著放大。更关键的是，现有AI模型仅具备初步、粗糙的持续学习（continual learning）能力，难以在动态变化、规模庞大的HPC环境中有效地进行管理与调度。因此需要一种可自适应、可持续演进且节能的AI管理机制。作者同时指出，当前研究过度聚焦于单体（monolithic）Transformer模型的扩展，而忽略了智能体化（agentic）AI与类脑（brain-inspired）架构这两条互补路径；本文旨在填补这一空白，提出面向HPC可持续自适应系统的统一框架。
AI.method: 方法上采用"综述+框架设计"结合的路线：（1）回顾并梳理超越单体Transformer的emerging directions，重点归纳agentic AI与brain-inspired architectures两条互补研究脉络；（2）提出LIFE框架，将系统实现为智能体中心（agent-centric）的多智能体系统，而非单一模型；（3）组合四个核心组件——orchestrator负责总体协调与闭环控制，Agentic Context Engineering负责构建/演化上下文，novel memory system提供跨时间步的知识与经验存储与检索，information lattice learning承担信息结构化学习与推理；（4）以HPC运维闭环为具体落地示例（Kubernetes-like集群上关键微服务延迟尖峰的检测与缓解），说明框架的可行性与泛化性；（5）论证LIFE可通过"generalize"机制扩展至多种正交（orthogonal）用例。
AI.result: 从摘要给出的结果看，LIFE通过将编排器、Agentic Context Engineering、记忆系统与信息晶格学习四者耦合，实现了面向HPC的自演进（self-evolving）网络管理与运维能力，并在一个具体的闭环运维场景（Kubernetes-like集群中关键微服务延迟尖峰的检测与缓解）中完成概念验证。论文同时表明LIFE不局限于该单一场景，可泛化支持一系列正交的用例方向。摘要未提供量化的性能、能耗或精度指标，说明其当前贡献主要在框架构想与概念验证层面。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为，agentic AI与类脑架构是实现可持续、自适应AI系统的关键互补路径，二者均不应被单体Transformer的规模扩展所取代。以智能体为中心的LIFE框架，通过编排器、上下文工程、记忆与信息晶格学习的协同，为HPC的能耗控制与持续学习缺失问题提供了统一解法，并已在微服务延迟尖峰治理的闭环示例中展示潜力；未来工作需在真实集群上开展定量评测、能耗量化与规模化实验。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: DDTree（Diffusion Draft Tree）将块扩散草稿模型（DFlash）单次前向输出的逐位置边缘分布直接构造为草稿树，用最佳优先堆算法在固定节点预算下选出最优（可证明最大化代理接受长度）的树，再通过祖先注意力掩码在目标模型单次前向中完成树验证。实验显示在 10 个数据集 × 3 个目标模型 × 2 个温度共 60 种设置下全部优于原始 DFlash，接受长度与端到端加速均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码逐 token 串行，是推理延迟的主要来源。推测解码（speculative decoding）用轻量草稿器提出多个候选 token 由大目标模型并行验证，但效果取决于草稿质量与开销的平衡。DFlash 证明块扩散草稿器可在单次前向内生成整个草稿块，性能超过 EAGLE-3 等强自回归草稿器；但原始 DFlash 每轮只验证一条草稿轨迹，未能利用单次前向在每个未来位置上给出的多个边缘分布（每位置仅是边缘分布，非路径条件分布），限制了接受长度。多分支探索可提高接受率，但会线性增加验证成本，抵消加速收益，因此关键在于如何从逐位置分布中挑出"最值得验证"的延续。
AI.method: 1) 背景形式化：块扩散草稿器单次前向给出 L 个位置的边缘分布 q_i，目标模型为路径条件自回归分布 p；由边缘分布诱导出因子化分布 Q(y_{1:L}|c,b)=∏_i q_i(y_i|c,b)，作为可优化的代理。2) 代理目标：定义树的接受长度 α_T 为采样延续在树中匹配的最长前缀深度，目标为在 |T|≤B 且前缀闭包约束下最大化 E_{Y~Q}[α_T(Y)]。3) 理论结果（命题1）：该期望可分解为树上节点前缀概率之和 Σ_{u∈T} q(u|c,b)；（命题2）取概率最高的 B 个前缀自动前缀闭包且最优；（引理1）最优树可限制在每深度 top-K 令牌集合 S_K 内。4) 算法1：以 log 概率为堆键的最佳优先搜索，每次弹出生成"下一个兄弟"与"第一个孩子"两个候选，弹出 B 次即得最优树，复杂度 O(B log B)。5) 验证：树展平为 token 序列，按深度赋位置 id，采用 tree attention（节点仅关注根、祖先与自身）在目标模型单次前向中打分全部分支；随后按目标模型解码规则沿树行走，匹配则接受并继续，首个不匹配 token 作为下一轮 bonus token，KV cache 压缩至已接受路径。6) 实现基于 Hugging Face Transformers，节点预算取 {16,32,64,128,256,512,1024}。与 OPT-Tree（需每深度一次草稿前向）及 DART（依赖外部 N-gram 连续性剪枝与 trie）相比，DDTree 无需额外外部评分机制，且最优性可证明。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct 三个目标模型上，覆盖 MATH-500、GSM8K、AIME 2024/2025、HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、SWE-bench Lite、MT-Bench、Alpaca 共 10 个数据集，温度 0.0 与 1.0 全部 60 种组合中 DDTree 均优于 DFlash。温度 0.0 时如 AIME 2024 上 4B：5.56×→7.54×（τ 7.27→10.37），8B：7.35×→10.42×（τ 7.35→10.42）；Coder-30B：5.93×→7.87×。温度 1.0 提升同样稳定（如 HumanEval 4B 4.34×→6.43×，τ 5.97→9.18）。预算-质量权衡研究（MATH-500, Qwen3-8B, T=0）显示接受长度随预算单调增长，而加速在 B=256~512 达峰，B=1024 时验证开销超过收益；同样"概念预算"下 DDTree 优于 DFlash 的单块 16 节点。接受长度直方图显示 DDTree 将概率质量明显移向更长前缀（<4 的接受长度大幅减少，16 的整块接受更常见），故每生成 token 所需轮次更少。实验在 8 张 H200 上以 bfloat16 运行，块大小 16，最大生成 2048 token；DDTree 目标模型使用标准 PyTorch SDPA（FlashAttention-2 不支持树注意力模式），而基线取两种后端中更快的更优结果以保证公平。
AI.conclusion: DDTree 将块扩散草稿器的"单次前向多位置边缘分布"这一被浪费的信息转化为可在单次目标模型前向中验证的紧凑草稿树，在给定节点预算下可证明地最大化草稿模型下的期望接受长度（作为目标模型期望接受长度的代理），并以 O(B log B) 的极低额外开销实现，优于需要多次草稿前向的 OPT-Tree 与依赖外部 N-gram 剪枝的 DART。实验证实其在多模型、多领域、多温度下一致提升端到端加速与接受长度，使 DDTree 位居当前最优推测解码方法之列。作者同时明确该最优性仅针对代理目标而非真实目标模型分布，且最优预算随硬件与实现而变；同时把使用标准 SDPA 而非 FlashAttention-2 作为已知局限。未来方向可包括以更贴近目标分布的条件概率改进代理目标、动态/自适应预算，以及更高效的树注意力内核实现。

title: SOAR: Self-Correction for Optimal Alignment and Refinement in Diffusion Models
summary: The post-training pipeline for diffusion models currently has two stages: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated data and reinforcement learning (RL) with reward models. A fundamental gap separates them. SFT optimizes the denoiser only on ground-truth states sampled from the forward noising process; once inference deviates from these ideal states, subsequent denoising relies on out-of-distribution generalization rather than learned correction, exhibiting the same exposure bias that afflicts autoregressive models, but accumulated along the denoising trajectory instead of the token sequence. RL can in principle address this mismatch, yet its terminal reward signal is sparse, suffers from credit-assignment difficulty, and risks reward hacking. We propose SOAR (Self-Correction for Optimal Alignment and Refinement), a bias-correction post-training method that fills this gap. Starting from a real sample, SOAR performs a single stop-gradient rollout with the current model, re-noises the resulting off-trajectory state, and supervises the model to steer back toward the original clean target. The method is on-policy, reward-free, and provides dense per-timestep supervision with no credit-assignment problem. On SD3.5-Medium, SOAR improves GenEval from 0.70 to 0.78 and OCR from 0.64 to 0.67 over SFT, while simultaneously raising all model-based preference scores. In controlled reward-specific experiments, SOAR surpasses Flow-GRPO in final metric value on both aesthetic and text-image alignment tasks, despite having no access to a reward model. Since SOAR's base loss subsumes the standard SFT objective, it can directly replace SFT as a stronger first post-training stage after pretraining, while remaining fully compatible with subsequent RL alignment.

AI.tldr: SOAR是一种用于扩散模型的后训练方法，通过自校正机制填补监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）之间的训练-推理差距，无需奖励模型即可实现密集的每时间步监督，有效缓解暴露偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散模型的两阶段后训练流程（SFT + RL）存在根本性缺陷：SFT仅在从正向加噪过程采样的真实状态下优化去噪器，推理时一旦偏离这些理想状态，后续去噪就依赖于分布外泛化，产生了沿去噪轨迹累积的暴露偏差。RL虽可理论上解决此问题，但存在奖励信号稀疏、信贷分配困难和奖励黑客风险等问题。
AI.method: SOAR从真实样本出发，使用当前模型执行单次停止梯度 rollout，将产生的偏离轨迹状态重新加噪，然后监督模型使其能够将偏离状态引导回原始干净目标。该方法具有on-policy特性，无需奖励模型，提供密集的每时间步监督信号，完全避免信贷分配问题。由于SOAR的基础损失包含标准SFT目标，因此可直接作为预训练后的更强第一阶段后训练方法。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-Medium上，SOAR将GenEval从0.70提升至0.78，OCR从0.64提升至0.67，均优于SFT，并同时提高了所有基于模型的偏好分数。在受控的奖励专项实验中，SOAR在美学和文图对齐任务上超越了Flow-GRPO，尽管其不依赖奖励模型。
AI.conclusion: SOAR成功填补了SFT与RL之间的训练-推理差距，提供了一种reward-free、dense supervision的自校正机制，可直接替代SFT作为更强的后训练第一阶段，并与后续RL对齐完全兼容。

title: AISafetyBenchExplorer: A Metric-Aware Catalogue of AI Safety Benchmarks Reveals Fragmented Measurement and Weak Benchmark Governance
summary: The rapid expansion of large language model (LLM) safety evaluation has produced a substantial benchmark ecosystem, but not a correspondingly coherent measurement ecosystem. We present AISafetyBenchExplorer, a structured catalogue of 195 AI safety benchmarks released between 2018 and 2026, organized through a multi-sheet schema that records benchmark-level metadata, metric-level definitions, benchmark-paper metadata, and repository activity. This design enables meta-analysis not only of what benchmarks exist, but also of how safety is operationalized, aggregated, and judged across the literature. Using the updated catalogue, we identify a central structural problem: benchmark proliferation has outpaced measurement standardization. The current landscape is dominated by medium-complexity benchmarks (94/195), while only 7 benchmarks occupy the Popular tier. The workbook further reports strong concentration around English-only evaluation (165/195), evaluation-only resources (170/195), stale GitHub repositories (137/195), stale Hugging Face datasets (96/195), and heavy reliance on arXiv preprints among benchmarks with known venue metadata. At the metric level, the catalogue shows that familiar labels such as accuracy, F1 score, safety score, and aggregate benchmark scores often conceal materially different judges, aggregation rules, and threat models. We argue that the field's main failure mode is fragmentation rather than scarcity. Researchers now have many benchmark artifacts, but they often lack a shared measurement language, a principled basis for benchmark selection, and durable stewardship norms for post publication maintenance. AISafetyBenchExplorer addresses this gap by providing a traceable benchmark catalogue, a controlled metadata schema, and a complexity taxonomy that together support more rigorous benchmark discovery, comparison, and meta-evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AISafetyBenchExplorer，一个包含195个AI安全基准测试的结构化目录（2018-2026年），用于系统分析AI安全评估生态。研究发现当前领域的主要问题是"碎片化"而非"匮乏"：基准测试数量虽多，但缺乏统一的测量语言、基准选择原则和持续的维护规范。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM安全评估的快速发展，基准测试生态系统迅速扩张，但测量标准化程度严重滞后。研究者面临选择困难：面对众多基准测试，缺乏系统性的比较框架和选择依据。此外，表面相似的指标（如accuracy、F1 score）背后可能隐藏着完全不同的评判标准、聚合规则和威胁模型。
AI.method: 研究团队构建了一个多工作表结构化目录，记录了基准测试级别元数据、指标级别定义、论文元数据以及代码仓库活跃度等四类信息。通过这一受控元数据模式，对195个AI安全基准测试进行了系统性分析，并提出了复杂度分类体系。
AI.result: 主要发现：（1）中等复杂度基准测试占主导地位（94/195），仅7个达到Popular层级；（2）强英语偏向（165/195仅支持英语）；（3）评估导向明显（170/195为评估资源）；（4）GitHub仓库维护不足（137个处于stale状态）；（5）Hugging Face数据集同样存在陈旧问题（96个）。
AI.conclusion: AI安全评估领域面临的核心挑战是碎片化而非稀缺性。现有基准测试缺乏共享的测量语言、原则性的选择标准和可持续的维护规范。AISafetyBenchExplorer通过提供可追溯的基准目录、受控元数据模式和复杂度分类法，为更严格的基准测试发现、比较和元评估提供了基础设施支持。

title: Calibration-Aware Policy Optimization for Reasoning LLMs
comment: Published as a conference paper at ACL 2026
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) enhances LLM reasoning but often induces overconfidence, where incorrect responses yield lower perplexity than correct ones, degrading relative calibration as described by the Area Under the Curve (AUC). Existing approaches either yield limited improvements in calibration or sacrifice gains in reasoning accuracy. We first prove that this degradation in GRPO-style algorithms stems from their uncertainty-agnostic advantage estimation, which inevitably misaligns optimization gradients with calibration. This leads to improved accuracy at the expense of degraded calibration. We then propose Calibration-Aware Policy Optimization (CAPO). It adopts a logistic AUC surrogate loss that is theoretically consistent and admits regret bound, enabling uncertainty-aware advantage estimation. By further incorporating a noise masking mechanism, CAPO achieves stable learning dynamics that jointly optimize calibration and accuracy. Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that CAPO-1.5B significantly improves calibration by up to 15% while achieving accuracy comparable to or better than GRPO, and further boosts accuracy on downstream inference-time scaling tasks by up to 5%. Moreover, when allowed to abstain under low-confidence conditions, CAPO achieves a Pareto-optimal precision-coverage trade-off, highlighting its practical value for hallucination mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对GRPO在LLM推理训练中导致的过度自信问题进行分析，提出根本原因在于其不确定性无关的优势估计方法。通过引入基于logistic AUC损失函数的CAPO方法，实现不确定性感知优势估计，在保持甚至提升推理精度的同时显著改善校准性能，并在低置信度拒答场景下展示出幻觉缓解的实用价值。
AI.motivation: GRPO在提升LLM数学推理能力的同时，会导致模型过度自信——错误回答的困惑度反而低于正确答案，使相对校准性能(AUC指标)退化。现有方法要么校准改进有限，要么以牺牲推理精度为代价。因此需要一种能同时优化精度和校准的新方法。
AI.method: (1) 理论证明GRPO类算法中不确定性无关的优势估计必然导致优化梯度与校准目标错位；(2) 提出CAPO，采用logistic AUC替代损失函数，具备理论一致性和后悔边界，实现不确定性感知优势估计；(3) 引入噪声掩码机制确保学习稳定性；(4) 最终实现精度与校准的联合优化。
AI.result: 在多个数学推理基准测试中，CAPO-1.5B在校准性能上提升高达15%，同时保持与GRPO相当或更优的推理精度；在推理时扩展任务中精度进一步提升5%；在低置信度拒答设置下实现了精确率-召回率的Pareto最优权衡。
AI.conclusion: CAPO通过不确定性感知优势估计有效解决了GRPO的校准退化问题，为LLM对齐训练提供了一种精度与校准协同优化的有效范式，其拒答机制在幻觉缓解方面具有实际应用价值。

title: BEAM: Bi-level Memory-adaptive Algorithmic Evolution for LLM-Powered Heuristic Design
summary: Large Language Model-based Hyper Heuristic (LHH) has recently emerged as an efficient way for automatic heuristic design. However, most existing LHHs just perform well in optimizing a single function within a pre-defined solver. Their single-layer evolution makes them not effective enough to write a competent complete solver. While some variants incorporate hyperparameter tuning or attempt to generate complex code through iterative local modifications, they still lack a high-level algorithmic modeling, leading to limited exploration efficiency. To address this, we reformulate heuristic design as a Bi-level Optimization problem and propose \textbf{BEAM} (Bi-level Memory-adaptive Algorithmic Evolution). BEAM's exterior layer evolves high-level algorithmic structures with function placeholders through genetic algorithm (GA), while the interior layer realizes these placeholders via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). We further introduce an Adaptive Memory module to facilitate complex code generation. To support the evaluation for complex code generation, we point out the limitations of starting LHHs from scratch or from code templates and introduce a Knowledge Augmentation (KA) Pipeline. Experimental results on several optimization problems demonstrate that BEAM significantly outperforms existing LHHs, notably reducing the optimality gap by 37.84\% on aggregate in CVRP hybrid algorithm design. BEAM also designs a heuristic that outperforms SOTA Maximum Independent Set (MIS) solver KaMIS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEAM，一种基于双层优化的LLM驱动超启发式方法。外层使用遗传算法进化高层算法结构，内层通过蒙特卡洛树搜索实现具体函数。引入自适应记忆模块和知识增强流水线解决复杂代码生成难题，在CVRP和MIS问题上显著超越现有方法和SOTA求解器。
AI.motivation: 现有LHH方法仅在预定义求解器内优化单一函数，单层进化机制在生成完整competent求解器时效率不足。虽然部分变体融入超参数调优或尝试通过迭代局部修改生成复杂代码，但仍然缺乏高层算法建模，导致探索效率受限。
AI.method: 提出BEAM方法，采用双层优化架构：外层通过遗传算法(GA)进化高层算法结构（含函数占位符），内层通过蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)实现这些占位符。引入自适应记忆模块和知识增强(KA)流水线来支持复杂代码生成与评估。
AI.result: BEAM在多个优化问题上显著优于现有LHH方法，在CVRP混合算法设计中 aggregate 最优性差距降低37.84%，并设计的启发式算法在最大独立集(MIS)问题上超越了当前最优求解器KaMIS。
AI.conclusion: BEAM significantly outperforms existing LHHs, reducing the optimality gap by 37.84% on aggregate in CVRP hybrid algorithm design, and designs a heuristic that outperforms the state-of-the-art KaMIS solver for Maximum Independent Set problems.

title: One Token Away from Collapse: The Fragility of Instruction-Tuned Helpfulness
summary: Instruction-tuned large language models produce helpful, structured responses, but how robust is this helpfulness when trivially constrained? We show that simple lexical constraints (banning a single punctuation character or common word) cause instruction-tuned LLMs to collapse their responses, losing 14--48% of comprehensiveness in pairwise evaluation across three open-weight model families and one closed-weight model (GPT-4o-mini). The baseline response is preferred in 77--100% of 1,920 pairwise comparisons judged by GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o. Notably, GPT-4o-mini suffers 31% comprehensiveness loss (99% baseline win rate), demonstrating that the fragility extends to commercially deployed closed-weight models, contrary to prior findings on format-level constraints. Through mechanistic analysis, we identify this as a planning failure: two-pass generation (free generation followed by constrained rewriting) recovers 59--96% of response length, and linear probes on prompt representations predict response length with $R^2 = 0.51$--$0.93$ before generation begins, with $R^2$ tracking collapse severity across models. The same probes yield negative $R^2$ on base models, confirming that instruction tuning creates the representational structure encoding the collapse decision. Crucially, base models show no systematic collapse under identical constraints, with effects that are small, noisy, and bidirectional, demonstrating that instruction tuning creates this fragility by coupling task competence to narrow surface-form templates. The effect replicates on MT-Bench across all eight task categories. We further show that standard independent LLM-as-judge evaluation detects only a 3.5% average quality drop where pairwise evaluation reveals 23%, exposing a methodological blind spot in how constrained generation is assessed.

AI.tldr: 指令微调LLM在面对简单词汇约束（如禁用单个标点或常见词）时会出现响应崩塌，损失14-48%的可理解性。指令微调通过将任务能力与窄表面形式模板耦合来创造这种脆弱性，而非增强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Prior work suggested instruction-tuned LLMs are robust to format-level constraints, but this paper investigates whether robustness extends to trivial lexical constraints (banning a single punctuation or word), and whether standard evaluation methods adequately detect quality degradation.
AI.method: 1) Pairwise evaluation across four LLMs (three open-weight, one closed-weight) with simple lexical constraints (banning punctuation or common words); 2) Mechanistic analysis via two-pass generation and linear probes on prompt representations to predict response length; 3) Comparative analysis between instruction-tuned and base models; 4) Evaluation replication on MT-Bench across eight task categories.
AI.result: Simple lexical constraints cause 14-48% comprehensiveness loss; baseline preferred in 77-100% of 1920 pairwise comparisons; GPT-4o-mini shows 31% loss with 99% baseline win rate; effect replicates across all eight MT-Bench categories; standard LLM-as-judge detects only 3.5% drop where pairwise evaluation reveals 23%. Linear probes achieve R²=0.51-0.93 on instruction-tuned models but negative R² on base models, confirming instruction tuning creates the collapse decision structure. Base models show no systematic collapse.
AI.conclusion: Instruction tuning creates fragility by coupling task competence to narrow surface-form templates, and standard LLM-as-judge evaluation significantly underestimates this problem (detects only 3.5% drop vs 23% actual drop). Two-pass generation (free generation + constrained rewriting) can recover 59-96% of response length.

title: TimeSAF: Towards LLM-Guided Semantic Asynchronous Fusion for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Despite the recent success of large language models (LLMs) in time-series forecasting, most existing methods still adopt a Deep Synchronous Fusion strategy, where dense interactions between textual and temporal features are enforced at every layer of the network. This design overlooks the inherent granularity mismatch between modalities and leads to what we term semantic perceptual dissonance: high-level abstract semantics provided by the LLM become inappropriately entangled with the low-level, fine-grained numerical dynamics of time series, making it difficult for semantic priors to effectively guide forecasting. To address this issue, we propose TimeSAF, a new framework based on hierarchical asynchronous fusion. Unlike synchronous approaches, TimeSAF explicitly decouples unimodal feature learning from cross-modal interaction. It introduces an independent cross-modal semantic fusion trunk, which uses learnable queries to aggregate global semantics from the temporal and prompt backbones in a bottom-up manner, and a stage-wise semantic refinement decoder that asynchronously injects these high-level signals back into the temporal backbone. This mechanism provides stable and efficient semantic guidance while avoiding interference with low-level temporal dynamics. Extensive experiments on standard long-term forecasting benchmarks show that TimeSAF significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and further exhibits strong generalization in both few-shot and zero-shot transfer settings.

AI.tldr: TimeSAF 是一个面向多模态长时序预测的分层异步融合框架：把"单模态特征学习"与"跨模态交互"彻底解耦，用独立的跨模态语义融合主干（可学习查询自底向上聚合时间与文本语义）+ 阶段式语义精化解码器（自顶向下门控回注语义）替代现有逐层深度同步融合，在 7 个 LTSF 基准上取得 SOTA，并在少样本/零样本迁移中展现强泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 增强时序预测方法（如 Time-LLM、GPT4TS、CALF、TimeCMA 等）普遍采用"深度同步融合"策略：在网络每一层都用交叉注意力或特征拼接强行对齐文本与时间序列特征。这种设计忽视了两种模态在粒度上的天然错配——LLM 提供的是高层抽象语义，而时间序列是低层细粒度数值动态。作者将这一现象命名为"语义感知失调"（semantic perceptual dissonance）：高层语义被压缩到与低层数值波动相同的表征尺度，特征高度纠缠，导致语义先验难以有效引导预测，甚至在不恰当的深度上产生负迁移。同时，纯数值模型（PatchTST、iTransformer、TimesNet 等）缺乏语义先验，存在"语义感知缺失"（semantic perceptual deficit），跨域泛化与数据稀缺场景（少样本/零样本）能力受限。因此需要一种既保留数值建模稳定性、又能有效注入 LLM 语义先验的融合范式。
AI.method:
整体架构：输入多变量时序 X∈R^{L×N}（L=96）与离线 LLM 生成的逐变量提示嵌入 E。
1）时间序列分支：RevIN 可逆实例归一化 → 时间维切分为 patch（Np=⌊(L-P)/S⌋+1）→ 线性投影 g(·) + 可学习位置编码，得到时间 token。
2）提示编码分支：冻结的预训练 GPT-2（取前 6 层）编码按变量自动生成的统计描述性自然语言提示（模板含时间区间、采样频率、数值序列、趋势统计量），tokenize 后 padding 对齐，维度 768；经可学习语义适配模块 l(·) 映射到模型维度 D，并加变量级位置编码，得到文本 token。
3）两个结构对称的单模态主干（Unimodal Encoding Block：SelfAttn 残差 + FFN 残差，各自带 LayerNorm），严格在各自动模内演化，不做任何跨模交互。
4）跨模态语义融合主干（Cross-Modal Semantic Fusion Trunk）：设 dp 层主干、S 个融合阶段、L_S=dp/S。在每阶段触发层 κ_s 处，实例化可学习融合查询 Q_s^F∈R^{P_f×D_f}（在 batch×变量维度广播），先对查询做自注意力，再以查询为 Q、时间/文本隐状态为 K/V 做两次交叉注意力（残差形式），最后 FFN 得到该阶段的"融合记忆"F^(s)；跨模态交互只发生在指定融合层，其余层两分支独立演化。
5）阶段式语义精化解码器（Semantic Refinement Decoder）：在每个融合阶段内，先做模态内自注意力更新 U_l^(m)，再以 F^(s) 为共享 K/V 做交叉注意力得 Z_l^(m)；经模态专属线性适配器 W_ad^(m) 与跨模态共享的标量门控 g（σ(g)∈[0,1]）生成残差 R_l^(m)=σ(g)W_ad^(m)(Z_l^(m))，残差加回后接 FFN，形成"聚合—精化"闭环。
6）输出：末层时间表示展平后线性投影得预测，逆 RevIN 还原量纲；损失为 MSE + L2 权重正则。
训练：Adam，学习率网格 {1e-4,3e-4,5e-4,1e-3}，batch {16,32,48,64}，主干层数 {2,4}，融合层数 {1,2,4}，模型维度 {64,128,256,512}，最多 50 epoch + early stopping，随机种子 2024，8×RTX 3090。附录 E 给出线性化方差分析：同步融合语义噪声方差上界为 L²λ²σ²，异步融合为 S²λ²_max σ²，比值 ≲ S²/L²≪1（S=2 vs L=6），可学习门控进一步抑制噪声注入。
AI.result:
1）长时预测（T=96，H∈{96,192,336,720}，7 个数据集）：TimeSAF 在全部 14 项聚合指标上均取得最优；相比 LLM 类基线 CALF/TimeCMA/Time-FFM/UniTime/Time-LLM，MSE 分别降低 3.10%/8.83%/6.58%/10.31%，相比 Transformer/CNN/MLP 类基线通常提升超 5%（如 ETTm1 平均 MSE 0.377 vs CALF 0.395、PatchTST 0.387；Exchange 0.340 为最优；Electricity 0.174/0.264 与最优基本持平）。
2）少样本（ETT 仅用 10% 训练集）：8 项指标中 7 项最优；相对 CALF/TimeCMA/Time-LLM/GPT4TS 的 MSE 相对改进 2.38%/10.93%/18.91%/15.09%，超 PatchTST 11.46%。
3）零样本（h1→m1、h1→m2、h2→m1、h2→m2）：4 个方向中 3 个平均 MSE 最低，整体与最强基线 CALF 相当，持续优于 TimeCMA/Time-LLM/GPT4TS（MSE 分别降 10.60%/3.29%/4.19%）；补充的跨域迁移（ETTm2→Electricity、ETTm1→Weather）优于 Time-FFM。
4）消融：w/o Fusion Trunk、w/o Fusion Query、w/o Gate、Synchronous Refinement 四个变体均明显下降，其中"逐层同步精化"最差，直接验证异步策略的必要性。
5）可视化：融合查询→时间 patch 与 refinement 阶段 patch→查询的注意力图高度一致，形成稳定的"聚合—精化"循环；t-SNE 显示精化后时间特征簇向融合特征簇靠拢并部分重叠，缩小了表征空间差异。
6）超参敏感性：S 从 1→2 一致降低误差，S=4 收益甚微；融合层置于中/深层略优于浅层或边界分布，故默认 S=2 + 中深位置。
7）附录消融：提示变体（仅域/仅时间戳/仅指令）仍能保持稳定增益；Trunk-Decoder 直接由融合主干出预测虽可行但整体弱于"融合→受控注入→预测头"路径，说明受控注入更能保留细粒度数值动态。
AI.conclusion: TimeSAF 通过"分层异步融合"策略把单模态编码与跨模态交互解耦，用独立的跨模态语义融合主干 + 阶段式门控语义精化解码器替代逐层同步耦合，理论（线性化噪声方差分析）与实验（14 项聚合指标 SOTA、少样本/零样本强泛化、消融与可视化）共同表明该设计可有效缓解语义感知失调，使 LLM 先验更稳定地引导数值建模。论文同时承认局限：仅在标准 LTSF 基准上验证、缺少真实工业部署与更复杂多模态环境；提示依赖规则化统计模板，未充分利用新闻/天气报告等非结构化外部知识；受硬件限制仅使用 GPT-2，尚未系统验证 LLaMA-3/GPT-4 等更大基础模型上的行为；亦未做专门的公平性/偏差分析。未来工作是扩大跨域迁移与真实任务评测、引入更丰富的外部知识并扩展到更强 LLM。

title: Drawing on Memory: Dual-Trace Encoding Improves Cross-Session Recall in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents with persistent memory store information as flat factual records, providing little context for temporal reasoning, change tracking, or cross-session aggregation. Inspired by the drawing effect [3], we introduce dual-trace memory encoding. In this method, each stored fact is paired with a concrete scene trace, a narrative reconstruction of the moment and context in which the information was learned. The agent is forced to commit to specific contextual details during encoding, creating richer, more distinctive memory traces. Using the LongMemEval-S benchmark (4,575 sessions, 100 recall questions), we compare dual-trace encoding against a fact-only control with matched coverage and format over 99 shared questions. Dual-trace achieves 73.7% overall accuracy versus 53.5%, a +20.2 percentage point (pp) gain (95% CI: [+12.1, +29.3], bootstrap p < 0.0001). Gains concentrate in temporal reasoning (+40pp), knowledge-update tracking (+25pp), and multi-session aggregation (+30pp), with no benefit for single-session retrieval, consistent with encoding specificity theory [8]. Token analysis shows dual-trace encoding achieves this gain at no additional cost. We additionally sketch an architectural design for adapting dual-trace encoding to coding agents, with preliminary pilot validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双轨迹记忆编码（dual-trace memory encoding），通过将事实与场景叙事轨迹配对来解决LLM智能体持久记忆缺乏上下文推理能力的问题。在LongMemEval-S基准上，双轨迹编码达到73.7%准确率，相比仅事实编码的53.5%提升20.2个百分点，主要增益来自时间推理、知识更新追踪和多会话聚合任务。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体的持久记忆系统将信息存储为扁平的事实记录，缺乏时间推理、变更追踪和跨会话聚合所需的上下文信息，导致记忆检索性能受限。
AI.method: 提出双轨迹记忆编码方法：每个存储的事实与一个具体场景轨迹（concrete scene trace）配对——即信息获取时刻和情境的叙事重建。该方法强制智能体在编码时承诺特定的上下文细节，从而创建更丰富、更独特的记忆痕迹。实验采用LongMemEval-S基准（4,575个会话，100个召回问题），在99个共享问题上进行对比。
AI.result: 双轨迹编码获得73.7%总体准确率，相比53.5%的仅事实对照基线提升20.2个百分点（95%CI: [+12.1, +29.3], bootstrap p < 0.0001）。增益集中在时间推理（+40pp）、知识更新追踪（+25pp）和多会话聚合（+30pp），单会话检索无显著提升。令牌分析显示该方法未增加计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 双轨迹编码显著提升LLM智能体的上下文记忆能力，其效益与编码特异性理论（encoding specificity theory）一致，即更具体的编码有助于需要情境线索的检索任务。该方法可扩展至编码智能体领域。

title: Toward Autonomous Long-Horizon Engineering for ML Research
summary: Autonomous AI research has advanced rapidly, but long-horizon ML research engineering remains difficult: agents must sustain coherent progress across task comprehension, environment setup, implementation, experimentation, and debugging over hours or days. We introduce AiScientist, a system for autonomous long-horizon engineering for ML research built on a simple principle: strong long-horizon performance requires both structured orchestration and durable state continuity. To this end, AiScientist combines hierarchical orchestration with a permission-scoped File-as-Bus workspace: a top-level Orchestrator maintains stage-level control through concise summaries and a workspace map, while specialized agents repeatedly re-ground on durable artifacts such as analyses, plans, code, and experimental evidence rather than relying primarily on conversational handoffs, yielding thin control over thick state. Across two complementary benchmarks, AiScientist improves PaperBench score by 10.54 points on average over the best matched baseline and achieves 81.82 Any Medal% on MLE-Bench Lite. Ablation studies further show that File-as-Bus protocol is a key driver of performance, reducing PaperBench by 6.41 points and MLE-Bench Lite by 31.82 points when removed. These results suggest that long-horizon ML research engineering is a systems problem of coordinating specialized work over durable project state, rather than a purely local reasoning problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AiScientist系统，通过层次化编排和权限范围的File-as-Bus工作空间实现自主长时程ML研究工程，在PaperBench上平均提升10.54分，MLE-Bench Lite达到81.82 Any Medal%，消融实验证明File-as-Bus协议是关键组件。
AI.motivation: 当前自主AI研究虽进展迅速，但长时程ML研究工程仍面临巨大挑战：智能体需要在任务理解、环境设置、实现、实验和调试等多个阶段保持数小时至数天的连贯进展。现有方法难以维持跨长时间跨度的连贯性和状态连续性。
AI.method: 提出AiScientist系统，核心设计原则：强长时程性能需要结构化编排与持久状态连续性。系统包含两个关键组件：1）层次化编排机制：顶层Orchestrator通过简洁摘要和工作空间地图维持阶段级控制；2）权限范围的File-as-Bus工作空间：使专业智能体能持续基于持久化制品（如分析、计划、代码、实验证据）重新锚定，而非依赖对话式交接，实现薄控制覆盖厚状态。
AI.result: 在两个互补基准测试上的实验结果：1）PaperBench：相比最佳匹配基线平均提升10.54分；2）MLE-Bench Lite：达到81.82 Any Medal%。消融研究表明File-as-Bus协议是关键性能驱动因素，移除后PaperBench下降6.41分，MLE-Bench Lite下降31.82分。
AI.conclusion: 长时程ML研究工程本质上是协调专业工作与持久项目状态的系统问题，而非纯粹的局部推理问题。这一发现为构建更强大的自主研究智能体提供了新的系统级设计思路。

title: Robust Semi-Supervised Temporal Intrusion Detection for Adversarial Cloud Networks
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE 2026 EuCNC & 6G Summit. This is a preprint version. The final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
summary: Cloud networks increasingly rely on machine learning based Network Intrusion Detection Systems to defend against evolving cyber threats. However, real-world deployments are challenged by limited labeled data, non-stationary traffic, and adaptive adversaries. While semi-supervised learning can alleviate label scarcity, most existing approaches implicitly assume benign and stationary unlabeled traffic, leading to degraded performance in adversarial cloud environments. This paper proposes a robust semi-supervised temporal learning framework for cloud intrusion detection that explicitly addresses adversarial contamination and temporal drift in unlabeled network traffic. Operating on flow-level data, this framework combines supervised learning with consistency regularization, confidence-aware pseudo-labeling, and selective temporal invariance to conservatively exploit unlabeled traffic while suppressing unreliable samples. By leveraging the temporal structure of network flows, the proposed method improves robustness and generalization across heterogeneous cloud environments. Extensive evaluations on publicly available datasets (CIC-IDS2017, CSE-CIC-IDS2018, and UNSW-NB15) under limited-label conditions demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and semi-supervised network intrusion detection systems in detection performance, label efficiency, and resilience to adversarial and non-stationary traffic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RSST-NIDS——一个面向云网络入侵检测的鲁棒半监督时序学习框架，在流级（flow-level）数据上结合监督损失、一致性正则化、置信度感知伪标签与「选择性时序不变性」，通过仅对高置信、师生一致且时序稳定的「良性一致窗口」施加隐空间时序平滑约束，抑制对抗污染与时序漂移。在 CIC-IDS2017、CSE-CIC-IDS2018、UNSW-NB15 的少标注（10%/5%）设置下，10% 标注下 F1 94.5%、AUROC 0.973，优于监督与半监督基线；跨数据集训练（CIC→CSE-CIC / UNSW）AUROC 0.889 / 0.847、MCC 0.61 / 0.57 最佳；15% 投毒下性能仅小幅下降（AUROC 0.93）且仅接纳 <22% 无标注窗口。
